title: IT Analyst Applications - Senior .NET Developer
description:
**Career Area:**

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Description

  

**About Caterpillar**

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed to and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

**Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a skilled **IT Analyst Applications - Senior .NET Developer** to join **India CoE-Integration & Engg -CAT IT Division**

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN  
  
As a Senior Systems Analyst, you will have the opportunity to work both independently and with a cooperative team on complex application projects. You will develop your professional network and leadership skills, assisting in the creation and support of IT Solutions that enable Caterpillar success.

Furthermore, you will contribute real value by acting as an IT Developer on in-house and purchased IT applications to solve business problems.

This position reports to an IT Manager and is part of an IT team located in several EAME locations.

**What you will do:**  
  
Job Duties/Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

* Resolution of system incidents on a key application used in several Eastern Europe Area (EEA) countries
* Application development (.NET), implementation of Epics, Futures and User Stories (business requirements)
* Develop, configure Business Intelligences and Analytics tools (e.g., Power BI)
* Coordination and collaboration with system vendor to adjust requirements for business needs
* Create and execute unit test plans
* Support system and integration test efforts
* Analyze and resolve code defects
* Administration of the system
* Ability to collaborate with Designers, Architects, and testers to optimize the quality of integrated solutions
* Interface with other IT areas and business customer
* Handles projects or work with defined scope in own discipline and typically has a short-term focus
* Works with guidance on small-scale team/unit projects
* Solves problems in own specialty areas
* Makes worthwhile improvements to existing programs, and procedures
* Makes practical suggestions for improving work processes in own area
* Works for consensus and contributes to achievement of work group goals
* Ensures that technical documentation is maintained and up to date

What you will have:  
  
**Required Qualifications:**

* Requires a 4-year accredited university/college degree in Information Technology, Computer

Science, or related field

* 7+ years of experience as an IT Developer
* 7+ years of experience in supporting a main application, or any other leasing system
* Advanced .NET programming skills for the implementation of new features
* Experience in administration of SQL server (MSSQL and database management)
* Software Development/Configuration Knowledge
* Understand software technologies and application hosting environments
* knowledge in Business Intelligences and Analytics tools
* Advanced experience in ITIL processes (ITIL) and SLAs
* Advanced English language skills

Desired Qualifications:

* Experience in leasing or financial institution will be an advantage
* Openness for business travel
* Well-developed communication skills
* Ability to work under time pressure

**Skill Descriptors:**  
  
Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.  
**Level Working Knowledge:**  

* Helps create contingency plans to mitigate impact of disruption on core applications.
* Identifies key players, criticalities, roles, and responsibilities.
* Investigates application-related issues with both business and IT professionals.
* Recommends enhancements for a major application system or related subsystems.
* Works with core application systems for a major business unit or function.

  
**Problem Solving:**

Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
* Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
* Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

  
Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**  

* Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
* Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
* Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
* Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
* Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
* Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).  
**Level Working Knowledge:**  

* Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
* Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
* Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
* Provides instant support for end users of application software.
* Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

  
**Requirements Analysis**: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.  
**Level Working Knowledge:**
  

* Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements.
* Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis.
* Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements.
* Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements.
* Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis.

  
System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.  
**Level Working Knowledge:**
  

* Assists with current and planned integration initiatives.
* Explores major issues and considerations for successful system integration.
* Works with applications, data, technology bridges and a variety of platforms.
* Works with existing interfaces as well as integration and migration plans within own area.
* Plays an active role in local integration efforts.

  
**System Testing**:

Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Supports the project leader in developing and executing system test plans.
* Evaluates system documentation and user manuals for usability, accuracy and completeness.
* Executes test cases, analyzes test results and reports on findings regularly.
* Tests system components for compliance with functional requirements.
* Participates in the testing of a system's ability to recover from hardware or software failures.

  
**What you will get:**

Work Life Harmony

Earned and medical leave.

Relocation assistance

**Holistic Development**

Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe

Career developments opportunities with global prospects

**Health and Wellness**

Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage

Employee mental wellness assistance program

**Financial Wellness**

Employee investment plan

Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan.

**Additional Information:**

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers

  
This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

**Posting Dates:**

October 30, 2026 - November 15, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

title: Software Engineer Associate Manager -
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

**Job Description**

The Software Engineer Lead Consultant develops code for complex modules, participates in design reviews, conducts code reviews, creates test plans and participates in testing reviews, and resolves moderate defects.
  
Required skills for this role is Java 8 (must), Java 17 (good to have), Spring boot, REST APIs, microservices based architecture.  
The Lead Consultant designs, documents, reviews, and maintains components of software solutions for complex projects. Under limited supervision, the Lead Consultant works closely with business partners to identify needs and design technology solutions to overcome process bottlenecks, reduce use of contingent claim resources, reduce compliance risks, or generally increase operational efficiency. They are often required to deliver tactical solutions that can be implemented within a few days. They are responsible for all phases of the application development cycle: beginning with requirements gathering, through release, and ultimately ongoing user support.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Executes change management activities supporting production deployment to Developers, Quality Control Analysts, and Environment Management personnel
* Identifies support issues and initiate action to resolve the problem and provides technical assistance to resolve complex issues.
* Creates accurate test plans, conditions, and data; participates in testing reviews to include conducting basic levels of module and integration testing according to process standards; track and resolve moderate defects.
* Acts as a technical expert for Band B and Band C Software Engineers.
* Creates enhanced technical documentation and implement changes
* Develops or confirms detailed project or system change estimates or project plans, calibrate estimating factors for continuous improvements
* Develops code for intermediate to complex modules with high-level architecture, following documentation and development standards
* Ensures that design/code reviews are scheduled and executed; provide feedback and recommends solutions; ensures that design standards and documentation are followed and certifies that code meets quality standards; reviews and critiques code presented by team members.
* Critiques and evaluates detailed business, functional, and high-level technical requirements (including recovery, security and audit)

Education

* 4 year Bachelors Degree (Preferred)

Experience

* 12 or more years of experience

Supervisory Responsibilities

* This job does not have supervisory duties.

**Primary Skills**

Software Development

**Shift Time**

Shift B (India)

**Recruiter Info**

Shriya Kumariskuow@allstate.com

**About Allstate**

**Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.**

The Allstate Corporation is one of the largest publicly held insurance providers in the United States. Ranked No. 84 in the 2023 Fortune 500 list of the largest United States corporations by total revenue, The Allstate Corporation owns and operates 18 companies in the United States, Canada, Northern Ireland, and India. Allstate India Private Limited, also known as Allstate India, is a subsidiary of The Allstate Corporation. The India talent center was set up in 2012 and operates under the corporation's Good Hands promise. As it innovates operations and technology, Allstate India has evolved beyond its technology functions to be the critical strategic business services arm of the corporation. With offices in Bengaluru and Pune, the company offers expertise to the parent organization’s business areas including technology and innovation, accounting and imaging services, policy administration, transformation solution design and support services, transformation of property liability service design, global operations and integration, and training and transition.

Learn more about Allstate India here.

title: Software Engineer, Platfrom Engineering
description:
**About Us**

Mercari is a Japan-based C2C marketplace company founded in 2013 with the mission to "Create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell." From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018, we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission.

Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U.S. We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management.

For our services to be utilized by people worldwide, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us. This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence. With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company.  
  
**Our Culture**

To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organization and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives. Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values: Go Bold, All for One, Be a Pro and Move Fast. Our organization is also shaped by our four foundations: Sustainability, Diversity & Inclusion, Trust & Openness, and Well-being for Performance. Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organization. We invite you to read the Mercari Culture Doc which summarizes the behaviors and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognized, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari’s culture.

### **Organization/Team Mission**

### **Mercari Engineering Principles**

Mercari Engineering Principles are a shared understanding that serves as the foundation of engineering beliefs and behavior at Mercari. The Engineering Principles are designed to complement the organizational identity (Mercari's mission, values, and culture) from an engineering viewpoint.

These principles ultimately help us achieve Mercari's mission by defining the ideal state we seek to realize in the long term.

* Passion For The Product
* Grow Together
* Solve Through Mechanisms
* Collaborate Openly

### **Role**

We’re looking for a senior software engineer with a strong computer science background and proven experience developing platform or infrastructure systems. The ideal candidate is interested in distributed systems and cloud-based components, and is enthusiastic about improving developer productivity while ensuring the reliability, security, and observability of Mercari services. You should also be able to release, migrate, and operate platform features in large-scale systems.

### **What you’ll do**

* Design, develop, and maintain platform features and tools that support the full software development lifecycle, from build and test through deployment and operation.
* Support the migration to and adoption of new platform features and tools.
* Improve platform stability, scalability, availability, and security in collaboration with the SRE and Security teams.
* Improve observability of services and the platform to reduce incidents and control costs.
* Improve and automate daily platform operations, reducing toil.
* Advocate for engineering best practices and communicate with internal developers to understand their needs.

### **You may be a good fit if you**

* Are passionate about improving developer productivity and experience.
* Enjoy building, operating, and maintaining scalable infrastructure through operational automation.
* Take a pragmatic approach to problems and are neutral about technology choices.
* Avoid reinventing the wheel and make effective use of existing tools and ecosystems.
* Have strong communication and interpersonal skills.

### **Platform areas**

* ETI
* Network
* Platform Infra
* Observability

### **Bold challenges**

The platform and its tools are used across the Japan marketplace, Japan fintech, and the Mercari US marketplace. Changes and improvements can affect organizational performance—from development agility to system reliability—and your work can have a significant impact.

The team needs to understand developers’ challenges and the needs of Mercari Group product development. The team gathers requirements, prioritizes problems, and chooses practical solutions. You’ll be able to take part in that decision-making and propose solutions that draw on your knowledge and experience.

 **Requirements**  

### **Minimum requirements**

* At least 6 years of experience developing, operating, and maintaining complex, scalable production systems, including cloud-based platforms.
* Strong computer science background and in-depth knowledge of a major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Excellent written communication skills for documenting designs and collaborating with stakeholders.
* Proficiency with container platforms such as Kubernetes or Docker in production environments.
* Hands-on experience building tools and automation with scripting languages such as Bash, Go, or Python.
* Strong experience implementing and managing infrastructure as code (IaC), such as Terraform.
* Ability to collaborate with a team and adapt to a dynamic environment.

### **Preferred requirements**

* Experience with distributed systems or microservices architecture.
* Understanding of service-level agreements (SLAs) and objectives for maintaining system performance and reliability.
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability technologies such as Datadog, Prometheus, Graphite, Grafana, Kibana, or Elasticsearch.
* Previous open-source software development experience or active participation in open-source communities.
* Production experience with service meshes such as Istio, Kong, or Linkerd.

  
**Benefits**

Employment Status : Full-time

Office location: Bengaluru

**Hybrid workstyle : 2 Days Work From Office**

(We believe in high performance and professionalism. We work from office for 2 days/week and work from home 3 days/week

To build a strong & highly-engaged organization in India, we highly encourage everyone to work from our Bangalore office, especially during the initial office setup phase

We will continue to review and update the policy to address future organizational needs)

Working Conditions

* **Employment Status:** Full-time
* **Office:** Bangalore
* **Hybrid workstyle**
* + We believe in high performance and professionalism. We work from the office for 2 days/week and work from home 3 days/week.
  + To build a strong & highly-engaged organization in India, we highly encourage everyone to work from our Bangalore office, especially during the initial office setup phase
  + We will continue to review and update the policy to address future organizational needs

Media

### **Owned Media**

* Mercari Engineering Portal
* Mercari Engineering Blog: Backend
* Mercan, introduces the people that make Mercari
* https://about.in.mercari.com/category/news/
* https://about.in.mercari.com/life/

### **Related Articles**

title: SAP Senior Developer
description:
Location: Bangalore, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

DIGIS Tribes develop and maintain applications supporting the Business Lines Avionics Global Services (AGS) within Thales GBU Avionics (AVS).

AVS business lines provide customer support and maintenance services for Thales avionics equipment worldwide. The applications developed by our teams support the day-to-day activities of various business users, including logisticians, repair technicians, marketing and sales teams, while contributing to improved operational efficiency and industrial performance.

These applications are built on and around SAP ERP and rely on real-time integration through OData web services to read, create, update and delete SAP business data. Our landscape also includes SAP-based reports, dashboards and other technical solutions that support business operations.

We are seeking an experienced **SAP Senior Developer** to join our technical delivery team and take end-to-end ownership of SAP development activities. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in ABAP, RICEFW development and OData services to design, develop and maintain robust, scalable and secure solutions aligned with business needs and enterprise architecture standards.

Working closely with SAP functional teams, enterprise architecture, integration specialists, infrastructure, security teams and external partners, you will contribute to the continuous improvement of our SAP landscape, ensure high-quality technical delivery and support the evolution of our applications and integrations.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, develop and maintain SAP solutions across implementation, enhancement, migration, upgrade, integration, maintenance and production support activities.
* Own end-to-end ABAP RICEFW development, including Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms and Workflows.
* Design, implement and support OData services using SAP Gateway and ABAP to enable seamless integration with SAP UI5/Fiori applications and third-party systems.
* Collaborate with SAP UI5/Fiori developers to ensure effective backend integration, service consumption and resolution of technical issues.
* Produce technical designs and specifications that meet business requirements and comply with SAP architecture, development, security and quality standards.
* Perform complex ABAP development, debugging, code reviews and performance tuning to ensure the reliability, efficiency and maintainability of solutions.
* Provide technical expertise and guidance to project team members, acting as a subject matter expert for complex SAP development and integration challenges.
* Work closely with SAP functional owners and cross-functional technical teams to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by reviewing existing code, identifying optimization opportunities and promoting development best practices.
* Support testing, deployment, transport management, cutover, hypercare and ongoing production support.
* Contribute to SAP S/4HANA transformation initiatives and the adoption of modern SAP development and extension approaches where applicable.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field; a master's degree is preferred.
* 6–9 years of experience working in SAP environments, with strong hands-on expertise in SAP ABAP development.
* Extensive experience in ABAP Objects, RICEFW development, debugging, technical design and performance optimization.
* Strong experience designing, developing and troubleshooting OData services using SAP Gateway and ABAP, including data modelling, CRUD operations and service implementation.
* Experience integrating SAP backend services with SAP UI5/Fiori applications and third-party systems.
* Good understanding of SAP UI5 concepts, including MVC architecture, data binding, OData consumption and frontend-backend communication.
* Strong knowledge of ABAP coding standards, technical specifications, code reviews, development quality and performance best practices.
* Good understanding of SAP technical architecture, transport management, testing, deployment and production support processes.
* Basic functional knowledge of SAP modules such as SD, MM and CS, including familiarity with relevant business processes and important SAP tables.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively with functional teams, technical stakeholders, senior management and external partners.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality solutions in a dynamic project environment.

**Knowledge / Skills**
----------------------

* Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA architecture and experience contributing to implementation, migration, upgrade or rollout projects.
* Familiarity with the SAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP), including CDS views, behaviour definitions and service exposure.
* Awareness of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), cloud-based SAP solutions and modern extension approaches.
* Understanding of enterprise integration patterns and best practices for secure, scalable and maintainable SAP services.
* Knowledge of Thales business processes and the avionics or industrial services environment would be an advantage.
* Experience supporting the full software development lifecycle, from technical design and development through testing, deployment and operational support.

**Personal Attributes**
-----------------------

* Autonomous, proactive and curious, with a strong commitment to technical excellence and continuous learning.
* Rigorous and detail-oriented, with a focus on code quality, solution reliability and maintainability.
* Strong analytical and summarizing skills, with the ability to understand complex technical problems and propose practical solutions.
* Collaborative and service-oriented, comfortable working with cross-functional teams and external partners.
* Able to communicate clearly, adapt to different audiences and build effective working relationships with business and technical stakeholders.
* Capable of taking ownership, managing competing priorities and delivering under pressure.
* Demonstrates integrity, professionalism, confidentiality and a strong sense of responsibility.

#LI-AS1

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Senior Mendix Developer
description:
We are seeking an experienced **Senior Mendix Developer** with strong hands-on expertise in low-code application development, enterprise application architecture, integrations, and end-to-end solution delivery. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, enhancing, and maintaining scalable, secure, and high-performance applications using the Mendix platform.

The successful candidate will collaborate with business stakeholders, solution architects, product owners, and cross-functional engineering teams to translate complex business requirements into robust technical solutions. This role requires strong proficiency in **Mendix Studio Pro, domain modeling, microflows, nanoflows, application security, API integrations, and application lifecycle management**, along with the ability to provide technical guidance and support high-quality project delivery.

description:

===========================

In this role, you will shape how our CT software turns clinical and operational challenges into innovative, reliable solutions that help radiologists and technologists scan faster, see more clearly, reduce patient dose, and deliver better patient outcomes.  
You will lead a team of approximately 120 engineers, setting the technical vision, building world-class software engineering practices, and accelerating the speed at which we move from idea to validated product, all within the rigor required of a regulated medical device environment. As a key part of the global CT Software organization, you will bring a global mindset, working seamlessly with CT teams and partners around the world while establishing Bangalore as a center of excellence for CT software innovation.  
GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

**Job Description**
===================

**Senior Director of Software Engineering – Computed Tomography (CT)**

**Location:** Bangalore, India

**Reports to:** VP of Software Engineering - CT

**Team size:** ~120 software engineers

**Travel:** ~20–25% international travel to global CT R&D sites, customer sites, and leadership forums

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a visionary, hands-on software leader to head our CT Software Engineering organization in Bangalore. In this role, you will shape how our CT software turns clinical and operational challenges into innovative, reliable solutions that help radiologists and technologists scan faster, see more clearly, reduce patient dose, and deliver better patient outcomes.

You will lead a team of approximately 120 engineers, setting the technical vision, building world-class software engineering practices, and accelerating the speed at which we move from idea to validated product, all within the rigor required of a regulated medical device environment. As a key part of the global CT Software organization, you will bring a global mindset, working seamlessly with CT teams and partners around the world while establishing Bangalore as a center of excellence for CT software innovation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Leadership and Vision**

* Define and communicate a multi-year software vision and strategy for the Bangalore CT organization, aligned with global CT business priorities, product roadmaps, and customer needs.
* Translate business objectives into clear engineering goals, measurable outcomes, and investment priorities.
* Develop and drive strategic initiatives that improve engineering productivity, product quality, and time-to-market.
* Anticipate technology and industry trends in CT and position the organization to take advantage of them.

**2. Customer-Centric Innovation**

* Champion a deep understanding of customer pain points by engaging directly with radiologists, CT technologists, service teams, and hospital IT and operations stakeholders.
* Partner with Product Management, Clinical, Applications, and UX teams to turn unmet customer needs into differentiated software solutions, for example simpler scan workflows, faster and more consistent exams, lower dose, better image quality, higher system uptime, and smarter automation.
* Build an innovation pipeline that balances near-term customer improvements with longer-term breakthrough capabilities.
* Encourage rapid experimentation through prototypes, proofs of concept, hackathons, and customer pilots to validate ideas early and often.

**3. Innovation Speed and R&D Execution**

* Oversee end-to-end delivery of CT software programs, including innovation projects, new product introductions (NPIs), design changes, sustaining engineering, and field actions.
* Ensure programs are delivered with high quality, on schedule, and within budget, with predictable and transparent execution.
* Increase innovation velocity by shortening feedback loops, reducing cycle time, and removing organizational and technical bottlenecks, without compromising safety or compliance.
* Use metrics such as DORA metrics, lead time, defect escape rate, and customer-reported issues to drive data-informed decisions and continuous improvement.
* Identify and manage key delivery risks and cross-site dependencies proactively.

**4. World-Class Software Engineering Practices**

* Establish and continuously raise the bar on engineering excellence, including code quality, design reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, DevSecOps, and release management.
* Lead the adoption of modern engineering practices and tools, including test automation, simulation and virtual scanner environments, infrastructure as code, observability, and AI-assisted development, adapted for a regulated environment.
* Provide leadership on Lean and Agile principles at scale; coach teams on estimation, work sizing, backlog health, and flow efficiency.
* Benchmark the organization against industry leaders and drive a roadmap toward best-in-class engineering maturity.

**5. Quality, Safety, and Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure all software activities comply with applicable medical device regulations and standards, and relevant cybersecurity requirements.
* Build quality and compliance into everyday engineering workflows so that they support speed rather than slow it down.
* Partner with Quality, Regulatory, and Systems Engineering leaders to ensure CT products meet compliance, controllership, radiation safety, and patient safety standards.
* Ensure audit readiness and lead the organization's response to software-related CAPAs, field issues, and regulatory inquiries.

**6. Technical Standards, Architecture, and Platforms**

* Partner with global system architects and cross-functional leaders to define future CT technology platforms that are scalable, secure, interoperable, and reusable across product lines.
* Drive platform thinking and modular design to reduce duplication, speed up new feature delivery, and lower total cost of ownership.

**7. Global Leadership and Collaboration**

* Lead the Bangalore CT software organization as an integral part of the global CT software team, with a "one team" mindset built on trust, shared goals, and seamless collaboration across geographies, cultures, and time zones.
* Represent the Bangalore CT organization in global leadership forums and strengthen its visibility and impact across the business.
* Work closely with global partners in Product Management, Systems Engineering, Hardware, Detector and Physics, Clinical, Service, Manufacturing, Quality, and Regulatory.

**8. Talent Management and Culture**

* Attract, develop, and retain top engineering talent in a highly competitive market.
* Build strong technical and functional leadership benches, organizational models, and succession plans.
* Create an inclusive, high-performance culture built on ownership, curiosity, psychological safety, and continuous learning.
* Develop clear technical and managerial career paths, and mentor emerging leaders and senior technical experts.

**9. Engineering Operations and Finances**

* Own and manage the Bangalore CT software engineering budget, headcount, and resource allocation.
* Explore and implement alternative resourcing models, such as partners, vendors, and centers of excellence, to scale capacity and accelerate innovation.
* Use portfolio and project management tools to track progress, report status, and highlight key risks.
* Drive cost efficiency and productivity improvements while protecting investment in innovation.

**10. Stakeholder Engagement and Communication**

* Present regular updates on strategy, progress, and risks to executive sponsors, global CT leadership, and customers.
* Align stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and trade-offs; resolve conflicting priorities through proactive and transparent communication.
* Ensure data, process, and system changes are implemented in line with project objectives and timelines.

**11. Thought Leadership and Knowledge Sharing**

* Act as a recognized technical and leadership voice inside the company and in the wider industry, including conferences, publications, and industry and academic partnerships.

* Encourage the creation of learning content, internal tech talks, communities of practice, and patents and invention disclosures.

title: Director, Systems Software Engineering
description:
Oracle is seeking an engineering director to build and lead a new Systems Firmware team in Bengaluru. You will hire the founding engineers, establish the team’s technical direction and culture, and take responsibility for outcomes that directly affect the reliability and serviceability of our server fleet.

The team’s initial mission is to resolve BMC and BIOS firmware issues in production. Working closely with US engineering teams, infrastructure operations, hardware teams, and external partners, you will lead complex investigations, drive lasting fixes, and improve the diagnostics, testing, and release practices that prevent problems from recurring. The team will participate in on-call rotations during India daytime hours, complementing US coverage through coordinated response and clear technical handoffs.

You will start with four senior engineers and provide close technical leadership while building the practices and partnerships needed for the team to succeed. You will set priorities, develop your engineers, and balance immediate fleet needs with longer-term improvements in firmware quality, security, and operational efficiency.

You will also shape the team’s roadmap and future capability. As additional hiring is approved, our intent is to expand its responsibilities into firmware development and delivery for new server and GPU platforms. This includes working with original design manufacturers and joint design manufacturers (ODM/JDMs), particularly Taiwan-based partners, on platform requirements, firmware integration, bring-up, validation, and production readiness.

This role calls for a leader with deep systems firmware expertise, sound operational judgment, and a record of building strong engineering teams. You should be comfortable guiding difficult technical investigations, holding partners accountable for delivery, and translating lessons from production into better engineering decisions.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Build and lead the Bangalore Systems Firmware team.** Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional engineers working on BMC firmware and BIOS. Establish clear ownership, coach technical leaders, and create an inclusive culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* **Own firmware operational support during India daytime hours.** Establish sustainable on-call rotations and effective handoffs with US teams to provide continuity of support for Oracle’s server and GPU fleet.
* **Lead resolution of complex firmware issues.** Guide incident triage, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions across firmware, hardware, and software boundaries. Prioritize work by customer impact and ensure timely resolution and clear stakeholder communication.
* **Turn fleet experience into better products.** Partner with engineering, operations, and vendors to address recurring defects, improve diagnostics and recovery, and translate customer and operational needs into firmware enhancements.
* **Establish engineering and operational standards.** Define and evolve runbooks, escalation processes, maintenance procedures, and firmware validation and deployment practices that improve fleet availability, health, security, and reliability.
* **Drive disciplined execution.** Set priorities and manage interdependent initiatives across teams, balancing urgent fleet issues with long-term improvements. Establish measurable outcomes, manage dependencies, and adjust plans as business needs and resources evolve.
* **Champion firmware quality and security.** Partner with security and engineering stakeholders to establish secure development practices, clear acceptance criteria, and appropriate testing and release controls.
* **Develop strong global partnerships.** Align priorities and ownership across US and India engineering teams, fleet operations, hardware engineering, and external partners. Build productive relationships with ODM/JDM vendors, including Taiwan-based partners.
* **Expand the team’s product development capabilities as it grows.** Build the expertise and processes needed to contribute to firmware architecture, platform bring-up, integration, validation, and production readiness for new server and GPU products.
* **Drive continuous improvement.** Evaluate emerging firmware technologies, identify team skill gaps, and invest in automation, knowledge sharing, and engineering practices that improve execution and reduce recurring operational work.

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated success leading systems firmware engineering teams, with experience hiring, coaching, managing performance, and developing senior technical talent.
* Deep technical expertise in server firmware, with substantial experience in BMC firmware and/or BIOS/UEFI and the ability to lead engineering decisions across both domains.
* Experience supporting production server environments and leading the investigation and resolution of complex issues spanning firmware, hardware, operating systems, and platform management.
* Strong technical judgment, including the ability to guide architecture and design reviews, evaluate competing solutions, and connect immediate corrective actions to long-term reliability improvements.
* Experience establishing operational support practices, including on-call rotations, incident escalation, root-cause analysis, runbooks, and coordination across geographically distributed teams.
* A record of delivering complex engineering initiatives through clear priorities, resource planning, dependency management, and effective cross-functional execution.
* Experience applying secure development practices, firmware validation, release management, and controlled deployment processes.
* Strong communication and partnership skills, with the ability to explain technical issues, manage escalations, and align engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external vendors.
* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building a new engineering team or expanding an existing team from operational support into firmware development and product delivery.
* Experience working directly with ODM/JDM partners on server firmware development, platform bring-up, qualification, and production issue resolution; collaboration with Taiwan-based vendors is particularly relevant.
* Experience with GPU or accelerated computing platforms and the firmware requirements of large-scale cloud infrastructure.
* Familiarity with OpenBMC or other BMC firmware stacks, BIOS/UEFI implementations, and server management interfaces and standards such as Redfish and IPMI.
* Experience improving fleet reliability through firmware telemetry, automated testing, diagnostic tooling, and safe update and recovery mechanisms.

title: Event Streaming Developer
description:
**Description**

Google Cloud

* Architecture Mindset
* Hands-On Pipeline & Production Builder

Experience Required 7-10 years

We are building a central Data Engineering team responsible for ingesting data from enterprise source systems and engineering applications — including Oracle, CRM platforms, and internal engineering tools — loading it into our data platform and delivering foundational data products that serve Group Practices across the firm. We're looking for a senior engineer who combines an architecture mindset with deep hands-on experience — someone who can design scalable systems and personally build and ship them into production. You will own pipelines end-to-end, from whiteboard to running code, on Google Cloud.

What You'll Do

ARCHITECTURE & DESIGN

Architect end-to-end data platform solutions: from source system connectivity through ingestion, storage, transformation, and data product delivery — making deliberate decisions on scalability, cost, and maintainability.

Define reference architectures and reusable patterns: for pipelines, storage layout, IAM boundaries, and CIM modeling that the whole engineering team builds from.

Evaluate and select Google Cloud services: for each workload: streaming vs. batch, event-driven vs. scheduled, structured vs. unstructured.

Translate business requirements: from Portfolio Data Managers and domain data owners into clear, implementable technical designs.

HANDS-ON PIPELINE & PRODUCTION ENGINEERING

Personally build and ship production pipelines: this role codes, not just designs. You will own your work from first commit through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing reliability.

Build end-to-end ingestion pipelines: from source systems (Oracle, CRM, engineering applications) into Google Cloud Storage and BigQuery.

Build multimodal unstructured data processing workflows: handling PDFs, Excel, PowerPoint, audio recordings, video files, and engineering drawings.

Apply Google Cloud AI services: Document AI, Speech-to-Text, Video Intelligence, Vision API, Vertex AI — to extract structured information from unstructured content and ship results to production datasets.

Use LLMs: to classify, summarize, and transform unstructured text and documents into structured, queryable data products.

Build and maintain Common Information Model (CIM) semantic layers: aligning ingested data with business-domain meaning across Group Practices.

Design and manage Google Cloud Storage buckets: lifecycle policies, folder structure, access controls, and cost optimization.

Configure and enforce Google Cloud IAM: service accounts, role bindings, workload identity, and least-privilege policies across all platform resources.

Write observability into every pipeline: logging, alerting, data quality checks, and SLA monitoring from day one.

Required Skills

ARCHITECTURE MINDSET & PRODUCTION ENGINEERING

Proven record of designing systems and then personally building them for production, not delegating implementation after the whiteboard session.

Architecture trade-off decisions: streaming vs. batch, managed vs. custom, normalized vs. denormalized — and the ability to explain the reasoning clearly.

Reliability patterns: idempotency, dead-letter queues, retry logic, schema evolution, and data quality gates.

Technical design documents that a team can build from, and are equally comfortable writing the code.

GOOGLE CLOUD PLATFORM

BigQuery

* Cloud Storage (GCS)
* Cloud IAM
* Dataflow / Apache Beam

title: Senior C++ Software Engineer (Networking)
description:
Location: Pune & Bengaluru

  
  

Position Requirements

About the role We are seeking a Senior / Lead Engineer with deep expertise in C/C++ systems programming, data plane forwarding, and enterprise network routing to join our core engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing high-performance networking software and firmware running on enterprise-grade edge and gateway appliances. You will work closely with architecture, software, hardware, and QA teams to build scalable, resilient, and high-throughput networking solutions. The position combines low-level systems programming, embedded Linux kernel networking, and modern dynamic routing protocols to deliver next-generation networking platforms at scale. Responsibilities • Design, implement, and maintain high-performance data plane components, forwarding pipelines, and system daemons using C and Modern C++ (more C++ compa ratio). • Develop, extend, and optimize modular packet-processing architectures and Linux kernel networking paths. • Implement and enhance enterprise routing and L2/L3 capabilities, including BGP, OSPF, VRF, LACP (802.3ad), VLANs, and Dual-Stack IPv4/IPv6. • Integrate, configure, and maintain open-source routing suites and daemons (such as BIRD and FRR). • Diagnose and resolve complex networking, forwarding, and performance bottlenecks across user space and kernel space. • Profile system performance, memory utilization, and throughput, implementing optimizations for multi-core hardware platforms. • Collaborate with QA, Systems Test, and DevOps teams to define testing strategies, automated validation harnesses, and release-gating criteria. • Participate in technical design reviews, architectural discussions, and code reviews to enforce software engineering best practices. • Maintain development and build workflows using embedded build systems and CI/CD automation pipelines.

  

Selling Points

Requirements

• 7+ years of hands-on software development experience, ideally in Embedded Systems, Network Firmware, or Data Plane Development. • Strong proficiency in C and Modern C++ (C++14/C++17) with a deep understanding of memory management, concurrency, and data structures. • Solid experience with Linux Kernel Networking (e.g., netfilter/iptables, network namespaces, socket programming, routing tables, and interface management). • Strong foundation in L2/L3 networking protocols and dynamic routing: • Dynamic routing protocols (BGP, OSPF) and routing daemons (BIRD / FRR). • VRF (Virtual Routing and Forwarding) and network segmentation. • Dual-Stack IPv4 / IPv6 networking (SLAAC, DHCPv6, NDP, Neighbor Discovery). • L2 link aggregation, VLAN tagging, and bridging. • Practical experience working in Embedded Linux development environments (cross-compilation, toolchains, POSIX APIs). • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills using system logs, core dumps, and packet analyzers (Wireshark, tcpdump). • Familiarity with version control workflows using Git, Gerrit, or GitLab. • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional communication skills.

  

Nice to Have

• Firmware & Embedded Systems experience is highly appreciated. • Experience with FD.io VPP (Vector Packet Processing), DPDK, or vector-based packet forwarding graph architectures. • Experience with modular packet router frameworks (e.g., Click Modular Router or similar packet graph frameworks). • Knowledge of VPN and secure overlay technologies (IPsec / IKEv2, secure tunnels). • Experience with embedded Linux build systems such as Yocto / BitBake, CMake, or Make. • Scripting capabilities in Python or Bash for rapid prototyping, diagnostic tooling, and test automation. • Understanding of multi-WAN architectures, dynamic path selection, and policy-based routing.

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Simulation team, you will build the web applications and services that make simulation usable for engineers, application teams, and customers. From configuring scenarios and importing customer environments, to launching and monitoring simulation runs, to exploring datasets and results, you will create the experiences that turn powerful simulation of UR cobots and MiR mobile robots into practical everyday tools.

**The Team**

Engineering - Our engineering team is at the core of our products – connected directly to the mission of preventing cyberattacks. We are constantly innovating – challenging the way we, and the industry, think about cybersecurity. Our engineers don’t shy away from building products to solve problems no one has pursued before. We define the industry, instead of waiting for directions. We need individuals who feel comfortable in ambiguity, excited by the prospect of a challenge, and empowered by the unknown risks facing our everyday lives that are only enabled by a secure digital environment.

  
  

**Job Summary**

As a Principal Software Engineer for Device Security & Containers, you will build the enterprise managed devices running the PANW security stack. You will serve as the primary technical interface between PANW and hardware teams, responsible for platform firmware, cloud management agents, and new hardware board bring-up. Operating at the intersection of embedded Linux, cloud-connected agents, and platform hardware, you will define and build features across network and security layers.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement the container runtime to host the PANW security stack as an isolated privileged container.
* Build data path integration using netfilter hooks and eBPF programs for intercepting and inspecting client traffic.
* Benchmark and optimize on-device security inspection across various SoC tiers to define product performance commitments.
* Implement IPS/IDS capabilities on the device, including rogue device detection and signal jamming detection.
* Develop post-quantum cryptography at the application layer to leverage vendor SoC PQC silicon support.
* Establish a firmware security hardening baseline, including read-only overlays and runtime attestation hooks.

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in embedded or systems security engineering focusing on resource-constrained Linux environments.
* Production experience with eBPF programs for network traffic inspection or security monitoring (XDP, TC, socket filters).
* Experience with container runtimes (Docker, containerd) in embedded Linux environments, including seccomp and capability management.
* Working knowledge of netfilter/nftables for data path traffic redirection and inspection.
* Strong programming skills in C and C++, along with Python for tooling and test automation.
* BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing or working with IDS/IPS systems for rogue device detection
* Familiarity with ML inference at the edge, deploying models on resource-constrained hardware with NPU integration.
* Understanding of secure boot chains, firmware attestation, and TPM-backed trust anchors.
* Experience with network security protocols and threat detection such as DPI and file sandboxing.
* Strong experience in packet processing, parsing, and networking (L2-L4) protocols across architectures.
* Experience in data plane forwarding, network processor programming, and DPDK packet processing performance tuning.

**Our Commitment**

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Edge AI SDK Lead - Bangalore
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for an Edge AI SDK Lead to own the customer-facing software experience for Velaura’s AI SoC.

This role will define and lead development of public APIs, SDK structure, command-line tools, sample applications, documentation, developer workflows, model and camera examples, developer portal content, compatibility matrices, and the path from “unboxing the eval kit” to running real robotics and AI workloads. This is an on-device role: the SDK runs on our silicon, not in the cloud.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own SDK architecture, public APIs, command-line tools, sample applications, documentation strategy, and developer workflows.
* Set the API standards, versioning, error handling, logging, packaging, compatibility, and deprecation policies across platform, AI runtime, camera, and robotics components.
* Lead the developer experience for installing the SDK, flashing boards, running demos, deploying models, using cameras, and integrating with applications.
* Work with AI, multimedia, robotics, and model-zoo teams to deliver model examples, camera-to-NPU pipelines, ROS examples, containers, and reference applications.
* Own developer documentation structure, getting-started guides, tutorials, API references, troubleshooting guides, migration guides, and known-issues workflows.
* Partner with Tools/Release on downloads, package repos, release notes, compatibility matrices, SDK artifacts, archived releases, checksums, and versioned documentation.
* Help define developer portal requirements including docs, downloads, model/app catalog, camera compatibility, KB integration, entitlement/access control, and support-bundle workflows.
* Ensure SDK quality by partnering with SQA on examples, docs validation, install tests, compatibility tests, and release readiness.

  

* Represent the customer developer perspective in architecture and prioritization discussions.
* Hire, mentor, and lead engineers focused on SDK APIs, developer tools, documentation systems, developer portal integration, and sample applications.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Strong experience building and shipping SDKs, APIs, or developer tools for embedded or edge hardware (e.g., SoCs, AI accelerators, dev kits, camera or robotics platforms) - software that customers install and run on the device itself. Experience limited to cloud, web, or backend SDKs/APIs does not meet this requirement.
* Strong C/C++ for embedded targets and Python experience, with ability to design clean APIs and production-quality examples.
* Hands-on experience developing for embedded Linux targets, such as cross-compilation and toolchains, BSPs, board bring-up and flashing, device drivers, or on-device packaging and deployment.
* Strong sense of developer experience, documentation quality, API usability, and release discipline.
* Ability to work across kernel, runtime, compiler, multimedia, robotics, tools, SQA, and product teams.
* Experience translating complex low-level capabilities into usable customer-facing software.
* Experience leading technical teams or major SDK/API architecture areas.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with AI accelerator SDKs, robotics SDKs, Jetson-like platforms, edge AI products, or semiconductor developer kits.
* Familiarity with ONNX/PyTorch/TFLite model flows, ROS 2, GStreamer, OpenCV, containers, Linux packaging, or Python packaging.
* Experience building developer portals, documentation sites, SDK installers, CLI tools, sample catalogs, knowledge bases, or model zoos.
* Experience with API governance, semantic versioning, compatibility matrices, customer migration guides, and release notes.
* Experience working with early customers, field teams, support teams, or developer relations.
* Ability to write excellent technical documentation and set a high bar for customer-facing materials.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

At Velaura, we believe exceptional talent deserves exceptional rewards. Compensation for this role includes a base salary and very competitive equity compensation, allowing team members to share in the company’s long-term success.

The base pay listed represents a good faith estimate that the Company reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of hire. Actual compensation will depend on multiple factors, including the candidate's skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and geographic location.

In addition to base salary and equity compensation, Velaura offers a comprehensive benefits package that may include medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; flexible work arrangements; professional development opportunities; and other benefits designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

Velaura is committed to pay equity and transparency and regularly benchmarks compensation to ensure we remain competitive in the market.

**Why Velaura?**
----------------

Velaura is building next-generation compute technology for cloud, edge, and Physical AI. Our solutions will enable robots, autonomous systems, drones, and other intelligent machines to operate efficiently in the physical world.  
This is an opportunity to help build foundational technology at a time when the industry is undergoing fundamental change. You will work alongside experienced leaders, architects, engineers, and operators who have delivered industry-defining products across mobile, cloud, semiconductor, and AI platforms. If you enjoy solving difficult problems, working across disciplines, and helping shape the future of Physical AI, we would love to hear from you.

---------------------------------------------------

Born from the combination of Dufry and Autogrill, Avolta is redefining the travel experience through the dedication and expertise of our diverse workforce. Sustainability and social responsibility are embedded in our strategy, ensuring we grow in a way that benefits both our employees and the communities we serve.

Are you looking for a dynamic, international career where your contributions truly matter? Join Avolta and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of travel - together.

  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Web Scraping & Competitor Onboarding - 65%
  

* Analyse assigned websites using Chrome DevTools (Network, Elements and Console) to determine whether data is

best extracted from HTML, XHR/Fetch requests, REST/JSON APIs, embedded JSON, or browser-rendered content.
  

* Develop production-grade spiders using the Scrapy framework, including Spiders, Requests/Responses, Items,

Item Loaders, Pipelines, Middlewares and project/settings configuration.
  

* Use Selenium WebDriver or Playwright for Python when required data cannot reliably be obtained through Scrapy

or direct HTTP requests.
  

* Handle JavaScript-rendered content and browser interactions such as dropdowns, pop-ups, location/airport

selection, load-more buttons and infinite scrolling.
  

* Implement and maintain location-specific crawls where product assortment, pricing, promotions, availability or

content varies by country, region, airport, store or selected location. Handle location selection through URLs, APIs,
  
cookies, sessions or browser interactions as required.
  

* Handle product variants accurately, including size, volume, pack size, colour or other product options, ensuring

relevant variants and their associated prices, availability, identifiers and attributes are extracted and mapped
  
correctly.
  

* Build robust XPath and CSS selectors capable of handling nested and changing HTML structures.
* Implement numbered, next-page, load-more, infinite-scroll and API/cursor-based pagination.
* Extract structured product information such as product name, brand, category, regular/promotional price, currency,

availability, product URL, image URL, SKU/product identifiers and other required attributes.
  

* Work with requests/httpx and direct APIs where browser automation is unnecessary; parse nested JSON and

embedded JavaScript/JSON objects.
  

* Implement request/session management including headers, cookies, retries, timeouts, redirects, throttling and proxy

configuration.
  

* Develop reusable scraping components and avoid duplicated website-specific logic wherever practical.

Data Quality, Testing & Validation - 20%
  

* Validate scraper output against the source website and defined data schema.
* Implement field validation, normalization and cleaning for prices, currencies, identifiers, availability and text fields.
* Handle missing fields, malformed responses, duplicate records and unexpected page structures gracefully.

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. ## Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a ServiceNow Developer with 4–5 years of hands-on experience designing, developing, configuring, and supporting ServiceNow solutions. The candidate should have a strong foundation in ITSM and practical experience in at least one additional ServiceNow module: WSD, ITOM, or SAM.
  
  
The role involves working with business and technical teams to understand requirements, deliver maintainable solutions, support integrations, and improve platform capabilities.
  
  
## Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Configure and develop ServiceNow applications, forms, workflows, and user experiences.
* Implement and support ITSM processes, such as Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Catalog.
* Develop and maintain Flow Designer flows, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, script includes, and ACLs.
* Create and enhance catalog items, record producers, variable sets, approvals, and notifications.
* Work with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical designs and platform solutions.
* Develop and support integrations using REST or SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and related ServiceNow capabilities.
* Troubleshoot defects, perform root-cause analysis, and resolve production issues.
* Follow development standards, update set practices, code review processes, and platform governance requirements.
* Support testing, deployments, documentation, and knowledge transfer.
* Identify opportunities to improve platform usability, automation, and operational efficiency.

  
## Module-Specific Experience
  
  
The candidate should have hands-on experience in \*\*at least one\*\* of the following:
  
  
### Workplace Service Delivery (WSD)
  
  

* Configure workplace services, such as space reservations, moves, workplace cases, or maintenance requests.
* Work with workplace locations, spaces, floors, and related data.
* Support WSD workflows, portal experiences, notifications, and integrations.

  
### IT Operations Management (ITOM)
  
  

* Support Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, or ITOM Health capabilities.
* Understand MID Server configuration and troubleshooting.
* Work with configuration items, discovery patterns, identification and reconciliation, and CMDB data quality.

  
### Software Asset Management (SAM)
  
  

* Support software asset data, normalization, reconciliation, and license management processes.
* Work with software models, entitlements, installations, and reclamation workflows.
* Assist with software compliance reporting and integrations with discovery or inventory sources.

  
## Required Skills and Experience
  
  

* 4–5 years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience.
* Strong experience implementing and supporting ITSM.
* Practical experience in at least one of WSD, ITOM, or SAM.
* Proficiency in JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting.
* Experience with Flow Designer, business rules, client scripts, script includes, UI policies, ACLs, and scheduled jobs.
* Experience developing catalog items, record producers, and service request workflows.
* Familiarity with REST/SOAP integrations and data import or transformation processes.
* Understanding of CMDB concepts, tables, relationships, and platform data structures.
* Experience with testing, debugging, deployments, and production support.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

  
## Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* One or more relevant micro-certifications or implementation certifications in ITSM, WSD, ITOM, or SAM.
* Experience with Service Portal or Employee Center.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery and tools such as Jira.
* Experience working with update sets, application repository, or source control.
* Knowledge of CSDM and ServiceNow platform governance practices.

  
## Success Profile
  
  
The successful candidate is a hands-on developer who can deliver reliable ServiceNow solutions, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and contribute across ITSM and at least one specialist module.

title: Principal Data Systems Software Engineer
description:
Build the next generation of Oracle Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA) software, helping fortune 500 enterprises protect and recover their business-critical Oracle databases. Work on software where data integrity, recoverability, cyber resilience, and performance at scale directly affect customers' most important operations.

Join our growing engineering team in Bengaluru and collaborate with experienced ZDLRA engineers in India and the US. You will contribute to shared product priorities, deliver new features and projects, and help evolve an enterprise data protection platform. This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team while building deep product expertise within an established global engineering organization.

The work spans Oracle database kernel development and systems programming, primarily in C and PL/SQL on Linux. You will tackle engineering problems involving buffers and caches, memory management, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, concurrency, and distributed systems. Strong algorithms, thoughtful design, and an understanding of how these components interact will be central to delivering correct, efficient, and maintainable software.

You will participate throughout the development lifecycle: understanding problems, exploring the codebase, identifying root causes, designing solutions, implementing changes, writing tests, and validating results. The work combines new development and enhancements with complex defect resolution, including issues encountered in customer environments. As your product knowledge grows, you will take increasing technical ownership of assigned features and components, contributing to design decisions, code reviews, ongoing maintenance, and knowledge sharing.

We value engineers who investigate problems systematically, use documentation and diagnostic tools resourcefully, communicate clearly, and help colleagues succeed. You will use modern engineering tools, including LLMs and AI coding agents, to accelerate code exploration, development, and testing while applying independent judgment and rigorous validation to the resulting designs and code.

We welcome experienced developers with strong C, Linux, system programming skills and practical knowledge of database internals, storage, distributed systems, or other demanding enterprise software. Prior Oracle Database, RMAN, PL/SQL, or backup and recovery product experience is an advantage. Strong systems fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to translate complex requirements into reliable production software are essential.

This position is based in Bengaluru, India.

  

**Product development and technical ownership**

* Design, implement, and maintain ZDLRA features and enhancements in C and PL/SQL on Linux, contributing to Oracle database kernel and systems software development.
* Translate requirements and technical problems into clear designs, manageable tasks, and deliverable milestones. Evaluate alternatives and document trade-offs involving correctness, performance, scalability, compatibility, and maintainability.
* Apply appropriate algorithms and data structures to build efficient, reliable software. Reason about memory use, concurrency, synchronization, and behavior under demanding workloads.
* Develop and improve assigned components involving buffers, caches, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, and distributed processing, with careful attention to data integrity and recovery behavior.
Build product expertise through code exploration, technical documentation, collaboration, and delivery of fixes and enhancements. Progress toward ownership of assigned features and projects, including subsequent development, maintenance, and defect resolution.  

**Investigation, performance, and quality**

* Investigate complex defects, including issues reported from customer deployments. Reproduce failures, trace relevant code paths, establish root causes, and implement durable fixes.
* Use GDB, core dumps, logs, traces, profiling tools, and Linux utilities to gather evidence and understand software behavior across interacting components.
* Diagnose performance and scalability bottlenecks involving CPU, memory, storage, I/O, and networking. Establish useful measurements and validate the impact of changes against representative workloads.
* Design and implement tests alongside production code. Cover functional behavior, boundary conditions, regressions, concurrency, and relevant failure and recovery scenarios using the team's engineering and test frameworks.
* Use shell scripting and automation to improve diagnostic data collection, issue reproduction, testing, and other repeatable development tasks.
Follow secure coding practices and engineering standards. Evaluate error handling, resource management, backward compatibility, and versioning implications when modifying existing code or interfaces.  

**Engineering execution and collaboration**

* Take assigned work through the software development lifecycle, from analysis and design through implementation, review, testing, integration, and maintenance.
* Plan work realistically, identify dependencies, and communicate progress, design decisions, risks, and blockers. Coordinate with the engineering team to deliver agreed project milestones.
* Collaborate closely with ZDLRA engineers in India and the US and with relevant database engineering teams to resolve cross-component issues and deliver shared product objectives.
* Participate in design and code reviews, providing constructive feedback on correctness, clarity, performance, security, test coverage, and long-term maintainability.
* Write and maintain useful design notes, implementation documentation, and troubleshooting guidance. Share findings so that investigations and engineering decisions benefit the wider team.
* Use internal documentation, specifications, and existing code resourcefully to understand unfamiliar areas. Ask focused questions, seek timely feedback, and help colleagues solve technical problems.
As product expertise grows, provide technical guidance, mentor colleagues, and contribute to improvements in the team's development practices and engineering quality.  

**AI-assisted engineering**

* Use LLMs and AI coding agents to accelerate code exploration, problem analysis, implementation, test development, and documentation where they are useful.
* Critically review AI-generated suggestions and verify them against the actual codebase, requirements, and observed behavior. Validate changes through appropriate reviews and tests, and remain accountable for the correctness, security, performance, and maintainability of delivered software.
