title: Senior Software Engineer II - Storage
description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you'll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.

**Position Overview:**
----------------------

We are looking for an engineer who will help lead the development and support of current and future storage platforms at scale, with a particular focus on Network File System (NFS) and scalable file storage solutions.  
The Storage Team supports the operations and development of block volumes, backups, image management, object storage, and scalable file systems like NFS. Our goal is to create a cohesive, singular interface to hypervisor storage, where storage class placement decisions are transparent to the hypervisor client and leverage the full range of block and file storage classes to best satisfy customer needs.
  
  
The selected candidate will have the opportunity to make impactful contributions to key software, contribute to the open source community, and debug interesting problems at cloud scale.

  

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

* Design, build, and maintain scalable NFS solutions and distributed file systems.
* Support the creation and operations of distributed systems at scale.
* Program in Go and other languages to develop high-performance storage solutions.
* Collaborate with a motivated team of peers to architect, develop, and optimize storage services.
* Contribute to and consume from free/open-source software communities, particularly in the file storage space.
* Solve complex, large-scale problems in a technically rewarding environment.

  

**Key Metrics:**
----------------

* Service availability (SLO/SLA): Monthly uptime for control plane and data plane (e.g., control plane 99.9%, data plane 99.95%); reported monthly.
* Mean time to detect / recover (MTTD / MTTR): Median detection and recovery times for Sev-1/Sev-2 incidents; tracked per quarter.
* Incident volume & change-failure rate: Number of incidents by severity and percentage of releases that cause rollbacks or incidents; tracked per release and monthly.
* Customer adoption & usage growth: Growth in active NFS customers, number of active mounts/clients, and total provisioned capacity (GiB/TiB) — measured QoQ.
* Operational efficiency / automation: Reduction in manual ops (on-call time, manual runbooks, toil) measured as % decrease in operational tickets or hours.
* Feature delivery: % of planned milestones delivered on time and meeting acceptance criteria.

  

**What You'll Add to DigitalOcean:**
------------------------------------

* Deep knowledge of NFS, scalable file systems, and distributed storage architectures.
* Experience designing, deploying, and operating highly available file storage solutions.
* Familiarity with Object Storage and distributed File Systems and how to scale those solutions.
* Expertise in concurrency/parallelism models in modern programming languages like Go.
* A passion for open-source contributions and collaborating with the storage community.

* This job is located in Bengaluru, India

JR: 2026-8243

As part of our team, you'll embody our "Shark" mindset: bold, ambitious, and scrappy. You'll lead with a bias for action and take true ownership of our products, customer success, and team culture.

data-backed user flows.

- Understanding of accessibility, responsive design, browser behavior, and usability

fundamentals.

- Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering and

business teams.

**Existing Automation :**

The current invoice processing solution is automated using Power Automate Desktop, Power Automate Cloud Flows, and an AI Document Processing Model.

**Existing Process Flow**

* Vendors send invoices through email.
* The bot monitors the mailbox and downloads invoice attachments.
* Invoices are received from 11 different vendors, each having different invoice formats/templates.
* An AI model extracts key invoice details such as:
    
  Vendor details, Invoice Number, Invoice Date, Purchase Order (PO) Number, Invoice Amount, Line Item Information
* Extracted data is stored in a SharePoint List for tracking.
* The bot reads the extracted data from SharePoint.
* Using UI automation, the bot logs into the AX Windows application.
* Invoice details are entered into AX and the invoice creation/posting process is completed.
* Processing status is updated for monitoring and reporting.

Business Requirement for D365

The business wants to eliminate the dependency on:

* AX Windows application
* Power Automate Desktop UI automation
* SharePoint-based intermediate processing and move to a D365 Invoice Capture based solution.

D365 Task :

* Vendor invoices are received through configured intake channels such as Email.
* D365 Invoice Capture automatically imports and processes incoming invoices.
* AI-powered extraction captures invoice header and line-item details.
* Extracted data is validated within D365 Invoice Capture.
* Purchase Order matching and business rule validations are performed directly in D365.
* Validated invoices are automatically created as Vendor Invoices in D365 Finance.
* Invoice approval, processing, and posting are managed within D365 without any UI automation.
* Users can track and monitor invoice status directly from D365 Finance.

Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance

D365 Finance Integration

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Overview:

### **Working at Atlassian India**

Atlassian's mission "to unleash the potential of every team" is the guiding light behind what we do. Our products, including Jira, Confluence and Bitbucket, help teams everywhere work better together, from NASA to Cochlear.

Our office is in Bengaluru, but eligible candidates can work remotely across India: from home, from an office, or somewhere in between. We call this TEAM Anywhere.

### **Your future team: KubePlat Team**

The KubePlat group in Core Engineering owns Atlassian's entire Kubernetes ecosystem. Every Atlassian cloud product, including Jira, Confluence, Loom and Rovo, runs on the clusters, platform services and deployment systems we build and operate. Our mission is to provide Atlassian a secure, reliable, cost-efficient and globally distributed compute platform, as the foundation for building great products.

What we own:

* **Kubernetes infrastructure:** hundreds of production clusters (EKS and GKE) across AWS, GCP and regulated cloud environments.
* **Fleet management:** automated, cloud-agnostic lifecycle management for clusters and platform components, with safe progressive rollouts.
* **Kubernetes Platform-as-a-Service:** an opinionated, multi-tenant platform for running Atlassian's microservices.
* **Cloud resource management:** self-serve, Kubernetes-driven provisioning of the cloud resources that services depend on.
* **Secure sandboxed compute:** strongly isolated environments for running untrusted code and AI-agent workloads.
* **Software delivery:** artifact management, deployment orchestration and automated verification for thousands of deployments every day.
* **AI/ML infrastructure:** the GPU compute, high-bandwidth networking and parallel filesystem ecosystem on Kubernetes that powers model training and AI inference behind Atlassian's AI features.

We are in the middle of a major transformation: moving to a multi-cloud, cell-based architecture, meeting FedRAMP and data-residency requirements, and building a reliable, cloud-native foundation for AI training and inference at scale.

Responsibilities:

As a Principal Engineer, you will set the technical direction for Atlassian's Kubernetes, compute and AI/ML infrastructure platform. You will lead engineers across several teams on our hardest problems, and take large, cross-team initiatives from design to launch.

### **What you'll do**

* Define the architecture and multi-year roadmap for a multi-cloud, cell-based Kubernetes fleet that scales to thousands of clusters.
* Design Kubernetes-native control planes (controllers, operators, CRDs and policy) that give engineers self-serve compute, networking and cloud resources.
* Raise platform reliability and security: reduce blast radius, build safe progressive rollouts, define SLOs, isolate workloads and support compliance (for example FedRAMP).
* Lead compute efficiency through autoscaling, bin packing, capacity planning and cost optimisation.
* Build the AI/ML infrastructure ecosystem on Kubernetes: GPU compute at scale, high-bandwidth, low-latency networking, and high-performance parallel filesystems for training and inference.
* Influence engineering and product leaders globally, set architectural standards, and mentor senior engineers.

Qualifications:

* 10+ years building and operating large-scale cloud infrastructure or platform-as-a-service systems.
* Deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise from running it in production at scale: internals, networking, multi-tenancy, and building operators and CRDs.
* Strong experience with AWS and/or GCP (EKS/GKE) and distributed systems design.
* Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java or similar.
* Platform engineering experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps/CD (for example Terraform, Crossplane, ArgoCD) and observability.
* A track record of leading technical direction across teams, with excellent communication and mentoring skills.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience with Kubernetes fleet management, cell-based architectures, sandboxing (gVisor, Firecracker) or regulated environments.
* Experience providing AI/ML infrastructure: GPU clusters, high-bandwidth networking (for example RDMA, InfiniBand, AWS EFA, GPUDirect) or parallel filesystems (for example Lustre, Amazon FSx for Lustre, GCP Parallelstore).
* Contributions to CNCF open-source projects.

title: Software Development Engineer - Tejas
description:
Enterprises want agents that can do real work on their own data. That data sits across documents, databases and business systems that were never built for agents to read, and today's agents forget most of what they learn once a session ends.

Our team builds Sarvam's context engine to solve both problems. The knowledge side brings an enterprise's data together so agents can search it, navigate it and cite where an answer came from. The memory side lets agents remember what they learn over time, about individual users, about teams, and across the organisation. We want both to keep improving as they are used.

Knowledge and memory for agents is a rapidly evolving field. We want to build at the frontier of it, and to show with measurable results that our approach does better than traditional ones.

**About Sarvam**
----------------

Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.

**What this role promises you**
-------------------------------

You will join a small team and own large parts of the platform. The work is driven by real customer deployments, so what you build gets used quickly and you see what works and what does not. You will also work closely with the teams building Sarvam's models, document AI and inference, which makes it much easier to solve problems that cut across the stack.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build and run the ingestion pipeline that parses, extracts and indexes large volumes of documents, and keep it reliable when files are messy and external services fail.
* Connect to databases and enterprise systems so agents can work with structured records as well as documents.
* Design how enterprise data is modelled, including the ontology, matching the same entity across sources, and tracing every value back to where it came from.
* Build the retrieval tools agents call, with search, filters and citations, and make them fast and cheap enough for agents to use heavily.
* Build memory for agents at the level of a user, a team and the whole organisation: how it is written, stored, retrieved and kept accurate over time.
* Run evals, find where answers go wrong, and keep iterating until quality improves.
* Work with product and forward-deployed engineers to turn what one customer needs into something the platform does for every customer.
* Write design docs and keep decisions documented.

Our production stack is Go, with Temporal, OpenSearch and Postgres.

**Who you are**
---------------

We are hiring at 3 to 5 years of experience.

* You have built and run backend or data systems in production, and you have fixed them when they broke.
* You are strong in at least one backend language. Our core is in Go, so Go experience is a plus, and you should be happy to work in it every day.
* You have good fundamentals in data modelling and PostgreSQL.
* You have worked on long-running pipelines and know how to make them safe to retry and recover.
* You have worked on search or retrieval and know how to debug why the right result did not come back.
* You use AI coding tools every day and have a good sense of where they help and where they don't.
* You care about measuring quality, and you are comfortable building the evals to do it.

**Bonus points**
----------------

* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution or structured extraction.
* Experience building memory for agents or LLM applications.
* Document processing, such as OCR, layout or table extraction.
* Connectors or change data capture for ERP, CRM or other enterprise systems.
* Building on MCP, or serving LLMs and embedding models in production.
* On-prem or air-gapped deployments.
* Experience at an early- or growth-stage startup.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Systems Software Engineer to join our team developing advanced validation and virtualization solutions used across Intel's product development lifecycle.

description:
Bangalore, Karnātaka, India IT Ref ID: JR-023480

**Our Mission**

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with 4+ years of software engineering experience to architect, build, and deploy custom Agentic AI applications integrated with our Salesforce ecosystem. In this role, you will bridge modern generative AI technologies (LLM orchestrations, autonomous agent loops, tool calling, and RAG) with enterprise CRM infrastructure. You will design autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents that execute complex, multi-step business workflows, interact directly with Salesforce data and APIs, and safely escalate to human teams when necessary.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Agentic Application Architecture:** Design, build, and maintain agentic solutions using tools like LangGraph, ADK, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI etc.
* **Salesforce Integration & Tool Calling:** Implement robust REST/SOAP integrations, Webhooks, Platform Events, and Apex Invocable Methods allowing AI agents to query SOQL, update CRM records, and trigger Salesforce Flows autonomously.
* **Context Grounding & RAG Pipelines:** Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines connecting vector stores (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) to supply real-time context to LLMs while mitigating hallucinations.
* **Workflow Automation & Agent Governance:** Define function calling schemas, tool definitions, dynamic planning loops, and fallbacks. Implement safety guardrails, prompt evaluation suites, rate limiting, and seamless human-in-the-loop (HITL) handoffs.
* **Observability & Reliability:** Set up agent monitoring, evaluation metrics, and tracing to track execution paths, latency, context usage, and token costs.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Partner with Salesforce Architects, Product Managers, and security teams to translate complex CRM requirements into reliable AI features adhering to enterprise compliance and data governance standards.

**Qualifications**

**Required Technical Skills & Qualifications**
----------------------------------------------

  
  

* **Software Engineering Foundation:** 3+ years of professional backend software engineering experience building scalable microservices, REST APIs, and asynchronous message queues.
* **Agentic AI & LLM Systems:** 2+ years of hands-on experience developing production AI agents, autonomous decision loops, multi-agent coordination, and function-calling/tool-use paradigms.
* **Salesforce Core Knowledge:** Proven experience interacting with Salesforce APIs (REST/Composite/Bulk), SOQL/SOSL queries, Connected Apps, OAuth flows, and Apex (Invocable Actions, Triggers).
* **Programming Languages:** Advanced proficiency in **Python** or **TypeScript/Node.js** for AI backend systems.
* **Vector Databases & Embeddings:** Direct experience with semantic search, embeddings generation, and vector engines (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, ChromaDB, PGVector).
* **Cloud & DevOps:** Proficiency in cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), serverless computing, and CI/CD pipelines.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Solid understanding of B2B Sales processes, Partner Relationship Management (PRM), and the end-to-end **Opportunity-to-Quote (Q2C) lifecycle**.
  

  

**The Team**
------------

You will be part of a growing, passionate, and dynamic team with an opportunity to work on challenging and exciting projects centered on what we believe is one of the most significant mission statements in the world. We also strive to be the most people-centric company ever!. That means we're constantly working to make your experience amazing, and you are part of the team breaking boundaries of what the workplace can be!.

**Our Commitment**

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

title: Software Engineer - Systems and Reliablity
description:
**Software Engineer – Systems & Reliability**
=============================================

**Smallest.ai** **| Bangalore**

**About The Role**
------------------

Own a service or a part of our product from design through production. You’ll write the code, validate its behaviour, deploy it and keep it reliable for the customers who depend on it.

Testing, deployment and operations are part of engineering ownership here. You’ll work with the team, but you won’t hand off responsibility when your code is merged.

Our systems power real-time voice, where an extra 100 milliseconds can change how a conversation feels. Behind that experience are GPU inference workloads for text-to-speech and speech recognition across AWS regions, alongside multi-tenant APIs, concurrency controls, billing and webhooks.

We work with Python, TypeScript and Go on Kubernetes in AWS, supported by Redis, MongoDB-compatible stores, Postgres, ClickHouse, RabbitMQ and Temporal. Familiarity helps; understanding the mechanisms underneath matters more.

**What you’ll own**
-------------------

* **Define success before building.** Establish measurable service-level objectives for customer-facing latency, availability and correctness.
* **Write maintainable code.** Build systems another engineer can understand, debug and operate without depending on you being available.
* **Test beyond the happy path.** Use unit, integration, load and fault-injection testing to validate behaviour under realistic conditions. Explain your coverage and its limitations in review.
* **Ship safely.** Own CI, deployments, rollbacks, schema migrations and infrastructure changes. When your work requires a Terraform change, you own that too.
* **Operate what you build.** Create useful dashboards, actionable alerts and runbooks. Participate in on-call, incident response and postmortems.
* **Stay close to customer impact.** When calls drop or requests fail, investigate directly, communicate clearly and drive the issue to resolution.
* **Improve the system around the problem.** Turn recurring incidents and manual debugging into better controls, automation and tooling.

**The challenges you’ll help solve**
------------------------------------

Our product works, and we’re strengthening the reliability practices that support its next stage of growth.

* Define SLOs for services that do not yet have clear reliability targets.
* Replace misleading health signals with monitoring that reflects whether customers can complete their tasks.
* Improve logging, health checks and alerting so failures are easier to detect and diagnose.
* Make testing and operational readiness a consistent part of delivery.
* Address existing reliability gaps alongside new product development.

You’ll fix problems you didn’t introduce and make decisions with incomplete information. You’ll also be expected to balance delivery speed with production readiness: surface risks early, propose practical trade-offs and follow through on commitments.

**What we look for**
--------------------

Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to apply them to unfamiliar problems. We assess these directly through technical discussion and practical reasoning.

You should be comfortable explaining and reasoning about:

* **Processes and operating systems:** Process creation, signals, file descriptors, namespaces, cgroups, PID 1 behaviour and CPU throttling.
* **Memory:** Virtual memory, page cache, available memory, swap, cgroup memory limits, out-of-memory behaviour and stalls that occur despite low CPU utilisation.
* **Files and storage:** Inodes, durability and fsync, disk-usage discrepancies, atomic rename, IOPS and throughput.
* **Networking:** TCP states, TIME\_WAIT, connection and read timeouts, Nagle’s algorithm, delayed acknowledgements, DNS, TLS, NAT and the trade-offs of UDP for real-time media.
* **Concurrency and distributed systems:** Race conditions, locks, idempotency, at-least-once delivery, retries, backoff, jitter, backpressure, clocks and partial failures.
* **Language runtimes:** Event loops, blocking operations, garbage collection, the Python GIL, memory leaks and algorithmic costs at production scale.
* **Data systems:** Indexes, query plans, transaction isolation, row and column stores, and replication lag.
* **Reliability:** SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, latency percentiles, why percentiles cannot simply be averaged, and alerting on customer-visible symptoms.

We also value clear writing, the patience to read unfamiliar code and the habit of measuring before drawing conclusions.

We evaluate demonstrated ability rather than years of experience, previous titles, employers, degrees, colleges, certifications or the number of frameworks on your résumé.

**How we work**
---------------

* **Be honest about what you know.** “I don’t know” is useful when followed by a clear approach to finding out.
* **Share hypotheses early.** Make your reasoning visible, invite scrutiny and update your view when the evidence changes.
* **Take responsibility and improve the mechanism.** Our postmortems focus on contributing causes and concrete changes that prevent recurrence.
* **Start with the customer’s experience.** A healthy pod does not mean a successful call. If the caller hears silence, we investigate it as a failure.
* **Use evidence.** Reach for traces, packet captures, profilers, query plans and load tests to understand what is happening.
* **Challenge ideas respectfully.** Question decisions—including those made by founders—with clear reasoning and evidence.
* **Automate repeated work.** When a problem keeps returning, build a better way to detect, diagnose or resolve it.
* **Move with urgency.** Make decisions at the right level, act on reversible steps and communicate blockers early. Use meetings when they help resolve a decision.
* **Hold yourself to the standard you expect from others.** Give direct, constructive feedback and receive it with the same openness.

**What to expect**
------------------

This is a hands-on role with substantial accountability. It includes on-call responsibilities, occasional incidents outside regular hours, customer escalations and debugging across systems you may not have built.

You’ll do well here if you enjoy understanding how systems work, acting quickly and staying with a problem until it is resolved.

This role may not suit you if you prefer narrowly defined implementation tasks, consider your responsibility complete at merge, or expect testing and production operations to sit entirely with another team.

**Why join** **Smallest.ai**
----------------------------

Build systems where engineering decisions are audible in the customer experience. You’ll work across real-time voice, GPU inference and distributed infrastructure, with the opportunity to improve both the product and how we build and operate it.

Your impact will show up in faster responses, fewer failed calls, safer releases and systems the whole team can trust.

-----------------

When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.

As a Customer Engineer (CE) for Google Cloud Security, you serve as the technical bridge between our most innovative security technologies and our customers' most complex business challenges. You are not just a technical advisor; you are a strategic partner to the Sales team, responsible for articulating the unique value proposition of Google Cloud’s security ecosystem.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

--------------------

* Act as the primary technical advisor, partnering with Sales to build and execute account strategies that win trust and drive adoption of Google Cloud Security solutions.
* Design creative, scalable, and resilient security architectures that map directly to our customers’ specific business goals and operational challenges.
* Lead technical validations, including Proofs of Concept (PoC) and technical deep-dives, proactively identify and remove roadblocks to ensure project success.
* Serve as an expert storyteller who can translate complex cybersecurity concepts into compelling, practical business outcomes for both technical practitioners and executive stakeholders.

You will be participating in all facets of Software Development and / or Software Sustaining, using knowledge and experience analyzing complex problems and devising creative solutions. Promotes proper engineering discipline and drives momentum within the project team. Consults with other teams on topics related to areas of expertise.

**WHY JOIN US**

Be at the helm of global supply chain strategy, driving decisions that impact customers, partners, and communities worldwide.

Work with the latest in AI, automation, and digital supply chain platforms to solve complex challenges.

title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
description:
Req ID: 63818

Job Function: Software Engineering

Posting Start Date: 21/10/2026

Posting End Date: 28/10/2026

Division: BT International

Job Location: IND-Bengaluru-RMZ Ecoworld

Advertised Salary: Competitive

**Accountabilities**

  

* **Own Service Management Engineering** : Lead the end-to-end engineering, integration, and evolution of ITSM, ITOM, Order Management, and Managed Services platforms for BTI, driving business process improvement, end-to-end process optimisation, and service workflow simplification to eliminate inefficiencies, reduce complexity & improve operational effectiveness.

* **Drive Service Delivery and Assurance** : Engineer integrated service capabilities that improve end-to-end service visibility, fulfilment, monitoring, incident management, problem resolution, and service restoration, delivering a more seamless and reliable customer experience.

* **Deliver Customer and Service Migrations** : Own technical solution design and engineering delivery for customer and service migrations, ensuring migration readiness, data and integration integrity, operational acceptance, and minimal customer disruption.

* **Embed SAFe and Agile Engineering Delivery** : Partner with Service, Product, Architecture, and Engineering teams across Agile Release Trains to translate business priorities into service enablers, solution increments, and release plans. Drive alignment across teams, manage dependencies, and accelerate value realisation through iterative delivery.

* **Accelerate AI-led Service Transformation** : Drive the adoption and industrialisation of AI, intelligent automation, and predictive service capabilities through OpsFabric. Enable proactive fault detection, intelligent incident triage, faster diagnosis and resolution, reduced manual effort, and improved customer and operational experiences.

* **Drive Service Landscape Simplification** : Lead engineering initiatives leveraging BTI AI solutions to simplify and modernise the Customer Experience (CX) and Service IT landscape, rationalising platforms, reducing duplication and technical debt, streamlining processes, improving agility & cost efficiency.

* **Ensure Engineering Excellence and Platform Resilience** : Establish and enforce engineering standards across architecture, APIs, integrations, security, observability, testing, release management, and operational readiness. Drive improvements in availability, scalability, performance, recoverability, and technical quality.

* **Own In-life Engineering Governance** : Provide clear accountability for the technical management and communication of production incidents, problems, and production releases (PRs). Coordinate stakeholders, manage risks and escalations, drive root-cause resolution, and ensure timely, transparent communications and effective service restoration.

* **Strengthen Cross-functional Leadership** : Build strong partnerships across BTI, BT UK, Service Operations, Product, Architecture, Cyber Security, and delivery partners to align priorities, resolve blockers, manage dependencies, and maintain accountability for outcomes.

* **Drive Continuous Improvement and Operational Automation** : Identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive activities, optimise service processes, improve engineering productivity, and shift from reactive support towards proactive, data-driven service management

* **Measure and Deliver Business Outcomes** : Define and track engineering and service KPIs, including customer experience, service availability, incident resolution, migration success, release quality, automation adoption, platform performance, and cost-to-serve. Use insights to prioritise investments and demonstrate measurable business value.

* **TSA/RTSA Engineering Dependencies** : Manage technical dependencies on BT UK-owned service tools under TSA and enable BT UK journeys through BTI-owned platforms under RTSA, ensuring continuity, clear ownership, effective risk management, and delivery against transition commitments for Service Ops.

**Skills Require** d

  

This role requires a doer who can think strategically, engineer pragmatically, collaborate across boundaries, and deliver relentlessly - connecting technology, process, people, and AI to create a simpler, smarter, and more reliable service experience for Telco B2B customers.

  

* **Technically credible** : Understands the technology deeply enough to challenge designs, guide engineering decisions, and help solve complex problems hands-on.

* **Business outcome focused** : Understands that technology is an enabler and consistently looks for ways to improve customer experience, simplify processes, and deliver measurable value.

* **Execution oriented** : Uses SAFe and Agile practices pragmatically to align teams, manage dependencies, overcome blockers, and get solutions into production.

* **Change agent** : Is curious, proactive, resilient, and willing to challenge the status quo—turning emerging technology, particularly AI, into practical improvements in how services are delivered and assured.

**The skills you’ll need to succeed:**

* **Technology & Engineering Expertise:** Strong knowledge of ITSM, ITOM, Order Management, and Managed Services platforms, modern architecture, APIs, cloud, integration, DevSecOps, and platform reliability, with the ability to translate business needs into robust, scalable engineering solutions.

* **AI, Innovation & Process Transformation:** Understanding of AI, GenAI, AIOps, intelligent automation, and predictive analytics, with the ability to apply emerging technologies to simplify business processes, optimise service workflows, and improve customer experience and operational efficiency.

* **Execution Excellence & SAFe Delivery:** Practical experience with SAFe and Agile delivery, translating strategy into executable roadmaps and backlogs, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing dependencies, and driving solutions from design through production.

* **Hands-on Engineering & Problem Solving:** A proactive, go-getter mindset with strong analytical and troubleshooting skills; willing to get into technical detail, challenge the status quo, remove blockers, and take end-to-end ownership of outcomes.

* **Collaboration & Stakeholder Leadership:** Ability to work across Product, Service, Architecture, Engineering, BTI, and BT UK teams, influence without authority, manage complex dependencies, and communicate technical issues and decisions clearly.

* **Service Reliability, Governance & Continuous Improvement:** Strong understanding of service assurance, incident and problem management, production releases, operational resilience, security, and risk management, with a focus on improving service quality and reducing recurring issues.

* **Business Outcomes & Delivery Accountability:** Track record of delivering measurable improvements in customer experience, service availability, migration success, automation, engineering productivity, and cost efficiency, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term technology strategy.

* **The defining ethos:** Think like a product owner, engineer like a technologist, deliver like an Agile team, and measure success through customer and business outcomes. Treat Service Management platforms not simply as tools to maintain, but as products to continuously evolve - using engineering, data, and AI to make services smarter, simpler, and more customer-centric

**Experience Required**

  

A track record of combining hands-on engineering credibility, product ownership, and operational accountability - using SAFe to mobilise teams and AI to improve service outcomes, while maintaining consistently strong service levels.

* Service Management Technology & Architecture
* AI, GenAI & Intelligent Automation
* Business Process Optimisation & CX Improvement
* SAFe, Agile Delivery & Backlog Prioritisation
* Hands-on Engineering & Technical Problem Solving
* Service Level Management & Operational Resilience
* End-to-End Solution Integration & Migration
* DevSecOps, CI/CD & Engineering Excellence
* Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Leadership
* Outcome Ownership & Data-driven Decision-making
* Continuous Improvement & Technology Simplification
* Proactive Leadership, Accountability & Execution
* Product Engineering & Platform Ownership

**Leadership accountabilities**

  

**Leading inclusively and safely**

* Build an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture where Product, Service, and Engineering teams are empowered to contribute, challenge ideas, and deliver their best work.
* Embed security, resilience, quality, and operational risk management into engineering decisions, ensuring innovation does not compromise service levels or customer trust.
  

**Owning outcomes**

* Take end-to-end accountability for Service Management product roadmaps, engineering delivery, platform performance, and service levels.
* Translate customer and business priorities into measurable outcomes, balancing continuous innovation with service stability, reliability, and operational excellence.
* Proactively manage risks, dependencies, and escalations across BTI, BT UK, and partner teams, ensuring commitments are delivered and issues resolved.

**Growth mindset**

* Champion continuous learning, experimentation, and adoption of emerging technologies, particularly AI and intelligent automation, to improve customer experience and service performance.
* Encourage teams to challenge the status quo, learn from failures, simplify processes, and continuously improve engineering practices and service outcomes.

**Customer first**

* Champion customer needs throughout the product engineering lifecycle, using customer feedback, service insights, and operational data to identify opportunities to improve CX.
* Drive seamless, proactive, and differentiated service experiences, ensuring engineering priorities deliver tangible improvements in service quality, responsiveness, and customer satisfaction.

**Collaborating for impact**

* Bring Product, Service, Architecture, and Engineering teams together through SAFe to align priorities, manage dependencies, and accelerate delivery of shared outcomes.
* Build strong partnerships across BTI and BT UK, fostering transparency, constructive challenge, and collective accountability for service performance and transformation.

**Driving innovation and simplification**

* Lead the evolution towards a product-led Service Management engineering organisation, with clear platform ownership, roadmaps, reusable capabilities, and continuous delivery.
* Drive AI-led transformation, automation, and service landscape simplification to reduce complexity, improve productivity, and make service experience a competitive differentiator.

**Delivering through others**

* Set clear direction, empower teams to make decisions, and establish accountability for engineering quality, delivery commitments, and service outcomes.
* Combine strategic leadership with a hands-on approach to problem-solving, removing blockers and enabling teams to deliver reliable services and sustained business value.

**Key decisions**

  

**Recommend (R):** Develop engineering options, roadmaps, technical solutions, and investment proposals.

**Agree (A):** Obtain mandatory agreement from relevant Architecture, Security, Risk, Service, or commercial authorities where required.

**Perform (P):** Lead or coordinate engineering teams to implement approved decisions and deliver outcomes.

**Input (I):** Consult Product, Service Operations, BT UK, and other stakeholders affected by the decision.

**Decide (D):** Make final decisions within the role’s delegated authority; escalate material business, funding, contractual, or risk exceptions to the designated decision-maker.

**Being trusted: Our code**

  

Compliance with all BT Group policies is mandatory and applies to all BT Group employees. Policies can be accessed via the Policy Portal and should be adhered to in-line with Standards of Behaviour Policy & Procedure and the Being trusted: our code .

**About the role**
------------------

The Senior Software Engineering Manager oversees software engineering activities, shaping the strategic direction of the software engineering practice to deliver the roadmap that supports BT's commercial strategy through cross functional business partnering.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

1. Leads engineering teams critical to the organisation's performance through the delivery of high-quality code within time and budget standards/requirements
  
2. Mentors, coaches, and manages several teams to develop current and future team capabilities and ensure performance in delivering the most impactful features to both internal and external users of the BT team
  
3. Leads the team in adopting relevant new technologies, tools, methods and processes that progressively advances service capabilities to its different stakeholders
  
4. Ensures timely releases from teams by overseeing compliance with key release quality metrics
  
5. Operates as an SME within own field of expertise, driving technical decisions, technology choices and contributes to group level discussion around architecture for a wide range of high performance products, capabilities, and platforms, effectively balancing short-term impact with long-term transformation
  
6. Oversees the team in developing an ambitious and compelling technical roadmap to meet the needs of the business, engineering organisation and defined technology strategy
  
7. Oversees engineering and operational excellence initiatives, implementing metrics and processes for regular assessment and improvement through the implementation of processes and tools supporting multiple platforms
  
8. Ensures team standards of engineering and operational excellence are upheld, establishing metrics and processes for regular assessment and improvement through the creation and implementation of processes and tools supporting multiple platforms
  
9. Drives an engineering culture that supports innovation and creativity while delivering high quality products with predictability and reliability
  
10. Builds 'best-in-class' engineering for services by ensuring that the services and the components are well-defined and modularised, secure, reliable, diagnosable, actively monitored and reusable
  
11. Leads the evaluation and implementation of high-quality tools and automation processes to support continuous delivery and developer productivity
  
12. Ensures the development and adoption of a DevOps mindset across the engineering teams
  
13. Leads the implementation of continuous improvement opportunities to improve the software engineering team processes

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

**Our Package**
---------------

At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens.

The ideal candidate is a strong engineering leader who can build high-performing teams, drive technical execution, and work closely with Data Science and AI teams to productionize intelligent capabilities.

* Partner with Product Management, Principal Engineers, and Architects to define technical strategy, architecture, and execution priorities aligned with product and customer requirements.

ClusterWareAI enables automated provisioning, orchestration, monitoring, and lifecycle management of large-scale AI infrastructure. In this role, you will define and drive the quality strategy for a complex distributed platform spanning GPU infrastructure, compute, networking, storage, Kubernetes, workload orchestration, and AI-enabled operations.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will lead and develop a Quality Engineering team while partnering closely with Software Engineering, Product Management, Platform Engineering, DevOps, Support, and Systems Integration teams to build quality into every stage of the product lifecycle.

The ideal candidate brings a strong product-engineering mindset, deep experience with test automation and distributed systems, and a passion for delivering reliable cloud and infrastructure software at scale.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end Quality Engineering strategy for ClusterWareAI across functional, integration, system, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and resilience testing.

* Define test strategies for GPU infrastructure, bare metal, Kubernetes, networking, storage, workload orchestration, and distributed systems at scale.
* Validate infrastructure lifecycle workflows including provisioning, configuration, upgrades, rollback, deprovisioning, monitoring, health management, and automated remediation.

**AI / Agentic Quality Engineering**

* Own the AI Quality Engineering strategy for ClusterWareAI's AI Platform capabilities.

* Test RAG, tool calling, multi-step agents, planning/execution, agent collaboration, memory, and infrastructure-aware reasoning.
* Develop AI regression pipelines to detect degradation caused by changes to models, prompts, agents, tools, knowledge sources, and orchestration logic.

* Validate agent guardrails, policy enforcement, approvals, authorization boundaries, tenant isolation, auditability, and human-in-the-loop controls.

Teams at the Ecolab Digital Centre will work collaboratively with Ecolab IT & Commercial Digital Solutions associates around the world on cutting edge digital innovation to accelerate growth around key initiatives in analytics, application development and digital development.

**Overview**

Ecolab is looking for a Sr. Software Engineer to join its Record to Report technology support team. This position will enhance, maintain and support business application platforms.

The Software Engineer will apply engineering and programming best practices to deliver and enhance software solutions that meet business needs.

Designs, codes, tests, debugs and documents those solutions. Works directly with peers in digital technology organization as well as with business associates on projects and support. Self-motivated professional, able to function independently and within a team structure

title: Principal Software Engineer, AI Platforms
description:
**Job ID** 2026-19314 **Date posted** Oct. 19, 2026 **Location** Bengaluru, India **Category** Software Engineering

  

We are hiring a Principal Software Engineer for Arm's AI Platforms team in Bangalore. You will help shape technical direction, build production software, and establish the engineering practices of a growing team. Working with the Director of Engineering and technical leaders across Arm, you will take responsibility for significant platform capabilities and remain closely involved in their implementation.

We are looking for an exemplary practitioner whose code, technical decisions, and approach to difficult problems set the standard for the team. You will combine systems engineering depth with hands-on expertise in agentic AI across the software development lifecycle (SDLC), helping engineers embrace new methods and assess their effect on delivery and quality.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Define technical direction with engineering leadership. Assess platform needs, explore design options, and turn decisions into software the team can deliver and operate.
* Design and implement distributed platform services. Write critical code, review implementations, and rapid prototyping to test uncertain assumptions before committing to a design.
* Shape the engineering culture through daily practice. Help the team deliver frequent changes with clear ownership, useful design and code reviews, and verification appropriate to the software being built.
* Build and use agentic AI workflows across the SDLC. Give agents useful project context, connect them to development tools, and establish feedback through tests and code review. Measure their effect on delivery speed and software quality.
* Keep current with developments in software engineering, AI development tools, and cloud systems. Evaluate promising approaches through hands-on experiments and adopt them when the results justify the change.
* Resolve difficult design and production problems involving concurrency, data consistency, performance, and failure recovery. Use what you learn to improve the architecture and the team's engineering practices.
* Help recruit staff and senior engineers, and develop their judgment through shared technical work. Support engineers in taking ownership of complete capabilities and working through unfamiliar problems.
* Partner with Arm teams in the US and UK on architecture and shared interfaces. Make technical decisions understandable and establish clear ownership across teams.

**Required skills and experience**
==================================

* 12+ years building distributed software, cloud platforms, or production infrastructure, or equivalent experience demonstrated through the scope and impact of your work.
* Strong programming skills in Go, C++, Rust, Python, or a comparable language. Experience designing service interfaces, working with concurrency and persistent data, and debugging complex failures.
* Experience building and operating software on Kubernetes and Linux, with an understanding of workload lifecycle, networking, resource management, and failure recovery.
* Hands-on expertise with agentic AI tools and harnesses for the SDLC. Experience configuring and extending workflows, assessing generated code, and verifying changes through automated checks and engineering review.
* A record of technical leadership grounded in your own engineering work, including mentoring experienced engineers, explaining design choices, and improving how a team develops software.

**Preferred skills and experience**
===================================

* Experience with AI inference infrastructure or model serving, including how workload and hardware choices affect latency, throughput, and resource use. Knowledge of inference performance and resource-efficiency considerations.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch, Ray, vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or Dynamo or experience qualifying accelerators and tuning distributed workloads.
* Kubernetes controllers or operators, deployment systems, or software that manages releases across different compute environments.
* Developer productivity tools, build and test infrastructure for large scale distributed systems.
* Distributed tracing, observability, diagnostics, or data processing systems used to understand production behavior.

**In Return:**
--------------

We provide an opportunity to learn about the latest Arm architecture features, working closely with a highly skilled engineering team on ground-breaking technology!

**Our 10x Mindset**
-------------------

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https://careers.arm.com/10x-mindset (opens in new window)

**Use of AI in Your Application**
---------------------------------

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm.com so we can support you.

**Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations**
----------------------------------------------

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm.com. To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process.

**Hybrid Working**
------------------

Arm’s approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team’s needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you.

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don’t discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: POWER PLATFORM & COPILOT DEVELOPER
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

**Role Summary**

The **Power Platform & Copilot Developer** leads the design, delivery, and scaling of **enterprise AI chatbot and low‑code solutions** using **Microsoft Copilot Studio and the Microsoft Power Platform** to support **LCS strategic business use cases** . This role serves as a **technical and functional lead** , providing architectural guidance, governance oversight, and mentorship while ensuring measurable business outcomes from AI investments.

The role partners closely with business leaders, AI governance teams, and platform stakeholders to establish a **scalable, governed low‑code AI operating model** , build Copilot Studio subject‑matter expertise (SME), and drive adoption across LCS.

We are hiring for Pune, Noida and Bangalore location.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI & Copilot Technical Leadership**

* Lead the **end‑to‑end architecture, design, and delivery** of Copilot Studio solutions and AI chatbots
* Define conversational AI patterns, standards, and reusable frameworks for enterprise adoption
* Review and approve solution designs to ensure scalability, performance, and maintainability
* Drive continuous improvement of AI agents based on usage analytics, feedback, and business outcomes

**Power Platform Solution Architecture**

* Lead development of complex **Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse solutions** supporting Copilot use cases
* Establish best practices for low‑code / pro‑code extensibility, integrations, and APIs
* Ensure alignment with enterprise application architecture and data strategies

**Governance, Security & Compliance**

* Own and enforce **governance standards** for Copilot and Power Platform solutions
* Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure Responsible AI, data protection, and audit readiness
* Guide environment strategy, DLP policies, access controls, and solution lifecycle management

**Capability Building & Team Enablement**

* Act as a **Copilot Studio SME and mentor** , cross‑training Power App developers into AI solution builders
* Support hiring, onboarding, and enablement of incremental Copilot development capacity
* Contribute to a **Center of Excellence / RCC delivery model** , defining intake, prioritization, KPIs, and capacity planning

**Stakeholder & Program Leadership**

* Partner with business owners and AI leadership to identify, prioritize, and roadmap high‑value AI use cases
* Provide executive‑level updates on progress, risks, ROI, and adoption metrics
* Represent the Copilot low‑code capability in enterprise forums (e.g., AI2)

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Advanced hands‑on experience with **Microsoft Power Platform** (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse)
* Strong experience designing and delivering solutions using **Microsoft Copilot Studio**
* Proven experience leading **enterprise‑scale low‑code or AI initiatives**
* Strong understanding of **conversational AI design, UX, and performance optimization**
* Experience with governance, security, and compliance in regulated enterprise environments
* Strong leadership, mentoring, and stakeholder‑management skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft certifications (Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Azure AI)
* Experience operating within a **Center of Excellence (CoE) or shared services model**
* Experience defining and tracking **KPIs, ROI, and adoption metrics** for AI solutions
* Familiarity with change management and enterprise adoption strategies

**Success Measures**

* Successful delivery of high‑impact LCS AI chatbot use cases
* Adoption and reuse of standardized Copilot solutions across teams
* Establishment and growth of Copilot Studio SME capability
* Compliance with enterprise governance and Responsible AI standards
* Demonstrated ROI and measurable business value from AI initiatives
  

  

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have:**

* 2 to 8 years of relatable work experience in a fast-paced business environment
* Strong troubleshooting and technical support skills.
* Experience maintaining project documentation and managing system updates.
* Excellent stakeholder communication and relationship-building abilities.
* Familiarity with data governance and compliance standards.
* Skilled in creating engaging content and presentations.
* Comfortable with multi-channel communication platforms.
  

  
  

**What We Offer:**

Our benefits package includes …

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On-demand digital course library for professional development

... and other local benefits!

*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*

description:

**About the Role**

Position Title : Lead Software Engineer

Corporate Title: AVP (Internal: AVP)

Reporting to : VP

Location: MGS - Bengaluru

  

**Job Profile**

**Position details**

The AVP, Lead Software Engineer will apply hands-on technical knowledge across data integration, database engineering, scripting, cloud-based data services, and AI-enabled solutions. The role is to help design secure, scalable Generative AI capabilities, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), enterprise knowledge bases, semantic search, and document intelligence solutions.

The successful candidate will combine strong engineering fundamentals with analytical thinking, iterative problem-solving, stakeholder management, and a risk-aware approach. The individual will translate business and technical requirements into reliable solutions, guide development teams, and deliver against milestones in a regulated financial-services environment. In the process, you will have exciting opportunities to develop your skills, expand your network, and build your career.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, enhance, and maintain complex ETL mappings, workflows, data pipelines, and UNIX/Linux shell scripts in enterprise data warehouse and data lake environments

* Build and optimize batch, real-time, and near-real-time integrations using IDMC or comparable integration technologies

* Develop advanced SQL and database solutions across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or comparable relational platforms, including performance tuning and data-quality controls

* Contribute to dimensional, canonical, and integration data models, and support data warehouses and data marts

* Build reusable Python, Java, or scripting components for data processing, orchestration, validation, automation, and operational support

* Design and build enterprise RAG solutions that retrieve trusted content and provide grounded responses using large language models

* Create and maintain knowledge ingestion pipelines covering document parsing, chunking, metadata enrichment, embedding generation, indexing, retrieval, and citation or source traceability

* Work with vector databases and semantic-search technologies such as Amazon OpenSearch, PostgreSQL with pgvector, or equivalent platforms

* Apply prompt engineering, hybrid search, reranking, context management, and retrieval evaluation techniques to improve answer relevance and reduce unsupported responses

* Build AI-enabled document intelligence solutions for extracting, classifying, summarizing, and validating information from structured and unstructured content

* Establish evaluation approaches for RAG and Generative AI solutions, including retrieval quality, answer groundedness, accuracy, latency, cost, and regression testing

* Implement responsible AI and model-risk controls, including data privacy, access control, content safety, human review, auditability, monitoring, and secure handling of confidential information

* Partner with architecture, security, data governance, model risk, legal/compliance, and business teams to move AI proofs of concept into supportable production services

* Design and support cloud-based data and AI solutions using relevant AWS services such as S3, RDS/Aurora, Redshift, Glue, Athena, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, Kinesis, EMR, Textract, Bedrock, SageMaker, OpenSearch, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager

* Design and deliver conversational “chat with data” solutions for banking use cases, enabling users to query governed structured and unstructured data through natural-language interfaces with appropriate access controls, source traceability, validation, and safeguards against unsupported responses

* Build resilient, observable, and cost-conscious architectures using infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, automated testing, logging, metrics, and alerting

* Apply secure cloud engineering patterns for network connectivity, encryption, secrets, least-privilege access, service integration, and operational recovery

* Provide technical knowledge and understandings across design, development, testing, implementation, release, and production-support activities

* Create and review functional designs, detailed technical designs, data mappings, interface specifications, runbooks, and operational documentation

* Gather and document business requirements, assess current technology and processes, and recommend practical target-state solutions

* Coordinate with IT leads, developers, testers, operations, and business stakeholders to ensure deliverables meet functional, non-functional, security, and control expectations

* Participate in production rollouts using change-control processes, clear documentation, stakeholder communication, and implementation validation

* Resolve production defects and incidents within defined service-level expectations; lead root-cause analysis and preventive remediation

* Mentor engineers, promote engineering standards, conduct design and code reviews, and encourage reusable patterns and continuous improvement

**Job Requirements:**

Bachelors’ Degree (or foreign equivalent degree) in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Experience in the financial services or banking industry is preferred.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 10-15 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, ETL, databases, SQL, and UNIX/Linux environments

* 8+ years of data integration experience in a lead or senior engineering role, preferably within banking or financial services

* 6+ years of hands-on experience working as a Data Engineer, designing, developing, and supporting scalable data pipelines and data-processing solutions using AWS services

* 8+ years of experience with IDMC or a comparable enterprise ETL/data-integration platform, including batch and real-time or near-real-time patterns.

* 5+ years of hands-on programming or scripting experience using Python, Java, or a comparable language

* Strong experience with one or more relational database platforms and advanced SQL, including performance tuning and troubleshooting

* Working knowledge of AWS data, integration, security, and serverless services

* Demonstrated understanding of Generative AI concepts, embeddings, vector search, RAG architecture, knowledge bases, prompt engineering, and LLM integration patterns

* Experience producing technical designs and leading delivery through development, testing, release, and production support

* Hands-on experience delivering a RAG, semantic-search, conversational AI, or enterprise knowledge-base solution from proof of concept through production

* Experience with Amazon Bedrock knowledge bases or agents, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon OpenSearch, PostgreSQL/pgvector, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or comparable frameworks and platforms

* Experience with document-processing services and libraries, including OCR, layout-aware extraction, chunking, metadata management, and source citation

* Knowledge of LLMOps/MLOps practices, including prompt and model versioning, automated evaluation, observability, feedback loops, performance monitoring, and cost controls

* Understanding of data governance, AI governance, model risk, privacy, security, and regulatory expectations relevant to financial services

* Experience with ER/Studio, JIRA, enterprise schedulers such as Autosys, and Agile/Waterfall delivery methods

* Experience with Big Data and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, Hive, Kinesis, or EMR

* Experience with Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool and CI/CD pipelines

* Strong communication, facilitation, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills

**Position Details**

• **Function/Department:** Technology
  
• **Location:** Bengaluru

**Position Summary:**

Chubb is seeking an experienced Virtualization Engineer to join our growing Global Hypervisor chapter, providing support for VMware vSphere environments servicing both Virtual Servers (VSI) and Virtual Desktop (VDI) systems. The Virtualization Engineer would require a minimum of 5+ years of directly related experience supporting VMware vSphere environments.

Seeking motivated technical professionals who specialize in providing support for enterprise level VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF/vSphere) infrastructure and related services, focusing on stability and performance. The position holder will be primarily focused on performing operational functions of Chubb’s Virtual Infrastructure environment; activities include but not limited to the support and maintenance of multiple VCF & vCenter environments, monitoring, alerting, availability, VM resource and performance management.

**Primary Job Responsibilities:**

* Investigation and diagnosis of incidents and problems relating to VMware Cloud Foundation
    
  (VCF), Aria/vRealize Suite, and vSphere Infrastructure and Virtual Machines.
* Analyze, authorize, and implement VM resource (Compute and Storage) requests.
* Participate in a follow the sun operational model supporting and maintaining the VMware Virtual Infrastructure.
* Provide on-call and after-hours support to address incidents, maintain infrastructure and support operational efforts.
* Provide training and mentorship to junior team members. Train team members in best practices and act as subject matter expert and escalation contact for infrastructure related issues.
* Proactively ensure the highest levels of systems and infrastructure availability. Perform daily system monitoring, verifying the integrity and availability of systems and key processes, reviewing system and application logs.
* Define, monitor and enforce the capacity and performance standards, metrics and thresholds and help build the instrumentation to effectively manage the environment.
* Work closely with network, security, development, application and support teams in the implementation of infrastructure components that support emerging technologies and applications.
* Automate operational, monitoring, and integrity verification processes (e.g., runbooks) for hardware, server, and system resources and processes.
* Implement common preventive maintenance practices for Dell PowerEdge hardware and VMware software suites.
* Ensure that system improvements and changes are implemented and monitor effects of the modifications.
* Help Identify and manage risks within the Virtual Infrastructure.
* Produce and maintain operational documentation, understanding and tools to effectively manage the VMware Cloud Foundation, vRealize (Aria) Suite, and vSphere platform.
* Participate in change, incident, and problem management.

  

**Qualification or Required Skills** **:**

* Extensive and recent support and engineering experience in hardware, operating systems, storage, and virtualization technologies in a global multi-data center enterprise organization.
* Advanced knowledge and experience with VMware hypervisors (VMware vSphere 7.x, 8.x) and VMware Cloud Foundation.
* Advanced knowledge and experience with server hardware architecture, configuration, and troubleshooting Cisco UCS and Dell PowerEdge MX infrastructure.
* Working knowledge and experience with VMware NSX and Aria (vRealize) Suite, including Aria Operations (vROPS), Aria Operations for Logs (Log Insight), and Aria Automation (vRA).
* Strong critical thinking and problem-solving, and the ability to debug complex-cross systems problems, and document root cause including remediation and detection.
* Demonstrates knowledge of a broad range of technology towers i.e.: Storage, Virtualization, Intel, Networking, Data Center Migration and Disaster Recovery
* Knowledge and experience with Windows server operating systems (Windows 2019, 2022).
* Knowledge of risk and controls landscape, ensuring company-wide standards are met.
* Fundamental understanding of network security practices
* Have hands on experience with PowerShell or Python and APIs
* Ability to collaborate with different technology towers to achieve common goals.
* Ability to manage multiple streams of work simultaneously.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Why Chubb?**  
Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!
  
Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.
  
• Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
  
• A Great Place to work: Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work® for the years 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026
  
• Laser focus on excellence: At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
  
• Start-Up Culture: Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
  
• Growth and success: As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment

**Employee Benefits**  
Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. Our benefits include:
  
• **Savings and Investment plans:** We provide specialized benefits like Corporate NPS (National Pension Scheme), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), Retiral Benefits and Car Lease that help employees optimally plan their finances
  
• **Upskilling and career growth opportunities:** With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customized programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs.
  
• **Health and Welfare Benefits:** We care about our employees’ well-being in and out of work and have benefits like Hybrid Work Environment, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Yearly Free Health campaigns and comprehensive Insurance benefits.

**Application Process**  
Our recruitment process is designed to be transparent, and inclusive.

• Step 2: Engage with our recruitment team for an initial discussion.
  
• Step 3: Participate in HackerRank assessments/technical/functional interviews and assessments.
  
• Step 4: Final interaction with Chubb leadership.

With you Chubb is better. Whether you are solving challenges on a global stage or creating innovative solutions for local markets, your contributions will help shape the future. If you value integrity, innovation, and inclusion, and are ready to make a difference, we invite you to be part of Chubb India’s journey.

document expected results.
