analysis, and implement durable corrective actions.
  

* Partner with product, implementation, support, security, infrastructure, and customer technical teams

to clarify requirements and deliver interfaces.
  

* Maintain interface documentation, data-flow diagrams, deployment procedures, runbooks, and

change records.
  

* Follow secure development, source-control, peer-review, change-management, privacy, and

regulated healthcare data-handling practices.
  

* Participate in scheduled releases and an on-call or after-hours support rotation as business needs

require.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  

* Professional experience developing and supporting healthcare interfaces in a production

environment.
  

* Strong hands-on Java development experience, including debugging, libraries/APIs, data

manipulation, and maintainable coding practices.
  

* Strong hands-on Lua development experience for healthcare integration, transformation, and

interface logic.
  

* Production experience building and supporting interfaces in Mirth Connect (NextGen Connect).
* Production experience building and supporting interfaces in iNTERFACEWARE Iguana.
* Strong knowledge of HL7 v2 structure, segments, fields, components, data types,

acknowledgements, and common trigger events.
  

* Experience with XML, JSON, REST APIs, SQL, relational databases, TCP/IP, MLLP, and secure file

transfer.
  

* Ability to diagnose interface problems across applications, networks, certificates, databases, and

message content.
  

* Experience with Git or another source-control system and disciplined software development and

release practices.
  

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work directly with technical and

nontechnical stakeholders.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  

* Five or more years of healthcare integration or interface-development experience.
* Experience with FHIR resources and APIs, CDA/CCD, X12, DICOM, or other healthcare

interoperability standards.
  

* Experience integrating laboratory, hospital, EHR/EMR, public-health, or newborn-screening systems.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, Linux, Windows Server, cloud environments,

containers, or CI/CD pipelines.
  

* Knowledge of interface security, TLS/mTLS, certificates, OAuth 2.0, encryption, auditing, and secrets management.

Understanding of HIPAA, PHI/PII protection, least privilege, data minimization, and secure software
  
development.
  

* Relevant certification or formal training in HL7, FHIR, Mirth Connect, Iguana, Java, or healthcare

Success Measures

description:

* Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement corrective actions.

* Stay updated on the latest Omnissa Horizon features, updates, and industry trends.
* Conduct Product and vendor analysis to ensure Chubb’s alignment to industry standards and trends.
* Provide Level 2/3 support for complex issues related to Omnissa Horizon and VDI environments.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve technical challenges and ensure user satisfaction.
* Conduct root cause analysis for recurring issues and implement long-term solutions.
* Create and maintain detailed documentation, including architecture diagrams, configuration guides, and standard operating procedures.
* Ensure the Omnissa Horizon environment adheres to organizational security policies and compliance requirements.
* Implement security best practices for VDI, including multi-factor authentication and data encryption.
* Analyze and optimize the performance of the Omnissa Horizon environment to ensure a seamless user experience.
* Conduct capacity planning and scalability assessments to support future growth

  

**Qualification or Required Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, with at least 3 years of hands-on experience with Omnissa Horizon.
* Expertise in Omnissa Horizon components, including Connection Servers, Unified Access Gateways, App Volumes, and Dynamic Environment Manager.
* Strong knowledge of virtualization technologies, including VMware vSphere and ESXi.
* Proficiency in Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy management.
* Experience with networking concepts, including VLANs, firewalls, and load balancers.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.
* Familiarity with scripting and automation tools (e.g., PowerShell, Python).
* Knowledge of ITIL processes and frameworks.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.  

**Why Chubb?**  
Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!
  
Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.
  
• Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
  
• A Great Place to work: Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work® for the years 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026

• Start-Up Culture: Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
  
• Growth and success: As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment

**Employee Benefits**  
Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. Our benefits include:
  
• **Savings and Investment plans:** We provide specialized benefits like Corporate NPS (National Pension Scheme), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), Retiral Benefits and Car Lease that help employees optimally plan their finances
  
• **Upskilling and career growth opportunities:** With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customized programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs.
  
• **Health and Welfare Benefits:** We care about our employees’ well-being in and out of work and have benefits like Hybrid Work Environment, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Yearly Free Health campaigns and comprehensive Insurance benefits.

**Application Process**  
Our recruitment process is designed to be transparent, and inclusive.

• Step 2: Engage with our recruitment team for an initial discussion.
  
• Step 3: Participate in HackerRank assessments/technical/functional interviews and assessments.
  
• Step 4: Final interaction with Chubb leadership.

With you Chubb is better. Whether you are solving challenges on a global stage or creating innovative solutions for local markets, your contributions will help shape the future. If you value integrity, innovation, and inclusion, and are ready to make a difference, we invite you to be part of Chubb India’s journey.

We are the engineering organization behind Cisco's flagship AI initiatives, including MyAgent (Cisco's super agent) and the Circuit Enterprise AI platform.
  
Our high-velocity team operates at the intersection of frontier generative AI, distributed systems, GPU infrastructure, and modern software engineering. We build with a steadfast focus on engineering craftsmanship, high talent density, principled quality, and developer enablement—empowering thousands of engineers across Cisco to create, validate, and scale multimodal agentic experiences.
  
  
Your Impact
  
As the Director of AI Support& Automation, you will build and lead our Bangalore-based engineering pod as an elite 'player-coach' calibrated two levels below the VP. Combining direct architectural leadership with deep, hands-on systems development across MyAgent and Circuit, you will set the benchmark for AI platform reliability and quality.
  
You will enable the engineering organization to improve and optimize engineering processes and infrastructure, directing software systems development, application engineering, and software quality assurance for cloud-based and agentic AI platforms. Your directive spans across 5 core pillars:
  

* Pillar 1: Tier 3 Engineering& Escalated Platform Support: Act as the ultimate engineering escalation authority for MyAgent and Circuit. Lead hands-on debugging, root-cause forensic analysis, and kernel/runtime patch development for complex production failures, memory leaks, context bleed, and tool execution anomalies. Bridge the gap between SRE/L2 operational support and core platform architecture with zero-regression hotfix.
* Pillar 2: Premier AI Agent Test Harness& Evaluation: Architect and build an end-to-end, agent-driven test automation harness. Implement automated LLM-as-a-judge scoring frameworks, multi-agent simulation loops, deterministic task verification, and golden dataset benchmarking. Maintain uncompromising quality gates with >99% test pass rates across complex functional, regression, experimental, and safety workflows.
* Pillar 3: AI Software& GPU Performance Validation: Lead performance profiling, stress testing, and concurrency load and latency validation across dedicated on-premise GPU clusters and cloud runtimes. Optimize latency, token throughput, context cache utilization, and resource efficiency.
* Pillar 4: Modular SDK& API Developer Platform: Deliver modular, embeddable SDKs, React components, and headless APIs that empower thousands of Cisco software engineers to control, customize, and extend multimodal agentic experiences.
* Pillar 5: High-Talent-Density Team Leadership: Recruit, mentor, and lead a small, high-density pod (6–10 elite systems, AI, and test automation engineers) in Bangalore. Lead by example through daily code reviews, technical design RFCs, pair programming, and rigorous engineering craftsmanship.
* Technical Architecture& Testing Methodology:
* Deterministic Harness Layer: Unit and integration verification of MCP protocol compliance, tool schema validation, state machines, token exchange (RFC 8693), and memory storage persistence.
* LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation Framework: Automated scoring pipelines using calibrated frontier and on-premise judge models to evaluate grounding, factual accuracy, safety guardrails, hallucination rates, and task completion against versioned golden sets.
* Multi-Agent Simulation& Adversarial Red-Teaming: Automated agent swarms generating synthetic edge cases, malicious prompt injections, tool misuse attempts, and context overflow scenarios to proactively identify failure modes.
* Continuous Canary& Regression Pipeline: Automated staging deployment validation with automated rollback mechanisms, real-time latency tracing (OpenTelemetry), and semantic drift monitoring.

Minimum Qualifications
  

* Education: Bachelor's degree (B.Tech / B.E. / B.S.) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative STEM discipline from an accredited institution.
* Professional Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including 3+ years leading high-performing technical engineering teams and 2+ years of hands-on production experience with LLMs, agentic workflows, or AI platforms.
* Hands-on Coding Proficiency: Expert-level fluency in Python and modern TypeScript/JavaScript; strong working proficiency in Go, C++, or Rust for systems-level performance tuning.
* AI& Systems Architecture: Deep practical experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, LlamaIndex, vLLM, Triton Inference Server, PyTorch, and vector databases.
* Modern Test& Performance Engineering: Demonstrated track record of designing large-scale distributed test harnesses, performance testing tools (k6, Locust, JMeter), browser automation (Playwright), and AI evaluation frameworks (Ragas, DeepEval, Promptfoo, Eval Studio).

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Advanced Credentials: Master's degree (M.Tech / M.S.) or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Distributed Systems, Machine Learning, or Software Engineering from a premier tier-1 engineering institution or top global research universities).
* GPU& Infrastructure Acumen: Solid understanding of GPU compute infrastructure, CUDA memory management, high-density server configurations, and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Academic, Research, or Open Source Contributions: Demonstrated academic depth or research contributions in distributed systems, compiler optimization, GPU parallel computing (CUDA/Triton), formal software verification, major contributions to tier-1 open-source AI frameworks/benchmarks, or recognized technical patents in AI/systems engineering.
* Player-Coach Leadership Archetype: Proven ability to lead from the front, write production code, conduct deep architectural reviews, and inspire an elite engineering culture without relying on bureaucratic middle management.
* Enterprise Executive Communication: Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence, interact, and present technical architectures effectively across engineering, product, and executive leadership.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering

Lead one or more software engineering teams, designing scalable solutions and owning the full software development lifecycle—from design and delivery to ongoing operation and maintenance.
  
  
Manage and develop engineers through regular coaching, guidance, and mentorship, supporting both their day-to-day work and long-term career growth.
  
  
Attract, onboard, develop, and retain diverse talent while building an inclusive, collaborative team culture.

Identify and drive improvements to engineering skills, standards, practices, architecture, and documentation.
  
  
Facilitate technical discussions and decisions, helping teams weigh trade-offs and align on effective solutions.

A good understanding of modern deployment methodologies, including progressive delivery and blue-green deployments.
  
  
Experience working with containers, container orchestration, and deployment automation.
  
  
12+ years of engineering experience, including at least 3-5 years leading high-performing teams.

Experience hiring and developing engineering teams and culture, and leading cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, agile environment.
  
  
The ability to communicate and collaborate across the organization, influence decisions with and without direct authority, and communicate inclusively and persuasively.
  
  
Strong analytical and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance technical and business requirements.
  
  
Payments experience is preferred.

title: Java Developer
description:
**About QPC**

QPC is a UK-headquartered contact centre technology company. QPC gives contact centres a real-time view of their operations. It collects events from major CX platforms such as Genesys, Amazon Connect, NICE, Avaya and Talkdesk and brings them into one platform for live reporting, workforce management and AI-driven insight. QPC has offices in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, North America, India and Australia.

**Role Summary**

We are hiring a Java developer to work alongside QPC's India team in Bangalore to build and maintain the event adapters that convert contact centre platform events into QPC's normalised event model. In general, you will work from a clear, pre-written design produced by our Event Adapter Analyst, which defines the incoming record structure, the events and attributes that matter, and the sequences needed to track a contact. Your job is to turn that design into robust, well-tested Java that fits into our existing collection service.

Collecting data from the source platform (APIs, polling, streams, webhooks) is a separate concern from converting it into events. Where collection has been decoupled, your adapter simply receives events from a queue such as NATS JetStream and does not need to worry about how they got there.

We work AI-first. You will use AI coding tools as a core part of how you build, not as an add-on: to understand the existing codebase quickly, to turn the Analyst's design into working code, to generate unit and integration tests, to review and refactor, to diagnose defects, and to write and maintain documentation. The aim is to deliver adapters faster and with fewer defects. You remain the engineer: you will review the output, understand it, test it, and own its quality in production.

This is a mid-level role as part of the wider Contact Centre Software Engineering team. It suits someone who likes focused, hands-on Java development in a specific area, enjoys turning a well-defined requirement into reliable production code, and is keen to work in a modern, AI-assisted way.

**Key responsibilities**

* **Adapters:** Design, develop and support Java event adapters that map source-system records into QPC events, working within the existing collection service and using AI coding assistants to accelerate implementation.
* **Designs:** Implement adapters from the Analyst's event mapping design (record structure, event sequences, attributes), using AI to trace requirements through to code, and raise questions or gaps back to the Analyst promptly.
* **Collection:** Receive events from queues (for example NATS JetStream) and, where an adapter still connects directly to a source, handle that connection cleanly and keep it separate from the conversion logic.
* **Event behaviour:** Handle real-world event behaviour: out-of-order or duplicate events, transfers, conferences and consult chains, reconnects and resynchronisation.
* **Concurrency:** Use multi-threading appropriately, for example separate threads for collection and processing, or one thread per stream, and avoid the bottlenecks and race conditions that come with it, critically reviewing any AI-generated concurrency code.
* **Testing and quality:** Write unit and integration tests, using AI to extend coverage, that prove expected behaviour, event edge cases and concurrency. The Analyst carries out acceptance testing against the requirements and you turn around their findings quickly, but you remain responsible for the quality of your own implementation.
* **Documentation:** Produce and maintain clear, AI-assisted documentation for each adapter, covering behaviour, configuration and known limitations, kept in step with the code.
* **Diagnostics:** Use AI to review code, explain unfamiliar legacy modules, investigate logs and speed up root-cause analysis.
* **Tools:** Build reusable AI prompts, templates and tools that help with development and support, such as replay utilities, sample-event generators or diagnostic helpers.
* **Knowledge sharing:** Share knowledge across the team so that routine changes never depend on one person.
* **Azure DevOps:** Utilise Azure DevOps for work items, change control, pipelines and time tracking.
* **AI practice:** Contribute to how the team uses AI: share what works, flag where tools get things wrong, and help improve our AI-assisted engineering practices.

**Required skills and experience**

* **Java:** Professional object-oriented software development in Java (Java 17+), ideally 3–5 years' experience.
* **AI coding tools:** Regular, hands-on use of AI coding assistants (for example Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor) in your day-to-day development, with the skill to review, test and correct their output.
* **Concurrency:** Experience developing multi-threaded, headless (service-style) applications, with a good understanding of concurrency pitfalls.
* **Testing:** Unit and integration testing (for example JUnit 5), including tests for event edge cases such as duplicate or out-of-order events, and for concurrency behaviour.
* **Communication:** Good written communication, able to read a design document, ask precise questions and document your own work.
* **Problem-solving:** Excellent problem-solving skills.
* **Teamwork:** Able to work autonomously, while being a positive, collaborative member of a team.

**Desirable**

* **Agentic AI:** Experience with agentic AI development workflows, for example AI agents working across a codebase, running tests or preparing changes for review.
* **AI workflows:** Experience writing effective prompts, project instructions or reusable AI workflows for repeatable development tasks.
* **IDE and build:** Experience in NetBeans IDE and Maven.
* **Contact centre:** Experience integrating with contact centre or telephony platforms (for example Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud, NICE CXone, Avaya, Cisco).
* **Legacy Java:** Experience of Java 8+ and ANT for support of existing libraries and modules.
* **Messaging:** Experience consuming from message queues or streaming systems (NATS JetStream, Kinesis, SQS or similar).
* **Integration:** Working knowledge of webhooks, WebSockets and REST APIs.
* **Networking:** Understanding of networking and socket connections.
* **Databases:** Database application experience (MS SQL Server, Oracle and MariaDB).
* **DevOps:** Version control (Git or similar such as SVN) and CI/CD or DevOps practices.
* **Other languages:** Exposure to other languages or paradigms.
* **Cloud:** Experience with AWS services (for example Kinesis, CloudWatch, IAM) and containerised deployment.

description:
**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a **Developer - Exposure Management Platform** to be part of making this happen.
  
  
**Position Overview and Objective**

The Arctic Wolf security operations platform ingests and processes upwards of 250 billion events a day from a wide variety of on-premise devices and cloud platforms. The security pipeline is a **distributed system** of loosely-coupled microservices that constitute our **real-time analysis** and **threat detection systems.** These services distill the incoming events into actionable intelligence that our Concierge Security Teams use to protect customers.
  
We are growing rapidly, with our data volume increasing ten-fold roughly every two years. We are looking for experienced developers to join our pack and work with us to continuously evolve and expand the capabilities of our security platform. This particular role focuses on building components of our Managed Risk Platform.  
  
  
  
**Responsibilities**

As a **Developer** at Arctic Wolf, you will:

* Deliver well-scoped backend features for real-time threat analysis services with minimal supervision.
* Design, develop, test, and maintain microservices as part of an agile engineering team.
* Write clean, reliable production code with automated tests and clear handling of edge cases.
* Deploy containerized services using CI/CD, AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices.
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and operational support for owned services.
Continuously learn, improve, and contribute to team engineering standards.  

**Required Qualifications**

* 1–2 years of experience shipping production-quality backend software.
* Strong coding skills and a bias for simple, maintainable solutions.
* Experience with cloud-based services and deployments, preferably on AWS.
* Hands-on experience with Golang is preferred; Java or other backend experience is also valuable.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, Kafka, Docker, and Kubernetes/EKS is preferred.
* Comfortable working on distributed systems or microservices, with guidance on larger design decisions.
Excited to work at the intersection of big data, cybersecurity, and real-time systems.  

**Our Technology Stack**  
  
Golang, Docker, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Kubernetes/EKS, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Java, Linux.

**On-Camera Policy**

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

**About Arctic Wolf**

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2025), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2025), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024-2026), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024-2026). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.

**Our Values**

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance.

We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.

  

**Benefits**
============

  

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru  

**Security Requirements**
=========================

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business and customer information.

  

Depending on the role, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws where applicable.

  

**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**

Overview:

Waters Global Research department is looking for an energetic and creative C++/algorithm software engineer to join the team and help bring technologies in analytical instrumentation to the forefront of the industry. The new hire will contribute to the next generation of innovations in automated instrumentation workflows and high performance algorithms to extract artefacts from high throughput analytical devices for drug discovery laboratories.

The Waters Global Research team performs early, cutting-edge research on novel chromatography and mass spectrometry systems that have a direct impact on laboratory testing, drug discovery and development and food safety. The role of this engineer will be to develop and refine algorithms that extract metrics from analytical devices, leverage GPU architectures to speed up run times.

We seek someone with a growth mindset who is self-motivated, a problem solver, and someone energized by working at the nexus of leading-edge software and hardware development.

* Build tools and develop algorithms in C++ that process scientific data from instruments
* Port algorithms to GPU and benchmark results
* Work with Subject Matter Experts in the instrumentation to refine algorithms and address edge cases
* Maintain codebase: use OOP and/or FP best practices, write unit tests, etc.
* Work with development teams to assist with algorithm validation and knowledge transfer
* Configure/use LLM and agentic tools to develop and validate solutions
* Present work to department, collaborate with other scientists and engineers across worldwide offices

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, physics, mathematics, or related field and at least 5 years relevant work experience, or equivalent
* Comfortable discovering and driving new capabilities, solutions, and programming best practices from blogs, white papers, and other technical documentation

* Experience with scientific data and algorithms development
* Proficiency in object-oriented design or functional programming best practices
* Familiarity with the software workflow and agile best practices (Git version control, testing best practices)

**Job Title**

Software Engineer

**Location**

Bangalore/Hyderabad

**About Us**

Ingersoll Rand is a global provider of mission-critical flow creation, life science and industrial solutions. Ingersoll Rand’s Global Engineering & Technology Center (GEC) in Bangalore, **A GREAT PLACE TO WORK CERTIFIED WORKPLACE** is driven by an ownership mindset and entrepreneurial spirit, has been a beacon of innovation for over 19 years, embodying our purpose to “Make Life Better” for our employees, customers, shareholders and the planet.

The Engineering & Technology center has expertly supported a diverse range of industrial products, offering deep expertise in core and digital engineering space. By cultivating a sense of inclusion, belonging and respect, and a collaborative culture, the GEC has fostered the most talented and capable engineers, thereby playing a pivotal role in driving Ingersoll Rand’s purpose and strategic focus areas.

**Job & Division Summary:**

The Software Engineer is responsible for the design, development, testing, and validation of industrial automation and control systems using Structured Text and Ladder Logic programming languages. The role develops PLC based and automation solutions on platforms including Rockwell Automation, Phoenix Contact, Schneider, Emerson, and Siemens. Working closely with project and controls engineering teams, the Software Engineer delivers safe, reliable, maintainable, and customizable automation systems that meet project requirements, applicable standards, and customer expectations.

This role reports to Jose Maldonado, Engineering Manager located at Lone Star Turbo, Houston, Texas, USA.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and test PLC and HMI applications for industrial automation and control systems.
* Create control system design documentation such as I/O lists, interface documents, network architecture, and cause & effect charts.
* Develop software solutions that meet customer requirements, project specifications, and company guidelines.
* Apply Lone Star Turbo programming guidelines to PLC and HMI software development projects.
* Conduct software testing, debugging, and validation activities to verify functionality and performance.
* Ensure compliance with customer specifications, industry standards, and company best practices.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives found on software quality, standardization, efficiency, and reliability.
* Collaborate with project engineers and controls engineers throughout the project lifecycle.
* Communicate effectively while working remotely with global engineering teams.

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in industrial automation, controls engineering, or control system software development.
* Hands-on experience with one or more PLC platforms including Rockwell, PLCnext, Modicon, and Siemens.
* Experience programming using Structured Text, Ladder Logic, Function Blocks, or similar industrial automation programming languages.
* Knowledge of PLC hardware architectures, industrial instrumentation, analog and digital I/O systems, motor controls, and variable frequency drives.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, P&IDs, control panel drawings, and network architecture documentation.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work directly with customers and cross-functional teams.
* Strong proficiency in English and ability to communicate with global stake holders.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

**Desired Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Controls Engineering or Computer Engineering with strong background in software development for industrial PLCs and HMIs.
* Experience developing PLC based control systems using platforms such as Rockwell ControlLogix/CompactLogix, PLCnext, Modicon, and Siemens, with programming in Structured Text and Ladder Logic.
* Experience developing HMI and SCADA systems using platforms such as Factory Talk, Ignition, or Wonderware, including alarm management, historian integration, device communications, and operator interface design.
* Experience in Factory Acceptance Testing, Site Acceptance Testing, and commissioning of industrial automation systems.
* Understanding of control system fundamentals including PID control, interlocks, permissives, state machines, and process automation concepts.
* Familiarity with electrical and control panel design principles, instrumentation, and field device integration.
* Experience with software standardization, reusable code libraries, and automation architecture development.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong technical presentation skills and experience participating in software development peer reviews.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a cross-functional team environment.
* Commitment to continuous learning and professional development within industrial automation and software engineering disciplines.

**What we Offer**

Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

About Us
  
Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. Together with our Bengaluru engineering team, we are building finance, accounting, payroll and expense management solutions that simplifies how businesses track and reconcile spending.
  
Thousands of finance teams globally use our product to streamline expense management, integrate seamlessly with leading accounting platforms, and are recognized for its clean design, usability, and speed.
  
We're investing heavily in AI — building the platform that lets AI agents and assistants do real engineering work, reliably and at scale. This team designs and runs the infrastructure behind our coding agents, review agents, and internal AI assistants: the orchestration, context and memory systems, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that make them better over time.
  
  
What We're Looking For
  
We're looking for someone with 3+ years of software engineering experience (mid-level) or 6+ years (senior), with hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agent-based systems in production.
  
  
Technical Skills- Solid software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modelling, and clean, maintainable code.
- Experience building and running production systems in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containers, Kubernetes or similar, and infrastructure as code.
- Hands-on experience with distributed systems: queues, async workflows, concurrency, reliability, and failure handling.
- Practical experience building with LLMs: tool use, agents, prompt and context engineering, RAG, and evaluation.
- Familiarity with agent protocols and ecosystems (e.g., MCP) and with using AI coding tools day to day.
  
  
Leadership & Ownership- Comfort working independently and handling ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, scope it, and drive it to production.
- Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining trade-offs to both technical and non technical audiences.
- At the senior level, we also expect you to lead projects and set technical direction, mentor other engineers, define evaluation and quality standards, and influence architecture across teams.
  
  
Mindset & Collaboration- Growth mindset — curious, always learning, and open to feedback.
- Works closely with the engineers who use these tools every day; you help the whole organization build software better and faster.
  
  
Nice to Have- Experience with trace analysis or log mining to find and fix agent failure modes.

- Background in observability, CI/CD, or developer productivity tooling.
- Experience with model routing, cost optimization, or prompt caching.

This is an opportunity to deepen your expertise in cloud-native technologies, drive meaningful improvements to the developer experience, and play a vital role in our mission to become Australia's best engineering bank.

description:
**Who We Are**

Location:

Bangalore,IND

We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits .

  

**Job Description**

**About Rocket**

Rocket is a team within Applied dedicated to advancing and scaling rapid innovation methodologies across the organization. We focus on accelerating breakthrough technologies by combining deep scientific expertise, advanced computational methods, and practical engineering to solve complex challenges in semiconductor manufacturing.

  

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a highly motivated and intellectually curious **Algorithm Developer** to work at the intersection of **artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), theoretical physics, and systems engineering** . In this role, you will drive the development of next-generation solutions for high-impact semiconductor manufacturing applications.

The successful candidate will contribute to multiple disruptive design initiatives by developing automated systems capable of ingesting and processing data from thousands of sensors, identifying critical physics-based relationships, and building predictive and control models. These solutions will leverage a hybrid approach that combines first-principles physics modeling with advanced machine learning techniques, including physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), to optimize complex manufacturing processes in real time.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop scalable data pipelines to collect, process, and analyze high-volume sensor data from semiconductor manufacturing systems.
* Identify and model underlying physical relationships governing complex process behavior.
* Develop predictive and control algorithms using a combination of traditional physics-based methods and machine learning approaches.
* Build robust, maintainable software modules that integrate directly with real-world manufacturing tools and systems.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams spanning physics, engineering, software development, and data science to accelerate innovation and technology deployment.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of intelligent automation solutions for advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes.
* Develop ML surrogates or reduced order models, based on rigorous physics simulations, including research, design, development and implementation & proliferation accompanying in accordance with project budgets and time schedules.
* Optimize accuracy / performance tradeoffs, to retain achieve but speed execution of algorithm modules
* Analyze large quantities of sensor and metrology data, and iteratively improve simulation and models to improve accuracy
* Implement models and code for user facing applications, in control systems or dashboards
Maintain a clean and consistent code base, that can be extended by team  

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate possesses a strong foundation in theoretical and computational disciplines, coupled with practical software development expertise. You are passionate about applying scientific principles to solve real-world engineering challenges and are equally comfortable moving between mathematical modeling, machine learning, and software implementation.

You should demonstrate:

* Deep expertise in one or more areas of theoretical physics, applied mathematics, computational science, or simulation-driven engineering.
* Working knowledge of modern machine learning, data science, and statistical modeling techniques.
* Strong software engineering capabilities, including the ability to translate complex algorithms into clean, scalable, and production-ready code.
A practical mindset focused on delivering solutions that interact with and control physical systems in real-world environments.  

  

**Qualifications**

**Minimum Requirements**

* Ph.D. in Physics, Applied Mathematics, Computational Chemistry, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline, **or**
* Master’s degree in one of the above fields with a minimum of **2 years of relevant industry or research experience** .

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated ability to develop high-quality, maintainable code, evidenced through public GitHub repositories, open-source contributions, peer-reviewed publications, or equivalent technical work.
* Experience with computational methods, computer-aided engineering (CAE), engineering simulation, physical modeling, or the analysis of complex systems, with a focus on practical and impactful outcomes.
* Experience applying machine learning techniques to scientific, engineering, or industrial problems.
* Strong interest in sensors, instrumentation, hardware systems, robotics, or other technologies that bridge software with physical-world applications.
Proven ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary environments and solve ambiguous, complex technical problems.  

  

**Why Join Rocket?**

Rocket offers a unique opportunity to work on cutting-edge challenges at the convergence of physics, AI, and semiconductor manufacturing. You will help develop transformative technologies that directly influence next-generation manufacturing systems while collaborating with a team dedicated to rapid innovation, scientific excellence, and real-world impact.

Full time

Assignee / Regular

No

description:
**About Exotel:**

Exotel is the emerging market’s leading full-stack customer engagement platform and business-focused virtual telecom operator. Incorporated in 2011, Exotel’s cloud-based product suite powers 50 million daily engagements across voice, video, and messaging channels. Exotel serves over 6000 companies across 60+ countries, including India, SE Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.

  

**Tech @ Exotel**

* Exotel Engineering builds fault-tolerant, scalable, and real-time distributed systems.

**Team IPO Readiness:**

The IPO Readiness pod owns Exotel’s billing and revenue platform — real-time call/SMS billing, balance deduction, invoicing, payment processing, and credit control. The platform handles approximately 200k transactions per minute across Voice, Messaging, and other Exotel solutions.

  

**Role: Member of Technical Staff II**

As an MTS-II on IPO Readiness, you will design, build, and integrate components across the billing platform and support IPO-readiness initiatives (controls, monitoring, automation). You will work on feature delivery, production support, and cross-system integrations with ERP (Business Central), payment gateways, and the Zuora migration path.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Platform Development & Integration:**

* Develop and maintain microservices and batch jobs in Golang, Java, or PHP

* Build and extend REST APIs and Kafka consumers/producers for billing events, sync flows, and fallback pipelines.

  

**Must-Have Skills:**

* Strong computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms).

* Proficiency in at least one of: Golang (preferred), Java, or PHP.

* Experience building scalable distributed systems and event-driven architectures.

* Hands-on MySQL — schema design, query tuning, replication awareness.

* Experience with Apache Kafka and asynchronous processing (consumers, lag, fallback/retry patterns).

* Kubernetes basics — pods, deployments, namespaces, ArgoCD or equivalent GitOps.

* DevOps mindset — you build it, you own it; comfortable with logs, metrics, and incident triage.

  

**Good-to-Have Skills:**

* Exposure to billing, invoicing, payments, or ERP integrations (Zuora, Business Central, Razorpay).

* Experience with Beanstalkd, Jenkins, Prometheus/Grafana/Loki.

* Scripting in Python for ops automation and report generation.

* Familiarity with ITGC/SOX-style controls and audit documentation.

  

Experience: 2–5 years

Location: Bangalore (On-site)

title: Enterprise Agentic Automation Developer/Solutions Architect
description:
**Date posted** 10/14/2026

### **Category** **Information Technology****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **18884****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/14/2026**

**We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

**You Are**

You have spent years building enterprise systems that actually solve business problems, not just demonstrate technical capability. You understand that the real challenge is not deploying an AI model, it is designing the solution architecture that makes it trustworthy, scalable, and maintainable across Finance, HR, Sales Operations, and Legal teams who need it to work every single day. You think in systems, not features. When someone describes a manual process, you are already mapping the integration points, data flows, governance requirements, and failure modes before they finish talking.

You are equally comfortable whiteboarding an agentic AI architecture with a VP of Finance and writing Python code to integrate Azure OpenAI with SAP. You have built enough automation solutions to know when a workflow needs intelligent document processing versus a simple API call, and you can explain that tradeoff clearly. You do not wait for perfect requirements. You ask the right questions, prototype quickly, and iterate with stakeholders who may not speak your technical language but absolutely know their business pain.

At Synopsys, you will architect AI and automation solutions that reduce manual work for 30,000 employees across critical business functions, and the platform you build will matter.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Design and build enterprise AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search, and Copilot Studio that automate Finance, Sales Operations, HR, Order Management, and Legal processes
* Architect and develop agentic AI systems and intelligent automation workflows on UiPath, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Functions that integrate with SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, SuccessFactors, and Workday
* Lead end-to-end solution delivery from requirements gathering and architecture design through development, testing, deployment, and production support
* Build reusable frameworks, integration patterns, and engineering standards for AI agent development that other developers can adopt across the enterprise automation portfolio
* Partner directly with business stakeholders in Finance, GTM, HR, and Operations to identify automation opportunities, assess feasibility, prioritize initiatives, and translate requirements into technical solutions
* Establish and enforce governance, security, Responsible AI practices, and DevOps standards using Azure DevOps or GitHub for CI/CD and source control
* Mentor developers on AI solution design, Azure architecture, integration patterns, and automation best practices

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Reduce manual effort across Finance, Sales Operations, HR, and Order Management by deploying AI-powered automation that handles document processing, data extraction, workflow orchestration, and decision support at scale
* Accelerate Synopsys' enterprise AI strategy by establishing reusable frameworks and patterns that enable faster, more consistent delivery of intelligent automation solutions across business functions
* Improve operational accuracy and compliance by building governed, auditable AI systems with proper security controls, error handling, and monitoring
* Enable business growth without proportional headcount increases by creating scalable automation platforms that handle increasing transaction volumes and process complexity
* Strengthen cross-functional collaboration by translating technical capabilities into business value that Finance, HR, and Operations leaders can understand and trust
* Build institutional knowledge and capability by mentoring developers and establishing engineering standards that raise the quality and maintainability of the entire automation portfolio
Drive measurable ROI through solutions that demonstrably* time, reduce errors, and improve process efficiency in production environments

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 8-12+ years building enterprise applications, automation solutions, or integration platforms, with at least 3 years working directly with AI or Generative AI technologies in production environments
* Deep hands-on experience with Azure AI Services including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, and Azure AI Search, plus Azure Integration Services like Logic Apps, Functions, Service Bus, and API Management
* Proven ability to design and deploy intelligent automation using platforms like UiPath, Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio, and Dataverse
* Strong development skills in Python, C#, and JavaScript, with solid understanding of REST APIs, SOAP, webhooks, SQL, and data modeling
* Direct experience integrating enterprise applications such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, SuccessFactors, or Workday in complex business environments
* Working knowledge of AI governance, Responsible AI practices, cloud security, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and source control using Azure DevOps or GitHub, experience with JIRA for project management is a plus

**Who You Are**

* You can sit in a room with a Finance Director who describes a month-end close process and walk out with a solution architecture that addresses the real bottleneck, not just the symptom they mentioned
* You write code that other developers can actually maintain, you document your integration patterns, you build error handling that helps operations teams diagnose issues without calling you at midnight
* You push back when a stakeholder asks for an AI agent but the problem actually needs a well-designed workflow, and you can explain why in terms they understand and respect
* You have shipped enough production systems to know that governance, security, and supportability are not afterthoughts, they are design constraints you bake in from the start
* You mentor junior developers by showing them how you think through a problem, not just handing them the answer, and you genuinely care about raising the technical capability of the team
* You stay current with AI and automation technology not because it is trendy but because you know the difference between a useful new capability and vendor hype, and you can evaluate both critically

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will join the Enterprise Agentic Process Automation team, which drives business transformation through AI, intelligent automation, process optimization, and enterprise integration. The team delivers capabilities across Finance, Sales Operations, Order Management, HR, Business Operations, and other functions, with emphasis on operational efficiency, scalability, governance, and innovation. Current initiatives include AI agents, document intelligence, finance automation, process orchestration, and enterprise platform integrations. The team operates in Bengaluru and collaborates closely with business stakeholders and IT teams across Synopsys globally.

**Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  
  

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Senior Developer (.net , Windows )
description:
**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

**Job Description**

**About the job**

  

At Arctic Wolf, we're not just navigating the cybersecurity landscape - we're redefining it. Our global team of dedicated Pack members is driving innovation and setting new industry standards every day. Our impact speaks for itself: we've earned recognition on the **Forbes Cloud 100, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fortune Future 50, and Fortune Cyber 60** lists, and we recently took home the **2024 CRN Products of the Year** award. We’re proud to be named a **Leader** in the **IDC MarketScape** for Worldwide Managed Detection and Response Services and earning a **Customers' Choice** distinction from **Gartner Peer Insights** . Our **Aurora Platform** also received **CRN’s Products of the Year** award in the inaugural **Security Operations Platform** category. Join a company that’s not only leading, but also shaping, the future of security operations.

  

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a **Senior Developer(Windows)-Endpoint Sustaining** to be part of making that happen.

  

**About the Role**

You’ll be working as a Senior Software developer on our Agent Client team, responsible for delivering the endpoint Windows software that helps solve the real-world security problems that IT professionals face. We develop the internal tools used by the security services team to keep our customers safe and informed. You are a fully qualified, experienced professional for this journey-level role.

  

**Some of your day-to-day responsibilities will be:**

* Mentor new and junior team members.
* Integrate software components into a fully functional software system; document and maintain software functionality.
* Execute assigned and self-generated work. Seek and receive mentoring.
* Understand the product and how Security Services delivers the service.
* Complete knowledge and full understanding of area of specialization, principles and practices within your professional discipline. Assess unusual circumstance and use sophisticated analytical and problem solving techniques to identify cause.
* Resolve and assess a wide range of issues in creative ways and suggests variations in approach.
* Work on problems of diverse scope where analysis of information requires evaluation of identifiable factors, and devise solutions based on limited information and precedent by adapting existing approaches to resolve issues.
* Use evaluation, judgment, and interpretation to select right course of action, which work is done independently and is reviewed at critical points.
We value a culture of sharing, so every team has the opportunity to share their work with the entire department during our monthly R&D Demos. Once a year we hold a department-wide Hackathon, teaming up across all R&D teams over four days to collaborate and build cool ideas outside the normal project scope. While innovation is the focus, some of these ideas do make it into our products.  

  
  

**About You**

You’re an experienced software developer with a minimum of 4+ years of experience who can complete solutions with little or no guidance. Comfortable with working independently on larger, more impactful feature, you have comprehensive knowledge of software development practices, and mastery over writing and debugging code. You perform complex programming tasks and implement software systems with ease. Highly collaborative, you mentor more junior developers.

You have worked closely in a global team of professionals with different cultures and backgrounds to form one unit with a strong sense of purpose. You will learn as you teach, making the whole more than the sum.

Here are some of the core technologies we use and teach across our Applications teams. You should have experience in one or more of these, or similar technologies:

· .Net

· C++

· Go

· AWS

· Git

· Docker

· Kubernetes

· Rust

· Windows kernel‑mode development(Preferred)

· AI‑based tooling for endpoint management(Preferred)

  

In addition, you may have demonstrated leadership experience from previous projects, regardless of title held. Even if you haven’t worked with all of our specific technologies, you bring a diverse knowledge base that you use to help the team solve complex technical problems. You have comprehensive knowledge of software development practices, and mastery over writing and debugging code.

You’ll receive all the security training you need during our onboarding process and through additional training on the job.

  

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2024), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 7,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.

  

**Our Values**

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion,and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.

  

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance.

  

We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.

The Cisco Optical Network Controller (CONC) team leads the industry in optical SDN controller solutions, powering mission-critical tier-1 service provider networks globally. * Dev-Test Architecture& Strategy: Architect scalable, reusable Python test automation frameworks; mentor engineers on writing robust end-to-end tests for distributed edge cases (e.g., node failover, high availability, scale).

Minimum Qualification

* Advanced Java Mastery: Deep expertise in Java (Spring Boot / Micronaut), concurrency/multithreading, distributed data caching, transactional consistency, and REST/gRPC API design.
* Python Test Engineering Expertise: Extensive experience designing modular, automated Python test frameworks (PyTest, Robot Framework, mock servers) to simulate large-scale network topologies and microservice interlocks.
* Cloud-Native& Distributed Systems: Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Kafka, distributed state management, and Linux systems internals.

Preferred Qualification
  

* Deep domain experience in Optical Networking (ROADM, Transponders, OTN, DWDM), L0-L3 network topologies, or PCE/Path Computation algorithms.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

**Who are we?**

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

**Job Summary**

The ServiceNow Developer specializing in Software Asset Management (SAM) is responsible for developing and implementing software asset management solutions within the ServiceNow platform. This role involves collaborating with stakeholders to enhance software asset management processes, ensuring compliance with licensing agreements, and optimizing software usage across the organization.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

* Development and Configuration: Configure and maintain ServiceNow SAM Pro publisher packs

* Integration: Integrate ServiceNow SAM Pro with SaaS publisher portals through out-of-the-box and custom integrations to improve usage data availability for license reconciliation

* Entitlement Upload: Manage and support software entitlement uploads in ServiceNow SAM Pro, including preparing and validating entitlement data from purchase orders, contracts, publisher portals, and procurement records. Ensure accurate mapping to software models using publisher part numbers, normalized publisher/product/version/edition details, license metrics, quantities, contract references, and effective dates

* Compliance Position Generation: Configure, execute, and troubleshoot ServiceNow SAM Pro reconciliation processes to generate accurate software compliance positions. Validate discovered installation and usage data, normalization results, software models, license metrics, allocations, downgrade/upgrade rights, and publisher-specific rules before reconciliation

* Reporting and Analytics: Create and maintain standard and performance analytics dashboards and reports to provide insights into software asset utilization, compliance status, and optimization opportunities

* Workflow Development: Design and develop efficient workflows that streamline processes and enhance user experience

* Collaboration: Work closely with the technical architect and product owner to align product vision, technical feasibility, and implementation strategies

* Testing and Quality Assurance: Conduct unit testing, system testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure data quality and functionality of developed solutions

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
**About Airbound**
------------------

**Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today.**

This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day.

The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch.

To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible.

**About Flight Systems**
------------------------

The hardware on the drone is only half of what keeps it up in the air. The rest is the software both on the craft and on our ground station. Our unique dual motor thrust vectored tailsitter with blended wing body design has to fly in almost all weather-including heavy winds and light rains autonomously. We’re targeting 1000s of flights per day across all locations, requiring us to rethink everything from firmware, controls, state estimation to even ground control and fleet management software. We’ve achieved an industry-leading payload-to-weight ratio of ~2kg drone for 1kg payload and we’re pushing this even further. Every gram matters when you’re revolutionizing logistics. This is where cutting-edge aerospace engineering meets software scalability meets real-world impact. If you get excited about solving problems that span multiple disciplines that don’t have textbook solutions, this is your playground.

**About the Role**
------------------

In this critical, hands-on engineering role, you will develop the embedded software that keeps our revolutionary aircraft flying safely and efficiently. You will build flight-critical systems, optimize real-time performance of our state estimation and control loops, and integrate cutting-edge sensors into our dual-motor thrust-vectored tailsitter platform.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Flight-Critical Firmware Development: Design and implement core embedded systems that control our unique blended wing body aircraft through complex autonomous flight operations
* Real-Time Control Systems: Develop high-frequency control loops and sensor fusion algorithms under strict timing constraints. Implement advanced flight control logic and state estimation systems that respond to changing flight conditions in milliseconds
* Hardware Integration & Optimization: Build low-level drivers for custom avionics hardware including IMUs, GPS modules, cameras, and motor controllers. Optimize code for memory and power efficiency
* Autonomous Navigation Systems: Support development of computer vision pipelines for precision landing, path planning algorithms, and obstacle avoidance systems for fully autonomous flight operations
* Communication & Telemetry: Develop robust communication protocols for ground station connectivity, fleet coordination, and real-time telemetry streaming. Ensure reliable data transmission in challenging RF environments with failsafe mechanisms

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Must-Have**
-------------

* 3-4 years or equivalent expertise in embedded/firmware engineering, with proven experience preferably in the drone/robotics industry or on similar complex real-time systems
* Core Programming Skills: Expert-level proficiency in embedded C and modern C++ 14/17+ for embedded systems, with strong knowledge of Python 3.8+ for computer vision, scripting and data analysis
* **Embedded Systems Expertise:**

  + Low-level MCU firmware with hardware interfaces, device drivers, and system programming for I2C/SPI/GPIO/UART/CAN based peripherals in bare-metal and RTOS setups
  + Proficiency with Embedded Linux systems in user-space and/or kernel-space modules, with exposure to multithreading and multiprocessing
  + Knowledge of computer vision libraries (OpenCV) and camera integration
* **Flight Control Systems:**

  + Hands-on experience with autopilot frameworks like ArduPilot/PX4 and ground control software (Mission Planner, QGroundControl, MAVProxy)
  + Strong understanding of control theory including PID controllers, and real-time feedback systems
  + Experience with SITL/HITL testing and flight simulation environments
* **Software Engineering Fundamentals:**

  + Strong test-driven development and profiling expertise for safety-critical systems
  + Mastery of Git workflows and collaborative development practices
  + Application of SOLID principles and embedded software best practices
  + Excellent documentation and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience with state estimation techniques (Kalman filters, least squares) and advanced control algorithms like model predictive control, disturbance rejection control
* Experience with high-speed communication protocols: MIPI-CSI/DSI, USB cameras with v4l2 stack, Ethernet, SerDes
* Experience with ROS2/Zenoh for distributed robotics systems and inter-process communication

**Work location:** Hoskote, Bangalore (Headquarters)  
#LI-AR1

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Comprehensive health insurance** to keep you and your loved ones covered
* **Relocation assistance and a daily travel stipend** to ease your commute
* **Advanced salary credit** to support you when you need it

“A driven, passionate team where you’ll have room to grow and thrive - **this is more than just a job, it’s a rare opportunity to build something meaningful** from the ground up”

**Work Schedule:**
------------------

* In-office role, working alternate Saturdays.

title: Senior Avaloq Developer
description:
##### **Project description**

We are looking for a Senior Avaloq Developer to design, build and enhance trading and settlement functionality on the Avaloq Banking Suite. You will work on the end-to-end securities trade lifecycle, from order capture through execution, STEX (stock exchange) processing and settlement. A key part of the role is order and settlement pooling: aggregating, allocating and netting instructions efficiently and accurately. You will work with onshore and offshore teams, business analysts and operations stakeholders to deliver robust, compliant solutions for a wealth management client.

##### **Responsibilities**

Design, develop and unit-test Avaloq customisations for trading, STEX and settlement processes in line with the architecture.

Implement and enhance order handling for exchange-traded and OTC products, including order routing, execution, confirmation and booking.

Build and maintain STEX and settlement workflows, covering instruction generation, matching, status handling, fails management and reconciliation.

Apply pooling logic: aggregating orders into block or pooled orders, allocating executions back to underlying client orders, and netting or consolidating settlement instructions where appropriate.

Develop and maintain connectivity with exchanges, brokers, custodians and CSDs/depositories using ISO 20022, SWIFT, FIX and APIs.

Analyse requirements, produce technical designs and estimates, and take part in solution workshops.

Investigate and resolve complex production incidents, performing root cause analysis and delivering permanent fixes.

Support testing cycles (SIT, UAT, regression), release management and deployment activities.

Review code, mentor junior developers and promote best practices in coding, performance and documentation.

Work with Operations, Compliance and Risk teams so solutions meet regulatory and control requirements.

##### **Skills**

Must have

6 to 10+ years in software development, with 4+ years of hands-on Avaloq experience.

Strong working knowledge of the Avaloq securities trading module, covering order management, execution, STEX and settlement.

Practical experience with order pooling or aggregation, allocation and settlement netting in a securities environment.

Proficiency in PL/SQL and the Avaloq development stack (Avaloq Script/AvqScript, Avaloq Workbench, Oracle).

Solid understanding of the securities lifecycle: pre-trade, trade, post-trade, clearing, settlement, corporate actions and reconciliation.

Experience with ISO 20022 and SWIFT messaging (MT/MX) and, ideally, FIX connectivity.

Familiarity with the product range, including equities, bonds, funds, FX and OTC derivatives.

Strong analytical and debugging skills, with experience of performance tuning in high-volume batch and real-time environments.

Experience working in Agile/DevOps teams using tools such as Jira, Git and CI/CD pipelines.

Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work with distributed teams across time zones.

Nice to have

Avaloq certification (such as Avaloq Academy certifications).

Experience with crypto asset trading and settlement on Avaloq.

Exposure to Avaloq data extraction and integration approaches, including APIs.

Knowledge of regulatory requirements affecting trading and settlement (for example MiFID II, CSDR settlement discipline).

Experience migrating or upgrading Avaloq versions.

Prior wealth management or private banking domain experience.

strategies
