description:
**Project Role :** AI Native Software Engineer  
**Project Role Description :** Build and ship production-ready software using AI as a core part of the engineering lifecycle. Apply AI-native practices to develop and validate solutions, maintain quality and compliance, and continuously improve how software is built and operated.
  
**Must have skills :** Digital Full Stack Development  
**Good to have skills :** Python (Programming Language), TypeScript, Software Development  
Minimum **3** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:
  
As an AI Native Software Engineer, your day revolves around creating and delivering software solutions where artificial intelligence is deeply integrated into every stage of development. You will engage in designing, building, and deploying applications that leverage AI capabilities, ensuring that these solutions meet high standards of quality and compliance. Your role involves continuous refinement of software processes to enhance efficiency and reliability, collaborating with various teams to innovate and improve the overall software lifecycle. This position offers an opportunity to work at the forefront of technology, blending software engineering with AI-driven methodologies to produce impactful products.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  

* Design and implement multi-agent orchestration pipelines using LangGraph state machines with conditional routing, self-healing loops, and sub-agent

hierarchies
  

* Build and maintain a hybrid retrieval system combining Neo4j knowledge graphs (Cypher) with Qdrant vector search and sentence-transformer

embeddings  

* Develop FastAPI backend services with async I/O (asyncpg, Motor), Pydantic v2 models, and JWT/RBAC security
* Build React 18 / TypeScript frontend features including visual graph editors (ReactFlow), real-time SSE streaming, and observability dashboards (Recharts)
* Integrate enterprise protocols: A2A (JSON-RPC), MCP (Model Context Protocol), AG-UI (Server-Sent Events)
* Connect to ALM/PLM tools via REST and GraphQL APIs with OAuth2/SSO authentication (SAML, OIDC)

- Implement dual-tier agent memory (Redis L1 + mem0 L2) with semantic recall and context consolidation - Build DAG-based workflow compilation with topological sorting, cycle detection, and Ray-based parallel execution - Deploy and operate containerized services using Docker, Azure Bicep IaC, and CI/CD pipelines (Azure Pipelines / Jenkins) - Serve and manage on-prem LLM models via vLLM alongside cloud-hosted models (OpenAI-compatible APIs)
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
Backend & AI  

* Python 3.10+ — production-grade FastAPI, Pydantic v2, async/await patterns
* LangGraph / LangChain — state machines, tool calling, agent orchestration
* LLM engineering — prompt design, token budgeting, multi-model routing, self-healing retry loops
* PostgreSQL (JSONB, asyncpg) or MongoDB (Motor) — async data persistence

  
Knowledge & Retrieval  

* Neo4j — Cypher queries, entity-relationship graph modeling, traversal algorithm
* Vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, or Weaviate) — embedding pipelines, semantic search, hybrid retrieval
* RAG architecture — chunking strategies, re-ranking, token budget management
* Sentence-transformers or equivalent embedding models

  
Frontend  

* React 18 + TypeScript + Vite — component architecture, hooks, lazy loading
* Server-Sent Events (SSE) or WebSocket — real-time streaming UIs
* ReactFlow / XYFlow — interactive node-based graph editors
* State management (Zustand or Redux) + server-state (TanStack Query)

  
Additional Skills  

* vLLM or TGI — on-prem LLM model serving and optimization
* mem0 or similar — persistent agent memory systems
* A2A / MCP / AG-UI — emerging agentic interoperability protocols
* GraphQL — schema design, client integration
* OAuth2 / SAML / OIDC — enterprise SSO integration
* Ontology modeling — entity taxonomies, relationship schemas for engineering domains
* Pytest — async test patterns, fixture-based testing

  
Qualifications  

* 4+ years professional software engineering experience
* 2+ years working with LLMs, agent frameworks, or ML systems in production
* Strong async Python and modern React/TypeScript skills
* Experience with graph databases or knowledge graph systems
* Comfortable owning features across the full stack — API to UI to deployment

  
Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Digital Full Stack Development.
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Validation Test Developer
description:
Job ID

72284

Category

Enterprise Technology

Location

Bengaluru, India

Work Type

On-site

As a **Validation Test Developer**, you will contribute to Ford’s internal Design Validation (DV) test systems for next-generation vehicle components. You’ll work with test engineers and cross-functional teams to develop and maintain automated test scripts, integrate test bench hardware, perform electrical measurements, and investigate test issues.

This role is suited to an early-career engineer with practical experience in electrical systems, measurement techniques, or test development who is ready to take ownership of defined test activities while continuing to build expertise in automotive validation. You’ll gain hands-on experience with tools such as Python, LabVIEW, NI TestStand, and NI VeriStand, along with laboratory instrumentation and vehicle communication protocols.

* **Test Automation & Scripting:** Develop, execute, debug, and maintain test sequences and automated scripts using Python, LabVIEW, NI TestStand, and/or NI VeriStand.
* **Test Bench Setup & Integration:** Assemble and integrate sensors, actuators, power supplies, and instrumentation into validation benches; support wiring and verify system readiness.
* **Electrical Measurement & Testing:** Perform and document measurements such as voltage, current, resistance, signal integrity, and timing using oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, power supplies, and data loggers.
* **Troubleshooting & Anomaly Logging:** Investigate test bench and hardware-in-the-loop issues, document test anomalies, and collaborate with senior engineers to identify root causes and corrective actions.
* **Network & Bus Communication:** Configure or monitor CAN, LIN, and Ethernet interfaces during component validation, as required.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work with product design, validation, and manufacturing test teams to clarify test requirements and execute test cases against design targets.
* **Documentation & Version Control:** Maintain test procedures, bench configurations, wiring diagrams, and execution reports; use Git or similar tools to manage scripts and changes.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Participate in design reviews, team meetings, and technical training; identify opportunities to improve test coverage, repeatability, and efficiency.

### **Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* **1–2 years of relevant experience** in electrical systems, measurement, test development, or automation, including applicable internship or co-op experience.
* Foundational understanding of electrical engineering principles, circuit theory, signal conditioning, and data acquisition (DAQ).
* Practical familiarity with Python or LabVIEW for scripting, test execution, or automation.
* Hands-on experience using common laboratory equipment, such as digital multimeters, oscilloscopes, and DC power supplies.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and clear written and verbal communication.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to National Instruments hardware platforms such as PXI, cRIO, or cDAQ and software such as LabVIEW, TestStand, or VeriStand.
* Basic understanding or practical exposure to automotive communication protocols, including CAN, LIN, or Automotive Ethernet.
* Experience using Git or similar version control tools.
* Ability to work collaboratively across engineering teams and manage assigned tasks with appropriate guidance.
* Interest in automotive validation, test automation, and continuous learning.

description:
### **Network Software Engineer - Observability & AI**

* JR-163881
* Hybrid

* Bengaluru

* Technology

* Full time

**Who are we?**

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a Network Software Engineer to join the Network Observability team within Equinix's platform engineering organization. This role sits at the intersection of network engineering, AI-native development, and Observability platform development. You will design and build intelligent Network APIs grounded in real-time observability data, network asset intelligence, and inventory systems — then expose those capabilities via Model Context Protocol (MCP), API’s, Streams and autonomous agents that power self-service experiences for Equinix customers and internal operators.

  

You will work closely with Network architects, product teams, platform architects, and data engineers to translate raw network telemetry into programmable, AI-consumable services. You will mentor junior engineers and set the technical direction for how network intelligence is surfaced, automated, and governed across Equinix's global infrastructure.

  

What you will build

In this role, you will have direct ownership over a genuinely novel engineering problem: making Equinix's global network intelligence programmable by both humans and AI. Concretely, you will ship:

  

* AI-native Network APIs — high-fidelity, low-latency APIs that expose real-time observability signals and network asset data as structured, agent-queryable surfaces

* MCP Servers for Network Capabilities — production MCP implementations that let any compatible AI agent safely query network health, inspect topology, validate configurations, and trigger network self-service workflows

* Autonomous Network Agents — intelligent agents that help Equinix customers and operators accomplish network tasks through natural language: diagnosing circuit issues, modeling capacity scenarios, and automating routine change workflows

* Observability-Grounded Intelligence — systems that ground every AI inference in live, authoritative network data, ensuring agents operate with current topology, accurate asset inventory, and real-time health signals
  

**Responsibilities**

Requirements Analysis

* Translate complex network and observability requirements into clear API contracts and data models

* Partner with product managers and business analysts to convert network observability use cases — latency anomaly detection, capacity thresholds, topology drift — into actionable engineering requirements

* Evaluate feasibility across the full data stack: streaming telemetry pipelines, asset inventory systems, and AI inference layers
  

  

Software Architecture & Design

* Participate in and drive architectural reviews for AI-native Network API platforms

* Define reference architectures for exposing network intelligence via MCP servers, ensuring agents can safely query, reason over, and act on live network data

* Design systems that integrate observability data sources (streaming telemetry, SNMP, flow data, topology graphs) with inventory and asset repositories as a unified programmable layer

* Lead the design of AI-native Network APIs that serve both human developers and autonomous AI agents as first-class consumers

* Architect MCP tool and resource definitions that expose network capabilities — topology queries, health checks, capacity lookups, change simulations — as structured, agent-callable interfaces

* Design agentic workflows for network self-service: automated troubleshooting, circuit provisioning assistance, and proactive anomaly remediation

* Evaluate and recommend open source frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenTelemetry, gRPC, GraphQL) to accelerate network intelligence delivery
  

  

Development & Coding

* Build production-grade Network APIs in Python or Java that consume observability telemetry, asset inventory, and topology data

* Implement MCP servers that expose network capabilities as callable tools and data resources for LLM-powered agents

* Develop agentic pipelines — using frameworks such as LangGraph or similar — that enable customers to perform network self-service tasks through natural language and structured tool calls

* Integrate across observability stacks (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Kafka, Grafana Loki) and network asset systems to create coherent, queryable data surfaces

* Apply AI-native development practices: prompt-engineered tool definitions, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) from network knowledge bases, structured outputs for agent decision loops

* Participate in peer code reviews and champion standard coding practices across the team
  

  

Testing

* Develop unit and integration tests for Network APIs, MCP server endpoints, and agent tool invocations

* Build test harnesses that simulate agent interactions with MCP-exposed network capabilities to validate safety, accuracy, and latency bounds

* Define testing strategies for agentic systems — including adversarial prompts, tool misuse scenarios, and multi-step reasoning failures

* Recommend and adopt appropriate testing frameworks (pytest, contract testing, LLM evaluation suites)
  

  

DevOps

* Define deployment and release guidelines for AI-native network services, including canary strategies for MCP server rollouts

* Manage environment planning for observability data pipelines, agent runtimes, and network API backends

* Document software configuration management practices and educate cross-functional teams on agentic deployment patterns and MCP lifecycle management
  

  

Software Reliability & Support Engineering

* Maintain and continuously enrich the inventory of production network APIs, MCP servers, agent workflows, and observability pipelines

* Prepare application support documentation covering agent failure modes, tool call error handling, and network API degradation runbooks

* Troubleshoot production issues across the AI-native stack: data pipeline gaps, agent reasoning failures, and MCP tool contract violations
  

  

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

* Collaborate with Equinix customers and internal NOC teams to co-design self-service network experiences powered by AI agents

* Translate customer network pain points — capacity planning friction, manual troubleshooting cycles, slow provisioning — into agent-driven automation capabilities

* Represent Network Observability engineering in cross-functional forums on AI platform strategy and network developer experience
  

  

R&D & Innovation

* Continuously evaluate emerging AI and networking technologies: new LLM capabilities, MCP protocol evolution, network foundation models, and vector-native data systems

* Prototype and evaluate AI-native approaches to network observability: anomaly detection agents, natural language network queries, and predictive capacity agents

* Contribute to Equinix's internal AI engineering community by sharing learnings from agentic network system design
  

  

**Qualifications**

Skills Required

* 5+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on platform, infrastructure, or network software systems

* Demonstrated experience building APIs that consume observability, telemetry, or network data at scale

* Proficiency in Python and/or Java for backend API and data pipeline development

* Hands-on experience with AI/LLM application development: prompt engineering, tool calling, RAG pipelines, or agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or equivalent)

* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) — either as a server implementer or consumer — or demonstrated ability to rapidly adopt structured AI tool interface specifications

* Experience with observability stacks: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Kafka, or similar streaming/metrics platforms

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  

  

Preferred

* Networking Certification or demonstratable understanding of network concepts: BGP, MPLS, VLANs, IP addressing and similar

* Familiarity with network inventory systems, CMDB/DCIM platforms, or graph-based topology data stores

* Background in agentic system design: multi-agent orchestration, tool safety guardrails, and structured agent output validation
* Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Weaviate) for RAG-backed network knowledge retrieval

title: Software Engineer II (JVM)
description:
### **Nexla, briefly**

Nexla is the data layer for enterprise AI. We give AI apps and agents the connectivity, context, and governance to work across more than 1,000 enterprise systems in real time, and we process over a trillion records a month doing it. DoorDash, LinkedIn, Johnson & Johnson, Instacart, and LiveRamp run mission-critical data on us. Honorable Mention in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Data Integration Tools, and top-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights four years running. Founded 2016, remote-first, headquartered in San Mateo.

Our values are short and we actually use them: Have Empathy. Be Curious. Be Intellectually Honest. Achieve Excellence. Remember to Relax.

**Role**  
You would work on the backend systems that move data through Nexla: JVM services, the streaming runtime on Kafka, and the distributed processing underneath it. Production Java every day. You take a problem, shape the design, build it, and own it through deploy and on-call. You debug it when it breaks. Small, focused team, which is why the ownership is real rather than nominal. This role sits closest to the integration layer, where the platform meets everything outside it, so the problem below is the one you would live in.

**What you'll own**

* Core framework features, designed and shipped by you. Schema evolution, pagination, rate limiting, circuit breaking, and the automated retries and self-recovery that keep pipelines running without a human watching. The SDKs and interfaces other teams build on sit here too: you write them, document them, and use them yourself.
* The streaming and processing path in production. Kafka, Spark, and Flink workloads, checkpointing, backpressure, and failure recovery. You operate what you build.
* Design decisions inside your scope, and a real voice in the ones above it. Multi-tenancy, concurrency, and latency show up in almost everything here, and you would be expected to have views on the tradeoffs rather than only implementing someone else's.
* The hard debugging. Trace failures across Kafka clusters, distributed runtimes, and flaky third-party APIs, fix them, then build the guardrails so they do not come back.

*Roughly 70% building and shipping, 15% design and technical discussion, 15% code review and the RFCs, runbooks, and docs that come with it.*

**The hard problem**  
Our platform integrates with more than a thousand external systems, each with its own schema quirks, auth scheme, rate limits, and retry semantics. The framework problem is the N+1 one: making the thousandth integration as cheap to add as the tenth. That means absorbing the differences into the abstraction rather than special-casing them, while the data underneath keeps moving at production volume.  
  
**Must-Haves**

* 5 to 8 years of software engineering, with some of it on backend platforms, services, or SDKs rather than only end-user applications.
* Strong Java. You understand JVM memory management, concurrency models, and non-blocking I/O, and you can work your way to the cause of a thread starvation issue from a heap dump.
* Hands-on experience with distributed systems in production: Kafka, Spark, Flink, or similar. You have run them, not only built against them.
* Comfort with the modern data stack and the protocols around it: Snowflake, Databricks, gRPC, GraphQL, webhooks, and CDC.
* You have owned production systems and know what good operational discipline looks like.
* You use AI tools in your actual work and can say specifically where they help and where they mislead you.

**Bonus points**

* Contributions to open-source data projects such as Airbyte, Flink, Debezium, or Arrow.
* Time at an iPaaS or ELT company: MuleSoft, Fivetran, Informatica, Airbyte, or similar.
* Deep Kubernetes and cloud-native experience, including Strimzi for Kafka.
* Security architecture: OAuth 2.0, mTLS, and encrypted credential management at scale.

**You'll thrive here if**

* You want ownership and will take it. You write code every day and you carry what you ship, through deploy and on-call.
* You are comfortable defining scope on the fly and shipping before the full picture is clear.
* You would rather build the guardrail than fix the same failure twice.
* You raise the quality of what is around you through review and pairing, not just the quality of what you write yourself.

*One thing to be clear about: our product definition is still moving as AI reshapes data integration, and the platform has to move with it. If you want a stable, well-defined surface to work on, this is not it.*

**How we hire**  
Four conversations, about two weeks end to end.

* **Coding.** Working through real code rather than a puzzle.
* **Low-level design.** How you structure a system at the class and interface level, and the tradeoffs you would defend.
* **High-level design.** Distributed systems design on a problem close to what we run in production.
* **Hiring Manager.** Ownership, clarity of thinking, and how you actually use AI in your work.

**On AI in the coding round.** Use it the way you would on the job, ours or anyone else's. We build AI tooling and we expect you to use AI tooling, so watching you work without it would tell us nothing useful. What we dig into is your judgment: what you delegated, what you verified, and what you threw away.

*You will hear from us either way.*  
  
**The practical stuff**  
Bengaluru, hybrid, 2 days a week in office. Compensation includes base salary and equity, set by depth and experience rather than by title. You will need to overlap with morning Pacific hours for syncs, design reviews, and collaboration with our US-based leadership and engineering teams.

**Worth a look before you apply**

* **What we are building now.** MCP Studio and Express, our two newest bets.
* **Who uses us, and why.** nexla.com/customers
* **The product in engineer terms.** docs.nexla.com
* **Our CEO on why we take "Remember to Relax" seriously.** Read the founder story
* **Everything else.** nexla.com · Blog · All open roles

### **Why Nexla? Why now?**

A few large companies - DoorDash, SentinelOne, Johnson & Johnson, LinkedIn, Amex, Integrity Marketing, among them use Nexla for data integration. Connectors, runtime, transformations, scheduling, the parts of the stack where data has to move between systems reliably.

The reason this is an interesting moment to join is what the agent shift is doing to the category. Data integration used to mean "land this data in that warehouse so a human can look at it." That product is mature. What it's becoming is closer to "an agent asks a business question, and the platform figures out which data and what code and which APIs add up to a real answer." That's a much bigger problem, and most of the architecture for it hasn't been built yet by anyone.

A concrete example. A revenue team wants to ask "which enterprise customers are showing renewal risk" and get a real answer through whatever agent or app they work in. Today there is no clean way to answer that question, it requires CRM, usage, support, and billing data joined in org-specific ways, and the calling agent can't just invoke a tool that returns the right answer unless someone first establishes whether the underlying data is even capable of producing one.

That is the system we are building. A probe agent investigates the data plane whether the right fields are populated, whether freshness is adequate, whether the joins exist, whether credentials cover the required scope and returns a grounded feasibility answer. Where there are gaps, Express.dev composes the pipelines to close them. The capability is then exposed as an MCP server: "renewal risk" as a curated product, with the business logic correct and the query semantics described well enough that the calling agent uses it as intended. The MCP Gateway governs which agents can call which capabilities, with the policies, audit, and observability an enterprise control plane requires.

The bet is that ten years of connector work, an enterprise customer base, and a runtime that already moves real volume are the right foundation to define this layer from.

Kong’s API Management suite includes the Kong Enterprise Gateway, the Konnect SaaS platform and a variety of Managed Gateways in public clouds like AWS, Azure and GCP. This suite of products helps customers in different industries (like finance, banking, eCommerce, airlines, etc.) manage their API platforms and operations at scale. Our customers expect secure, reliable, high scale, low latency offerings from Kong whether running on-premise or in the public cloud.
  
  
**About the Role:**

As a **Senior Software Engineer**, you will develop high-performance Go runtime, CLI engines and declarative state managers. You will architect the software that thousands of engineering teams use every day to interact with Kong's runtime — including **deck** (Kong’s state management & drift detection engine), the **Kong Terraform Provider**, official **Go SDKs** and automated spec-driven API tooling.

**What You Will Build & Own:**

  

You will balance **Software Development** with **APIOps Architecture**:

**1. Declarative Engine**

* **State & Drift Management Engines:** Design and optimize algorithms in **Go** for state diffing, validation, and real-time drift detection across large-scale multi-tenant API topologies.
* **Go SDK & Core Libraries:** Architect and maintain enterprise-grade, high-performance Go SDKs used by Kong’s internal microservices and external clients to interface with the Konnect SaaS platform.
* **API Design & Standardization:** Define clean, extensible REST API contracts across Kong’s platform runtimes.
* **Code Generation & Tooling Pipelines:** Architect spec-driven tooling (OpenAPI/AsyncAPI) to dynamically generate SDKs, client libraries, and IaC definitions without manual developer toil.

**2. APIOps & IaC Ecosystem**

* **Core CLI Engineering:** Build modern, fast, and intuitive CLI-first developer experiences designed for both human developer workflows and high-concurrency CI/CD automation pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins).
* **Terraform & Provider Ecosystem:** Build and extend high-reliability Terraform Providers to enable seamless IaC operations.
* **Support for Next-Gen Runtimes:** Bring new runtime capabilities into the declarative management ecosystem as native API primitives.

  **What You’ll Bring:**
* **5+ years of software engineering experience** designing and delivering production-grade backend systems and developer tools using **Golang**.
* **API Design Mastery:** Proven experience crafting intuitive, developer-friendly API schemas (REST, gRPC, OpenAPI), with a strong focus on backwards compatibility, versioning and developer experience (DX).
* **Hands-on IaC / Platform Understanding:** Production exposure to Terraform provider development, Kubernetes operators or stateful CI/CD automation pipelines.
* **Engineering Rigor:** Strong commitment to clean code, comprehensive automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end), benchmarking and robust software architecture.
* **Communication & Technical Leadership:** Ability to articulate complex technical decisions, mentor junior engineers and collaborate across global backend and platform teams.

**Why Join Kong?**

* **Build for Engineers:** Your work is open-source adjacent and directly impacts millions of developers and Fortune 500 enterprises around the globe.
* **Solving Deep Technical Problems:** Move beyond standard CRUD services to solve high-impact problems in declarative state sync, API governance and distributed connectivity.
* **High-Growth Pre-IPO Startup:** Scale your career alongside a market-leading company driving the future of API management and AI connectivity.

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. ### **About Us**



With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e\-mobility a global reality.



Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once\-in\-a\-lifetime opportunity to create an all\-electric future and a trillion\-dollar market.



At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

We are seeking a **Senior Software Engineer II** to join our **Audit Logging \& Security Visibility** team. This team builds the systems that record and surface security\-relevant activity across DigitalOcean's cloud platform, so customers and internal teams can detect threats, investigate incidents, and prove compliance — at billions of events a day.



In this role, you will set the technical direction for Audit Logging at DigitalOcean — defining how our event pipelines, SIEM integrations, and security visibility platform evolve over multi\-year horizons, and how they intersect with IAM, threat detection, and platform needs. You will be a primary technical voice in cross\-org decisions, and you will set the engineering standards the team builds against. If you are a seasoned engineer who wants to combine deep technical expertise with broad organizational impact, this is the role for you.


**What you'll do**
------------------


* **Define Platform Architecture:** Set the multi\-year technical strategy for audit logging, SIEM integration, and security visibility — designing for hyperscale event volumes and the evolving needs of enterprise customers.
* **Architect for Cross\-Domain Integration:** Lead decisions on how audit and telemetry systems intersect with IAM, threat detection, and platform engineering, so signals stay consistent across all of them.
* **Own Security Visibility Strategy:** Define the long\-term architecture for the Unified Security Dashboard and SIEM integrations (Splunk, Datadog, Chronicle, Sentinel) — setting patterns other teams build on, not just shipping one integration at a time.
* **Set Sustaining Engineering Standards:** Define what logging schema standards, event taxonomy, and operational hygiene look like across the domain, and hold the team accountable to that bar.
* **Architect for True Scale:** Design systems and data models that handle billions of events per day across multiple regions, with guaranteed delivery — anticipating multi\-year growth, not just current load.
* **Shape Cross\-Org Technical Decisions:** Be a key technical voice in design reviews spanning Audit Logging, IAM, Threat Detection, and Platform Engineering. Resolve architectural conflicts early, before they become production incidents.
* **Mentor Senior Engineers:** Coach engineers on system design, security engineering, and technical communication; act as a multiplier for the team's overall capability.
* **Translate Strategy to Leadership:** Communicate audit platform strategy and investment rationale to senior leadership, framing decisions in terms of customer trust, compliance risk, and business impact.

title: Sr. Software Engineer (Integrations)
description:
**About Dialpad**  

Dialpad is the AI platform for customer experience, built to resolve customer problems in real time across voice and digital. Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage.



Unlike legacy systems built to route and answer, or standalone agentic bot vendors built to deflect, Dialpad was built to resolve. Our AI agents and human agents operate on a single platform with shared context, allowing Agentic AI to resolve issues, advance deals, and eliminate busywork through automation while seamlessly handing conversations to humans when needed, with full context preserved.



Market\-leading brands, including Randstad, Motorola Solutions, Netflix, the San Diego Padres, the Colorado Rockies Baseball Club, and Cal Athletics, trust Dialpad. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T\-Mobile.


**Being a Dialer**  

At Dialpad, AI isn't just a feature; it's how our teams do their best work every day. We put powerful AI tools in every employee's hands so they can move faster, think bigger, and achieve more.



We believe every conversation matters. And we've built the platform that turns those conversations into insight and action, for our customers and ourselves.



We look for people who are intensely curious and hold themselves to a high bar. Our ambition is significant, and achieving it requires a team that operates at the highest level. We seek individuals who embody our core traits: **Scrappy, Curious, Optimistic, Persistent, and Empathetic**.

**Your role**  

As a Sr. Software Engineer on the Integrations team, you will lead the design and development of Dialpad's key native integrations. These integrations enable real\-time automation and data transfer between Dialpad and complementary systems, ensuring our mutual customers have a seamless, unified experience. This includes Agentic AI\-compatible integrations, CRMs, ticketing systems, workforce management platforms, and industry\-specific verticals such as recruiting, retail, and healthcare.



You will own a functional area or set of related features within Integrations, translating customer and business needs into robust technical solutions. You will help shape the 6\-12 month technical direction for your area, break down larger projects into clear deliverables, and solve classes of problems through shared tools, patterns, and processes.



You'll collaborate closely with engineering teammates, product leaders, business leaders, Dialpad customers, and external stakeholders. You will be expected to operate with little guidance, make pragmatic business and technical tradeoffs, and mentor other engineers through design, implementation, code review, debugging, and production support.



This position reports to our Engineering Manager and has the opportunity to be based in our Bangalore office. The position will require a hybrid working arrangement based out of our Bangalore office.


**What you'll do**


* Own the technical design, development, maintenance, and reliability of key native integrations across Dialpad's Integrations platform.
* Build and enhance integrations with systems such as Zendesk, HubSpot, AthenaHealth, Salesforce, Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace, and other customer\-critical SaaS platforms.
* Lead the delivery of Agentic AI\-compatible integrations that help customers automate workflows and connect Dialpad actions with external systems.
* Write architectural design and specification documents that clearly describe implementation options, tradeoffs, dependencies, risks, rollout plans, and success metrics.
* Develop backend services, APIs, workers, webhooks, data transfer flows, UI components, and automation workflows that scale across a large customer base.
* Break down larger projects into smaller deliverables and take responsibility for execution, delivery milestones, and the end\-to\-end result.
* Develop well\-tested features with appropriate test hooks, monitoring, and alerting, resulting in low defect reports and healthier customer scenarios.
* Design for performance, reliability, debuggability, extensibility, security, privacy, and operational simplicity.
* Debug complex production issues across Dialpad services and third\-party platforms, then turn those learnings into durable fixes and better team processes.
* Write clean, modular, and maintainable code using best practices along with unit tests.
* Participate in code and design reviews to ensure quality, maintainability, and scalability.
* Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers.
* Assist with emerging Agentic AI technologies and initiatives.
* Tech Stack: Python, Vue.js, Redis, Google Cloud, AI (MCP).


**Skills you'll bring**


* 7\+ years of professional experience as a software engineer, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience owning significant backend, full\-stack, platform, or integration systems in production, including design, implementation, launch, monitoring, and maintenance.
* Experience with at least one object\-oriented programming language, especially Python or JavaScript.
* Experience building integrations, APIs, webhooks, event\-driven systems, distributed systems, or customer\-facing platform features.
* Strong testing, debugging, and troubleshooting skills, especially across distributed systems and third\-party platform boundaries.
* Experience with OAuth, permission models, API rate limits, webhooks, event delivery, retries, idempotency, and third\-party platform constraints.
* Experience with Agile development methodologies.
* Effective communication skills, including writing design documents, surfacing risks early, and keeping stakeholders aligned.
* Collaborative team player who can work independently and autonomously when needed.
* Ability to evaluate multiple technical approaches and explain tradeoffs clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Pragmatic approach to solving problems while balancing customer impact, engineering quality, delivery timelines, and business goals.
* Experience mentoring engineers and raising the quality bar for a team.
* Agentic AI experience or strong interest in building AI\-compatible product workflows.
* Usage of AI coding assistants such as Claude, Gemini, or similar tools for the majority of coding tasks.

**Why Join Dialpad**


* Work at the center of the AI transformation in business communications
* Build and ship agentic AI products that are redefining how companies operate
* Join a team where AI amplifies every employee's impact
* Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and real opportunities for growth


We believe in investing in our people. Dialpad offers competitive benefits and perks, cutting\-edge AI tools, and a robust training program that help you reach your full potential. We have designed our offices to be inclusive, offering a vibrant environment to cultivate collaboration and connection. Our exceptional culture, repeatedly recognized as a Great Place to Work, ensures that every employee feels valued and empowered to contribute to our collective success.



Don't meet every single requirement? If you're excited about this role and possess the fundamental traits, drive, and strong ambition we seek, but your experience doesn't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply.


*Dialpad is an equal\-opportunity employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment.*

title: Salesforce Developer - Senior
description:
**Why We Stand Out**


Seeking a new challenge where your professional and personal aspirations are not only possible but supported? Kaufman Rossin might be just the place for you!


Kaufman Rossin Professional Services Private Limited’s (the “Company”) offices are located in the World Trade Center (WTC) in Bangalore, Karnataka, India, and at Udyog Vihar, in Gurgaon, Haryana, India.


The Bangalore office provides a range of services, including risk management, corporate governance, tax, assurance, and family office services. Out of the Gurgaon office, we render highly specialized back\-office alternative investment services for global hedge funds and related fund types. As one of the top accounting firms in the US, our foundation is “people first”. In the words of James Kaufman, one of our founders, “We prioritize our people, their development, and their well\-being. Our values are translated into action every day."


Kaufman Rossin, headquartered in Miami, Florida has been celebrated as the Best Place to Work in South Florida more than a dozen times. The firm has grown to over 700 employees, with offices spanning the tri\-county area and sister entities, Kaufman Rossin Wealth and Kaufman Rossin Alternative Investment Services.


The Firm is ranked 49th among the top 100 firms in the US by Inside Public Accounting 2023\. Internationally, the Firm has offices in Bangalore and Haryana in India and the Ivory Coast in Africa.

 **Think you have what it takes?**


Kaufman Rossin is seeking a Senior Salesforce Developer based in Bengaluru to lead the development, architecture, integration, and continuous improvement of the Salesforce platform.


Salesforce serves as the firms core CRM and client engagement platform, supporting pipeline and relationship management, client service processes, internal business operations, client and stakeholder experiences, integrations, automation, analytics, and increasingly AI\-powered capabilities through Agentforce.


This is a senior, hands\-on engineering role with broad platform ownership. You will partner directly with US\-based stakeholders and the Bengaluru PO/BA to define solutions, make architecture decisions, lead and mentor the Junior Salesforce Developer, and ensure Salesforce environment is well\-governed, performant, secure, scalable, and aligned with the firm's growth.


You will bring deep Salesforce platform expertise, strong Apex and LWC engineering skills, modern integration experience, and the platform maturity to balance delivery velocity with long\-term architectural health.


As we expand the use of Salesforce AI, this role will also play an important part in the design, development, governance, testing, and deployment of Agentforce solutions across the firm.

 **Requirements** **How You’ll Contribute:**

**Solution Architecture \& Technical Leadership**

* Own end\-to\-end solution design for Salesforce initiatives — evaluating declarative vs. programmatic approaches, assessing governor limit implications, integration dependencies, security considerations, and long\-term maintainability.
* Lead technical discovery with the Bengaluru PO/BA and US stakeholders — translating complex business requirements into well\-structured, scalable Salesforce solutions before development begins.
* Define and enforce Salesforce development standards across the team — coding conventions, test class quality standards, Flow best practices, naming conventions, API standards, security practices, and metadata organization in source control.
* Review and approve code and configuration changes from the Junior Salesforce Developer — providing structured, actionable feedback that builds their skills over time.
* Lead Salesforce release planning — coordinating sandbox environments, CI/CD deployments, pre\-release testing, regression testing, and production release governance.
* Proactively identify technical debt, platform risks, deprecated functionality, API dependencies, and scaling constraints — producing a prioritized remediation backlog and advocating for appropriate remediation.

**Sales Cloud — Advanced Development**

* Design and build complex Flows, Apex triggers, batch Apex, queueable Apex, scheduled processes, and asynchronous processing — handling sophisticated business process automation while balancing performance and governor limits.
* Build and maintain advanced Lightning Web Components — including components with complex state management, Lightning Data Service, wire adapters, server\-side Apex controllers, and integrations with external systems.
* Design reusable Salesforce services, components, and automation frameworks that reduce technical debt and improve development consistency.
* Lead Sales Cloud data model design — custom object architecture, junction objects, roll\-up strategies, relationship models, and schema decisions that maintain performance and scalability.
* Build solutions using Salesforce security and sharing architecture, including roles, sharing rules, permission sets, permission set groups, restriction rules, and programmatic sharing where appropriate.

**Agentforce \& Salesforce AI**

* Design, configure, test, deploy, and continuously improve Agentforce agents that support business processes and user workflows.
* Partner with business stakeholders to identify high\-value Agentforce use cases and translate them into secure, measurable, and scalable AI solutions.
* Configure Agentforce topics, instructions, actions, and grounding strategies to enable agents to reason and take appropriate actions across Salesforce.
* Build custom Agentforce actions using Flow, Apex, and other Salesforce platform capabilities where out\-of\-the\-box actions do not meet business requirements.
* Develop and manage Prompt Builder templates and reusable AI capabilities that support Agentforce and other Salesforce AI use cases.
* Integrate Agentforce with Salesforce records, Flows, Apex services, APIs, and external systems to enable agents to execute business processes safely.
* Implement appropriate security, permissions, data access, and governance controls for Agentforce to ensure agents operate within authorized boundaries.
* Establish testing and quality\-assurance practices for Agentforce, including evaluation of agent responses, actions, grounding, accuracy, and business outcomes before production deployment.
* Monitor Agentforce usage, performance, adoption, errors, and consumption to continuously improve agent effectiveness and manage platform resources.
* Stay current on Salesforce Agentforce, Prompt Builder, Data 360/Data Cloud, Einstein, and Salesforce AI platform capabilities and advise on opportunities for responsible adoption.

**Service Cloud**

* Own Service Cloud architecture and configuration — designing case management models, queue structures, assignment rules, escalation logic, and SLA frameworks that support client service and internal operations.
* Build and maintain Service Cloud Flows and automation — case routing, status lifecycle management, SLA milestone tracking, notifications, and closure procedures that reduce manual effort and improve resolution time.
* Configure and manage the Service Console — page layouts, quick actions, macros, Lightning components, and productivity features that give service teams the tools to resolve cases efficiently.
* Implement and maintain entitlements, milestones, and SLA policies where appropriate.
* Integrate Service Cloud with external systems and intake channels through supported Salesforce APIs, Email\-to\-Case, Web\-to\-Case, Experience Cloud, and other appropriate integration patterns.
* Build Service Cloud analytics covering case volume, resolution time, SLA compliance, queue health, trends, and operational performance.

**Experience Cloud**

* Own the architecture and development of Experience Cloud sites — designing portal structures, navigation models, page layouts, and digital experiences for client\-facing and internal stakeholder audiences.
* Configure member profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, and guest user policies — ensuring each audience sees the appropriate data, content, and functionality.
* Build custom Experience Cloud components using LWC — delivering dynamic, data\-driven portal experiences that integrate with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Agentforce, Knowledge, and other Salesforce capabilities.
* Implement Experience Cloud integrations with external identity providers — supporting SSO, registration handlers, and authentication flows that meet security and access management standards.
* Design and maintain Knowledge capabilities within Experience Cloud where appropriate.
* Monitor and optimize Experience Cloud site performance, component efficiency, security, and reliability.

**Data Quality \& Governance**

* Own Salesforce data governance framework — defining data ownership, field\-level standards, picklist governance, naming conventions, documentation requirements, and data stewardship processes.
* Design and implement a comprehensive duplicate management strategy — configuring matching rules, duplicate rules, and remediation processes that maintain a clean, trusted CRM dataset at scale.
* Establish and enforce data validation architecture — validation rules, required fields, formula\-based alerts, Flow\-driven data hygiene checks, and automated exception management.
* Lead data migration and enrichment initiatives — designing field mappings, transformation logic, reconciliation procedures, and post\-load validation processes.
* Build data governance dashboards and exception reports — giving leadership visibility into data completeness, stale records, missing critical information, duplicates, and data quality trends.
* Partner with IT security and compliance functions on Salesforce data governance — including field\-level security, data classification, retention, auditability, and appropriate AI data access.
* Ensure Agentforce and other AI capabilities operate against trusted, appropriately governed, and permission\-aware Salesforce data.

**DevOps, Platform Health \& Mentorship**

* Own the Salesforce DevOps pipeline — Salesforce CLI, VS Code, Git\-based source control, and Azure DevOps CI/CD for automated deployment, validation, testing, and release management.
* Maintain a healthy sandbox strategy with clear promotion paths, refresh schedules, testing standards, and hotfix governance.
* Conduct regular platform health reviews — storage consumption, API usage, Flow error rates, Apex job performance, integration logs, deprecated API usage, security configuration, and system performance.
* Maintain Salesforce security posture — permission architecture, least\-privilege access, field\-level security, sharing rules, role hierarchy design, connected apps, and integration\-user security.
* Mentor and coach the Junior Salesforce Developer — pairing on complex problems, conducting structured code reviews, and investing in their growth toward senior\-level capability.
* Produce and maintain comprehensive technical documentation — including data dictionaries, integration architecture diagrams, API inventories, solution designs, deployment runbooks, Agentforce documentation, and release notes.
* Monitor Salesforce product and feature retirements and proactively develop remediation plans to avoid disruption to business\-critical functionality.

**What Skills You’ll Bring:**

**Required**

* 5\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce development experience, with at least 2 years in a senior or lead developer capacity.
* Deep Sales Cloud expertise — complex Flow, Apex triggers, Batch/Queueable Apex, LWC, data modeling, security architecture, and advanced automation.
* Strong Salesforce integration architecture experience using REST APIs, Bulk APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Named Credentials, OAuth, and other modern integration patterns.
* Demonstrated experience modernizing or maintaining Salesforce integrations as API versions, authentication requirements, and platform capabilities evolve.
* Experience designing secure integrations using OAuth 2\.0, JWT, Named Credentials, External Credentials, connected apps, and least\-privilege integration users.
* Hands\-on experience with Agentforce, including agent configuration, topics, instructions, actions, testing, deployment, and optimization.
* Experience with Prompt Builder and integrating Agentforce with Salesforce automation such as Flow and Apex.
* Understanding of AI security, grounding, permissions, testing, governance, and responsible deployment within Salesforce.
* Service Cloud experience — case management architecture, queue/assignment/escalation design, Service Console, automation, and service operations.
* Experience Cloud experience — portal architecture, member access, LWC components, sharing model design, authentication, and Knowledge integration.
* Salesforce data governance experience — duplicate management, validation architecture, data quality monitoring, migrations, and enrichment.
* Salesforce DevOps experience — Salesforce CLI, VS Code, Git source control, and CI/CD pipeline configuration using Azure DevOps or equivalent.
* Salesforce Platform Developer I certification — mandatory.
* Excellent written and spoken English — able to lead technical discovery sessions, present architecture decisions, mentor developers, and communicate with US\-based IT leadership and business stakeholders with confidence and clarity.

**Preferred**

* Demonstrated production experience implementing and supporting Agentforce agents beyond Trailhead or proof\-of\-concept environments.
* Salesforce Platform Developer II certification.
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect or System Architect.
* Service Cloud Consultant certification.
* Experience Cloud Consultant certification.
* Experience with Data 360/Data Cloud as a grounding or retrieval source for Agentforce.
* Experience with Salesforce Prompt Builder and AI governance.
* Experience designing event\-driven Salesforce architectures using Platform Events and Change Data Capture.
* Salesforce CRM Analytics development experience.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps pipelines and Salesforce DX for automated deployments.
* Experience with integration monitoring, API lifecycle management, and modernization of legacy

**What We Offer:**

* Direct partnership with US\-based stakeholders and Architecture team — your decisions shape how the firm manages client relationships and service delivery at scale.
* A Bengaluru team culture that treats every engineer as a first\-class member of one global team.
* Clear growth path toward Salesforce Architect or Technical Lead as CRM capabilities expand.
* Full support for Salesforce certifications — Application Architect, System Architect, Service Cloud Consultant, Experience Cloud Consultant, and beyond.
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits commensurate with senior\-level expertise

  

**Benefits**  

* Work\-Life Balance
* People First Company
* Hybrid work policy
* Working directly with peers in the US

***We embrace authenticity.*** *Kaufman Rossin is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a culture that reflects the diversity of our firm and clients. We encourage understanding, acceptance, and celebration among all people. That includes lifestyle, education, experience, race, ethnicity, age, religion, physical ability, sexual orientation, and gender identity.* ***Differences make unique varieties.***

**Project Role :** Custom Software Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high\-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
  

**Must have skills :** Angular  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Custom Software Engineer, your day involves creating tailored software solutions by designing, coding, and improving various components within systems or applications. You engage in collaborative environments that emphasize agile methodologies, ensuring the delivery of scalable and efficient software that meets unique business requirements. Your role is dynamic, requiring adaptability and continuous enhancement of software to support evolving organizational goals and user needs.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand project requirements and deliver effective software solutions.
* Maintain and improve existing software applications to enhance performance and user experience.
* Document development processes, code changes, and technical specifications to support knowledge sharing.
* Assist junior team members by providing guidance and support to foster their professional growth.


  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Angular.
* Strong knowledge of front\-end development principles and best practices.
* Experience with component\-based architecture and modular design.
* Familiarity with responsive design techniques to ensure applications work across devices.
* Ability to debug and optimize code for performance and scalability.
* Understanding of version control systems and collaborative development workflows.


  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Angular.
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.
* B shift timing (12:30PM to 10:30PM)

  

15 years full time education

title: Developer Experience Contractor
description:
### **About EarnIn**



As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real\-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.



We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world\-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world\-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.


**POSITION SUMMARY**



Join EarnIn's Developer Experience team for a 12\-week summer internship building agentic AI infrastructure that directly improves how engineers ship software. You'll own meaningful end\-to\-end work on intelligent developer tooling and design systems that turn raw CI signals into actionable insights under the guidance of senior engineers. This position is based in Bengaluru, India, with two days a week in\-office required as part of our expanding site location, and is a 6\-month contract engagement with a start date in January 2027\.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Build agentic workflows that analyze signals from the software delivery pipeline and surface actionable guidance to engineering teams.
* Develop automated tooling that detects patterns in build and test reliability and drives corrective action to improve developer productivity.
* Create AI\-powered features that translate technical signals into plain\-language summaries and proactive recommendations for engineers.
* Build a conversational agent interface that helps engineers understand and resolve build issues through natural, evidence\-backed interactions.
* Integrate across the developer tooling ecosystem to connect data from multiple sources into a cohesive developer experience.
* Write clean, well\-tested, and well\-documented code built to last beyond the internship.


**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**


* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree (B.E., B.Tech, M.Tech, or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field from an Indian university
* Some experience with Python, Go, TypeScript, or another modern backend language; coursework or personal projects count.
* Familiarity with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD systems, curiosity about how they work under the hood.
* Some exposure to working with APIs and structured data formats.
* Interest in AI/LLM\-powered tooling; you don't need production experience, but you should be excited to learn how agents and tool\-calling work.
* Comfort using AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as part of your day\-to\-day workflow.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, communicate progress proactively, and ask for help when blocked is a plus.
* Prior internship or project experience in developer tooling, platform engineering, or observability is a plus.
* Familiarity with Datadog, getDX, or similar telemetry platforms is a plus.
* Experience calling LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) in a project context is a plus.


\#LI\-Hybrid


At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. Imports Platform team is leading a strategic initiative to modernize Okta's identity lifecycle management capabilities by architecting and migrating from a legacy monolithic system to a highly scalable, distributed microservices platform. This critical service orchestrates the importing, syncing, and provisioning of identities and access policies—users, groups, roles, entitlements—from external directory services including Active Directory, Office 365, and LDAP\-based systems.
 



 As a Principal Software Engineer on the Imports Platform team, you will be a cross\-team technical leader who takes difficult, ambiguously defined problems and drives them from ideation through production impact without oversight. You will own projects from zero to landing—defining scope, planning execution, making architectural decisions, and articulating measurable impact across the group. Arctic Wolf, with its unicorn valuation, is the leader in security operations in an exciting and fast\-growing industry—cybersecurity. We have won countless awards for our excellence in security operations and remain dedicated to providing an industry\-leading customer and employee experience.


Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a **Senior Developer \- Managed Risk Platform** to be part of making this happen.  

  



**About the Role**  

The Arctic Wolf security operations platform ingests and processes upwards of 250 billion events a day from a wide variety of on\-premise devices and cloud platforms. The security pipeline is a **distributed system** of loosely\-coupled microservices that constitute our **real\-time analysis** and **threat detection systems.** These services distill the incoming events into actionable intelligence that our Concierge Security Teams use to protect customers.
  

We are growing rapidly, with our data volume increasing ten\-fold roughly every two years. We are looking for experienced developers to join our pack and work with us to continuously evolve and expand the capabilities of our security platform. This particular role focuses on building components of our Managed Risk Platform.  

  



**You Will:**

* Create and scale high\-performance services in a real\-time threat analysis pipeline
* Architect, design, develop, test and deliver software in an agile environment
* Deploy containerised services to production within hours after your changes are merged, in keeping with our culture of Continuous Integration and Infrastructure\-as\-Code
* Work as part of a team of highly skilled engineers
* Continuously learn and expand your technical horizons

**Our Technology Stack:**  

**Golang, Docker, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Kubernetes/EKS, PostgresSQL, Kafka, Java, Linux**  



**About You:**

* **Excited to work at the intersection of Big Data and the Cybersecurity problem spaces**

Senior Java Developer
description:
**Hello there! We're Infrrd.** 




 Infrrd (pronounced In\-fur\-d) is an Enterprise AI company that uses AI and Machine Learning to automate human tasks in document\-heavy workflows across mortgage, insurance, and finance. We are looking for a Senior Java Developer to help build and own the backend services that power our mortgage document processing platform.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 You will own backend services that process large, complex mortgage documents at scale — designing the pipelines, integrating LLMs, and keeping the whole thing fast, accurate, and cost effective in production. This is a hands\-on senior role with real ownership: you will make architecture calls, drive them to a decision, and set the quality bar for engineers working alongside you.
 



  





**What You'll Actually Work On:** 




 High\-throughput extraction pipelines that process big\-size documents and large volumes of data in parallel, LLM failover and resilience logic across multiple model providers, and continuous work on accuracy, latency, and cost.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 
 :
 


* **Build high\-throughput document pipelines.** 
 Asynchronous, parallel processing with batching, retries, backpressure, and idempotent reprocessing for big\-size documents and large data volumes.
* **Work with the latest LLMs.** 
 Build against current LLM APIs — timeouts, token and cost controls, response validation, and automatic failover between providers.
* **Engineer for resilience.** 
 Circuit breakers, fallback chains, and graceful degradation so a single upstream failure never takes the pipeline down.
* **Debug production.** 
 Investigate extraction failures, latency spikes, and cost regressions using dashboards and metrics, and fix the root cause.
* **Raise the bar on the team.** 
 Review PRs, break features into clear tasks, unblock junior engineers, and write design docs that hold up to scrutiny across time zones.



  





  





**Who You Are** 
 :
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on Java development, including at least 2 years owning a production service.
* Excellent command of Core Java, with real depth in multithreading and concurrent architecture design.
* Strong with Spring Boot and Spring Data; comfortable in microservices and REST architecture.
* Strong working knowledge of No\-SQL DB (preferred MongoDB ); familiar with relational databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL).
* Comfortable with Docker and Kubernetes, and at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills with a solid command of data structures.
* Reasons about tradeoffs — cost, latency, and accuracy — not just correctness.
* Has informally mentored or guided junior engineers; the person others come to when they're stuck.
* Operates independently with minimal supervision, and proactively flags risks instead of waiting to be asked.
* Excellent written communication — much of the collaboration is asynchronous and across time zones.



  





**Good to Have** 
 :
 


* Exposure to LLM or GenAI application development — prompt iteration, evaluation, or accuracy measurement.
* Working knowledge of Python.
* Experience with streaming queues like Kafka or RabbitMQ.
* Background in Document AI, OCR, or the mortgage / fintech domain.
* Familiarity with observability tooling (Grafana, Metabase, ELK).



  





**Work Mode:** 




 5\-days work in office with flexible working hours (Google Maps Location).
 



  





**Curious about the kind of engineering challenges we solve? Check out a few of our tech talks:** 




**Automated Data Extraction from Engineering \& Construction Drawings** 




**Ally \| Agentic AI for Mortgage** 




**NLP\-powered Table Extraction for Insurance Policy Data** 




  





**By submitting your application, you agree that your personal information and resume may be collected, processed, and stored by us for recruitment purposes, including consideration for future roles.**

title: Software Development Engineer II , Amazon Cross Border Tech
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Amazon Cross Border Core Technology team is seeking a seasoned Software Engineer to drive the development of innovative technologies that will shape platforms and products impacting a multibillion\-dollar business and enhancing the global customer experience. Our team is focused on building next\-generation services that will transform international trade at Amazon. We aim to revolutionize how shoppers worldwide discover and purchase global products. We’re developing new services in areas like Customer Returns, Accounting, Customer Service and Mobile App to enhance the international shopping experience. Our goal is to offer a seamless, one\-stop shopping experience for international customers, which includes:  

  

Building products (mobile and web based) that reach millions of new customers globally, delivering a world\-class shopping experience with localized language, payment options, and currencies.  

Designing API\-based services in NAWS that enable scalable platforms for both internal and external partners.  

Advancing customer experience technologies to support shoppers worldwide.  

Innovating strategies for global expansion and developing solutions that will sustain the continued rapid growth of this thriving business.

You’re seeking a career where you can create, deliver, and make a lasting impact. You design solutions that reach millions of new customers globally, addressing complex problems with a holistic approach. You thrive in environments that demand intricate feedback loops and the development of robust ecosystems. You’re passionate about solving real\-world challenges with creative and thoughtful solutions, leveraging a deep understanding of the problem space. You constantly challenge yourself and others to improve, always striving for better outcomes. By collaborating closely with the business, you help define expansion strategies and develop innovative solutions that support the continued rapid growth of this dynamic and thriving business.  

  

About the team  

We're going to enable customers around the globe to purchase products on Amazon with guaranteed shipping and import duty fees. We’re going to improve this experience by making selection available across all Amazon marketplaces, so that customers can search and browse in their preferred language and currency. Along the way, we're going to face seemingly impossible problems. We're going to argue about how to solve them, and we'll work together to find a solution that is superior to each of the proposals we came in with. We'll make difficult decisions, but we'll all understand why. We'll be the dream team.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3\+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Shopify Developer
description:
Shopify Developer \+ UI/UX Designer

**WebzPlot \| Bangalore**

We’re looking for a **Shopify Developer who also has a strong eye for UI/UX and eCommerce design.**

Someone who can build a technically solid Shopify store, but also understands that a good eCommerce website is not just about clean code.

It needs to **look good, feel intuitive and convert.**

At WebzPlot, we work with brands across fashion, jewellery, beauty, lifestyle, D2C and other eCommerce categories. We’re looking for someone who can take a store from idea to execution while thinking about both the customer experience and the development behind it.

What You’ll Do

* Build and customise Shopify stores from scratch
* Work with Shopify 2\.0 themes and custom sections
* Develop using Liquid, HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Customise existing themes based on client requirements
* Convert Figma or design concepts into responsive Shopify pages
* Design and improve product pages, collection pages, landing pages and homepages
* Create clean, modern and conversion\-focused eCommerce layouts
* Improve mobile shopping experiences
* Work on cart, upsell, cross\-sell and conversion\-focused functionality
* Integrate Shopify apps and third\-party tools
* Troubleshoot theme, app and frontend issues
* Improve website speed and frontend performance
* Maintain consistent design systems across the store

The UI/UX Side Matters

We are not looking for someone who simply takes a design and codes it.

We want someone who can look at an eCommerce page and understand:

* Whether the visual hierarchy makes sense
* Whether the CTA is prominent enough
* Whether the product information is easy to scan
* Whether the page feels trustworthy
* Whether the mobile experience is smooth
* Whether too many elements are creating friction
* Whether the layout supports conversion

You should be able to suggest improvements instead of blindly implementing everything you are given.

What We Expect From You

You should have strong working knowledge of:

* Shopify
* Shopify Liquid
* HTML
* CSS
* JavaScript
* Shopify 2\.0 architecture
* Metafields and dynamic content
* Theme customisation
* Responsive design
* Cross\-browser compatibility
* Shopify app integrations
* Basic performance optimisation

You should also have a strong understanding of:

* eCommerce UI/UX
* Conversion\-focused design
* Product page structure
* Collection page usability
* Mobile\-first design
* Visual hierarchy
* Typography and spacing
* CTA placement
* Navigation and information architecture

Design Tools

Experience with the following is preferred:

* Figma
* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Canva

Figma knowledge is especially important.

You do not need to be a full\-time graphic designer, but you should be comfortable creating and refining clean website layouts.

You’ll Be a Strong Fit If

You care about the small details.

You notice when spacing is inconsistent.

You understand why a button should be above the fold.

You know when a page looks visually impressive but is difficult to shop.

You think about the customer journey before adding another section.

You can balance aesthetics with conversion.

And when you build something, you test it properly across desktop and mobile instead of assuming it works.

Bonus Points If You

* Have experience working with D2C brands
* Have built premium or luxury eCommerce websites
* Understand CRO
* Know basic SEO principles for Shopify
* Have experience with page builders
* Understand Shopify app conflicts
* Can work with APIs or custom integrations
* Have experience with Git
* Understand accessibility and usability best practices
* Can create reusable Shopify sections that clients can manage easily

What Your Work Will Be Judged On

Not just whether the website works.

We’ll look at:

* Code quality
* Visual quality
* Responsiveness
* Website speed
* User experience
* Conversion thinking
* Attention to detail
* Ability to solve problems independently

Experience

**2 to 5 years preferred**

Strong Shopify experience is required.

Agency experience is an advantage because you’ll be working across multiple brands and projects.

Location

**Bangalore \- In our JP Nagar Office**

Think You’re a Fit?

Send us:

* Your CV
* Your Shopify portfolio
* 3 websites you have worked on
* What you specifically handled on each project
* A Figma or UI/UX sample if available

We’re looking for someone who can **build like a developer and think like an eCommerce designer.**

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Bengaluru, Karnataka (Bengaluru, Bengaluru Urban District): Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* Are you currently in Bengaluru? If not are you willing to relocate and work from our JP Nagar office?
* Show us one eCommerce website you think is beautifully designed but poorly optimised for conversion. What would you change?
* Share your work sample links and shortlist your best works and let us know what do you like about it and what could be done better if you were to redo it

Experience:

* Creating Ecommerce Website on Shopify: 1 year (Required)
* UI design: 1 year (Required)
