**Posting End Date:** 10/10/26
  
About the Role
  
  

We are looking for a mid\-level SAP Joule developer to design, build, and extend generative AI capabilities on SAP Joule, SAP's AI copilot embedded across S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba, and SAP BTP. The role covers building custom Joule skills and agents, integrating generative AI into SAP applications, and connecting SAP's AI stack to business processes and data.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Design, build, and test custom Joule skills and agents using Joule Studio / SAP Build.
  
Develop backend services and APIs (CAP, Node.js/Java, or ABAP RESTful Programming Model) that expose business logic and data to Joule.
  
Integrate SAP Generative AI Hub / SAP AI Core with large language models (LLMs) for use cases such as summarization, Q\&A, and workflow automation.
  
Implement retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, including embeddings, vector stores, and grounding Joule responses in SAP business data.
  
**Configure and extend SAP BTP services:** destinations, XSUAA/authorization, event mesh, and API Business Hub connections.
  
Write and tune prompts, evaluate model outputs, and iterate on accuracy, tone, and safety guardrails.
  
Build or extend Fiori/SAPUI5 front ends and OData/REST services that surface Joule\-driven features.
  
Collaborate with functional/business teams to translate requirements into AI\-enabled scenarios.
  
Support testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting of deployed Joule skills in production.
  
  

Required Qualifications
  
3\-5 years of software development experience, including at least 1\-2 years working with SAP BTP or SAP Cloud Application Programming (CAP) model.
  
Hands\-on experience with SAP Joule, Joule Studio, or SAP Build (Apps/Code/Process Automation).
  
Proficiency in Node.js or Java for CAP\-based services, or ABAP Cloud / RAP for backend extensions.
  
**Practical understanding of generative AI concepts:** prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, and LLM integration (e.g., via SAP AI Core / Generative AI Hub or comparable platforms).
  
Experience with OData and REST API design and consumption.
  
**Familiarity with SAP security concepts:** XSUAA, role\-based access control, and destination configuration.
  
Working knowledge of SAPUI5/Fiori Elements for front\-end development.
  
Comfortable with Git\-based version control and agile delivery practices.
  
  

Desired Qualifications
  
Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, IBP, or Ariba functional modules.
  
Exposure to SAP Business Technology Platform's Event Mesh or Integration Suite.
  
Familiarity with vector databases (e.g., SAP HANA Cloud vector engine) and RAG architectures.
  
SAP certifications (e.g., SAP Certified Development Associate \- SAP BTP, or Generative AI\-related credentials).
  
**Experience with responsible AI practices:** bias testing, output evaluation, and data privacy compliance.

**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS**



At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry\-specific survey data.

* Equity
* Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
* Monthly Lunch on Legion


**ABOUT LEGION**



Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission\-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast\-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.



Legion Technologies delivers the industry's most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award\-winning, AI\-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee\-centric. It's proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting\-edge technology in an easy\-to\-use platform and mobile app that employees love.



If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.


**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**



There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig\-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion's Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. **How We Determine What We Pay**
--------------------------------


*As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry\-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. title: Principal Software Engineer- Performance Engineering
description:
**Principal Software Engineer, Performance Engineering**

Job Summary


We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer, Performance Engineering to embed performance as a first\-class engineering discipline across our large\-scale applications and databases — shifting performance validation left into design and active development, rather than treating it as a pre\-release regression gate. This is a hybrid engineering role: the candidate writes and reviews code, builds performance tooling and instrumentation, and partners directly with feature teams during design and implementation to catch scalability and efficiency issues before they reach production. The ideal candidate is fluent in Linux environments, comfortable authoring both application\-level code and test/automation code, skilled in modern load and performance testing frameworks integrated into CI/CD, and capable of deep database performance analysis to identify and resolve bottlenecks at the query, index, and schema level. This role requires a minimum of 10 years of relevant software engineering experience.


Why This Role Is Different


Traditional performance testing runs *after* code is "done," turning every finding into a costly late\-cycle fix. This role exists to move that curve left: performance budgets, load profiles, and profiling hooks become part of design review, code review, and CI — not a separate phase owned by a separate team.


Key Responsibilities


Shift\-Left Performance Engineering


* Partner with Product Architects and engineering teams *during design and development* to define performance/scalability requirements, SLOs, and load profiles before code is written.
* Embed lightweight, code\-as\-test performance checks (e.g., k6, Gatling, Locust) directly into CI/CD pipelines so regressions surface on every build/PR, not at a downstream test cycle.
* Review production code and architecture for performance anti\-patterns (N\+1 queries, unbounded loops, inefficient serialization, poor connection/thread pool sizing) as part of the normal code review process.
* Build and maintain reusable performance test harnesses, fixtures, and synthetic data generators that developers can run locally and in CI without specialist hand\-holding.

Load, Stress, and Full\-Scale Validation


* Design, script, execute, and evaluate performance, load, and stress tests to validate system behavior under expected and peak conditions, using modern load\-generation tooling (k6, Gatling, Locust) alongside JMeter/LoadRunner for legacy scenario coverage.
* Develop and maintain scripts to simulate realistic UI and transactional load across applications.
* Use the Linux command line and shell/Python scripting to configure environments, automate test setup/execution/data collection/reporting, and troubleshoot in flight.

Database \& Query Performance


* Write and evaluate SQL queries against large\-scale databases to support test data preparation and results analysis.
* Perform detailed evaluation of table and index design, query execution plans, and their impact on overall database performance.
* Generate and analyze deep diagnostics (Oracle AWR/ASH, SQL Server Query Store/MDW, or Postgres pg\_profile/PoWA) to isolate database\-layer bottlenecks.
* Generate and load large volumes of representative test data to support realistic performance validation.

Analysis, Instrumentation \& Remediation


* Analyze test and production telemetry (APM, profiling, GC/memory data) to identify root causes and drive optimization — collaborating directly with developers, DBAs, and infrastructure teams on fixes, not just findings.
* Evaluate and tune JVM memory management and garbage collection behavior under load.
* Document performance requirements, findings, and recommendations, and communicate clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

Required Skills and Experience


* Minimum 10 years of software engineering experience, including a minimum of 6 years focused on performance engineering, performance/load testing, or a closely related discipline.
* Demonstrated ability to write and/or review production application code — this is not a testing\-only role.
* Strong proficiency with the Linux command line for navigation, file management, process monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Semi\-advanced scripting ability (Bash/Korn, Python, or Perl) to automate workflows and build reusable tooling.
* Hands\-on experience with JMeter and/or LoadRunner for legacy load scenario coverage.
* Hands\-on experience integrating performance/load tests into CI/CD pipelines (shift\-left practice), using modern frameworks such as k6, Gatling, or Locust.
* Experience with Java memory management, garbage collection, evaluation, and tuning.
* Solid understanding of large\-scale database fundamentals: SQL, table/index design, referential integrity, and query performance evaluation.
* Hands\-on experience with Oracle AWR/ASH generation and evaluation, or equivalent (SQL Server Query Store/MDW, Postgres pg\_profile/PoWA).
* Ability to work with Product Management, Architects, and engineering teams to define performance requirements early in the development lifecycle, and to prioritize competing demands accordingly.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, Tanzu, or OpenShift for deploying, scaling, and monitoring workloads under test.
* Familiarity with Cassandra or Scylla; performance evaluation and tuning experience in either is a plus.

Preferred (Nice to Have) Skills


* Experience extending JMeter/LoadRunner or custom Java\-based test frameworks for runtime transaction generation.
* Experience with APM/observability platforms (Dynatrace, New Relic, Datadog, Grafana) for production\-signal\-driven performance work.
* Python for data analysis and tooling beyond test automation.
* Basic project management and Agile Scrum experience.

What We Offer


* Ownership of performance as an engineering discipline, not a downstream checkpoint — direct influence on architecture and design decisions.
* Exposure to large\-scale, high\-throughput fintech systems and modern cloud\-native infrastructure.
* Collaborative engineering culture with direct partnership across product, architecture, and infrastructure teams.
Competitive compensation and benefits package.

This team is responsible for Okta's enterprise\-grade soft\-delete and object recovery capability, designed to protect critical identity objects (Users and Groups) from accidental or malicious deletion.



As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design, implementation, and operational reliability of critical components within our real\-time, high\-fidelity recovery system. You will solve complex engineering problems around identity preservation (UUIDs) and relationship restoration—including group memberships, app assignments, and password hashes—ensuring our customers can seamlessly recover from data loss events.

* **Feature Execution:** Drive the technical design and end\-to\-end implementation of complex features, such as granular and bulk recovery workflows across Free and Advanced Resilience tiers.

* **Security \& Compliance:** Implement secure logging and tracking for all recovery operations (soft\-delete, restore, permanent\-delete) in Syslog to adhere to strict audit and compliance standards.
* **Product \& Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Partner with Product Managers and technical leads to clarify requirements, define technical scope, and break down complex projects into actionable milestones.
* **Operational Excellence:** Participate in on\-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis (RCAs), and enhance system observability, logging, and metrics.
* **Code Quality \& Technical Standards:** Champion engineering best practices through thorough code reviews, automated testing, and comprehensive technical documentation.

### **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**


* **Experience:** 5\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience building and scaling highly reliable, production\-grade applications.

* **Data Management:** Proficiency with relational databases (e.g., **MySQL**) and caching strategies (e.g., **Redis**) to manage state and high\-throughput data snapshots.
* **API Design:** Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust **RESTful APIs** for enterprise integration.
* **Problem Solving \& Ownership:** Proven track record of independently breaking down ambiguous requirements into clean, scalable software designs.

### **Nice to Haves**


* Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP).
* Experience with resilient systems design (e.g., retry strategies, circuit breakers, rate limiting).
* Hands\-on experience with feature flagging frameworks and gradual/canary deployment strategies.
* Experience with queueing systems or message brokers (e.g., Kafka).

### **Education and Training**

title: Senior Quality Engineer, Automation & API Testing
description:
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open\-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open\-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.


LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.


OUR PEOPLE:


People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.


We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.


**Position Overview**

  

The Senior Quality Engineer is responsible for driving quality across the software development lifecycle through a strong focus on test automation, API validation, quality engineering practices, and continuous delivery. This role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Architecture, and DevOps teams to establish testing strategies, improve automation coverage, identify quality risks early, and enable rapid, reliable releases.


The Senior QE serves as a quality advocate and technical leader, helping teams adopt scalable automation frameworks, shift\-left testing practices, and data\-driven quality standards. The role is expected to operate independently, influence engineering decisions, and mentor team members on quality engineering best practices.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Strategy \& Test Leadership**

* Define and execute comprehensive quality strategies aligned with product and engineering objectives.
* Lead test planning activities and establish risk\-based testing approaches across initiatives.
* Review requirements, architectures, and designs to identify quality risks and testability concerns early.
* Establish quality gates, standards, and automation objectives for development teams.
* Provide technical leadership on quality engineering practices across multiple products or services.
* Mentor Quality Engineers and development teams on automation, testing methodologies, and quality best practices.

**API \& Service\-Level Testing**

* Design, develop, and maintain robust API and service\-level automation frameworks.
* Validate REST, GraphQL, and microservice\-based architectures through automated testing.
* Create automated tests covering functional, integration, contract, regression, and negative testing scenarios.
* Validate authentication, authorization, data integrity, error handling, and security controls across services.
* Perform data validation through API responses, databases, queues, and downstream integrations.
* Collaborate with developers to improve API testability and observability.

**Test Automation Engineering**

* Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Develop reusable automation libraries, utilities, and test data management solutions.
* Drive automation\-first testing approaches, minimizing reliance on manual regression testing.
* Continuously improve automation reliability, execution speed, and maintainability.
* Measure automation effectiveness using coverage, execution, defect detection, and quality metrics.
* Ensure automated tests are integrated into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous delivery goals.

**System Integration \& End\-to\-End Testing**

* Validate complex workflows across distributed systems, microservices, and third\-party integrations.
* Design test strategies for highly integrated cloud\-based applications.
* Conduct integration and system testing to ensure end\-to\-end business process validation.
* Identify risks associated with cross\-system dependencies and recommend mitigation strategies.

**Performance, Reliability \& Security Testing**

* Define and execute performance, scalability, and reliability testing approaches.
* Analyze application behaviour under load and identify performance bottlenecks.
* Support security testing initiatives by validating authentication, authorization, and API security controls.
* Collaborate with Engineering teams to improve application resilience and production readiness.

**DevOps \& Continuous Quality**

* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms.
* Ensure quality gates are embedded within deployment pipelines.
* Leverage test execution analytics and quality metrics to drive continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams to improve environment stability, test data availability, and deployment validation.
* Support quality practices within cloud\-native and containerized environments.

**Release Quality \& Production Support**

* Evaluate release readiness using risk assessments, automation results, and quality metrics.
* Participate in production incident investigations and root cause analysis.
* Develop monitoring and validation strategies to ensure quality after deployment.
* Analyze defect trends and recommend preventative quality improvements.

**Skills \& Qualifications**

**Required**

* **7\+ years of experience** in Quality Engineering, Software Testing, or Test Automation.
* Strong experience designing and implementing **test automation frameworks** .
* Advanced experience in **API testing and automation** using tools such as Postman, Rest Assured, Playwright, Karate, or similar frameworks.
* Strong programming/scripting experience with languages such as **Java, C\#, TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python** .
* Experience testing **distributed systems, microservices, and cloud\-native applications** .
* Strong understanding of software architecture, SDLC, Agile, and DevOps methodologies.
* Hands\-on experience with **CI/CD pipelines** and automated quality gates.
* Experience with SQL and database validation techniques.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to independently drive quality initiatives and influence engineering teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud environments.
* Experience with containerized platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience implementing contract testing and service virtualization.
* Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or k6\.
* Experience with observability and monitoring platforms (Application Insights, Datadog, Splunk, Grafana).
* Experience in regulated, enterprise, or high\-availability environments.
* ISTQB Advanced, CSTE, or equivalent certification.

title: Power BI & Power Apps Developer
description:
**Position: Power BI \& Power Apps Developer**

**Payroll Company: Pro Team Solutions Private Limited**   
**Work\& Client Location: Sahakar Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka**   
**Experience:** 5–6 Years  
**Location:** Bangalore, Karnataka  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Function:** Business Intelligence / Data Analytics / Microsoft Power Platform

**Position Summary**

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced **Power BI \& Power Apps Developer** with approximately **5\+ years of hands\-on experience** in designing, developing, implementing, and supporting business intelligence solutions and low\-code business applications using the **Microsoft Power Platform**.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in **Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, DAX, Power Query, Dataverse, and SharePoint Online**, along with a good understanding of data modelling, ETL, system integration, security, and governance.

The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, and technical teams to understand business requirements and translate them into **interactive dashboards, automated workflows, scalable applications, and data\-driven solutions** that improve operational efficiency and support informed decision\-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Power BI Development**

* Design, develop, deploy, and maintain interactive **Power BI dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical solutions**.
* Develop complex **DAX measures, calculated columns, KPIs, and business calculations** based on functional requirements.
* Build and optimize robust data models using **Star Schema and Snowflake Schema** methodologies.
* Perform data transformation, cleansing, and preparation using **Power Query / M Language**.
* Implement and manage **Row\-Level Security (RLS)** to ensure secure and controlled access to business data.
* Connect Power BI with multiple data sources, including:
* SQL Server
* SAP
* SharePoint Online
* Microsoft Excel
* Azure services
* Dataverse
* REST APIs and other external data sources
* Develop optimized data models and reports for improved performance and scalability.
* Configure and monitor **Power BI Service workspaces, datasets, dataflows, gateways, and scheduled refreshes**.
* Troubleshoot data, refresh, visualization, and performance\-related issues.
* Monitor report performance and implement optimization techniques to improve report loading and query execution times.
* Ensure dashboards and reports follow appropriate data governance, security, and reporting standards.

**2\. Power Apps Development**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain business applications using **Microsoft Power Apps**.
* Develop both **Canvas Apps and Model\-Driven Apps** based on business requirements.
* Create responsive and user\-friendly applications for business process automation and operational requirements.
* Develop custom forms, screens, controls, user interfaces, and business logic.
* Use **Microsoft Dataverse** for data storage, application development, security, and integration.
* Integrate Power Apps with:
* SharePoint Online
* SQL Server
* Microsoft Teams
* Azure Services
* Dataverse
* Microsoft 365
* External APIs and third\-party systems
* Develop applications that improve manual processes and enhance business productivity.
* Configure application security, permissions, roles, environments, and access controls.
* Troubleshoot and enhance existing Power Apps solutions based on business and user feedback.

**3\. Power Automate \& Business Process Automation**

* Design and develop automated workflows using **Microsoft Power Automate**.
* Build automated business processes for:
* Approval workflows
* Notifications and alerts
* Document management
* Data synchronization
* Task assignments
* Business process automation
* Integrate Power Automate with Microsoft 365 applications, Power Apps, SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL Server, Teams, and external systems.
* Develop cloud flows and automate repetitive and manual business processes.
* Troubleshoot failed flows, connectivity issues, integration errors, and performance problems.
* Optimize existing workflows to improve reliability, efficiency, and maintainability.
* Implement appropriate error handling, exception management, and monitoring mechanisms.

**4\. Data Integration \& Technical Development**

* Integrate data from multiple internal and external sources into Power Platform and Power BI solutions.
* Work with **SQL Server, SAP, SharePoint, Excel, Azure, Dataverse, APIs, and other enterprise data sources**.
* Understand and apply data warehousing and **ETL concepts**.
* Develop efficient data extraction, transformation, and loading processes.
* Analyze data structures and ensure data quality and consistency.
* Collaborate with data and IT teams to resolve data integration and connectivity issues.
* Ensure solutions are designed with scalability, performance, maintainability, and security in mind.

**5\. Business Requirements \& Stakeholder Management**

* Engage with business stakeholders to understand business processes, challenges, and reporting requirements.
* Gather, analyze, and document functional and technical requirements.
* Translate business requirements into effective Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate solutions.
* Work closely with business users to validate dashboards, applications, workflows, and reports.
* Provide technical recommendations and identify opportunities for process improvement and automation.
* Conduct user demonstrations, knowledge\-sharing sessions, and training as required.
* Provide ongoing technical support and troubleshoot issues raised by business users.

**6\. Governance, Security \& Deployment**

* Follow Microsoft Power Platform governance, security, compliance, and development standards.
* Implement appropriate security roles, permissions, access controls, and **Row\-Level Security**.
* Manage Power Platform environments and application lifecycle activities.
* Support solution deployment across development, testing, and production environments.
* Maintain appropriate documentation for applications, dashboards, workflows, integrations, and deployment processes.
* Follow best practices for version control, change management, solution management, and release processes.
* Ensure Power Platform solutions comply with organizational security and data governance requirements.

**7\. Documentation \& Support**

* Prepare and maintain technical and functional documentation for developed solutions.
* Document application architecture, data sources, workflows, integrations, security configurations, and deployment procedures.
* Provide production support for Power BI reports, Power Apps, and Power Automate workflows.
* Analyze and resolve application, report, data, and integration\-related issues.
* Continuously identify opportunities to enhance existing solutions and improve system performance.

**Required Technical Skills**

The candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in the following technologies:

**Power BI**

* Power BI Desktop
* Power BI Service
* DAX
* Power Query / M Language
* Data Modelling
* Star Schema / Snowflake Schema
* KPIs and calculated measures
* Row\-Level Security (RLS)
* Power BI performance optimization
* Data refresh and gateway management

**Power Apps**

* Canvas Apps
* Model\-Driven Apps
* Dataverse
* Forms and UI development
* Power Fx
* Application security and permissions
* Environment management

**Power Automate**

* Cloud Flows
* Approval workflows
* Notifications and alerts
* Business process automation
* Integration with Microsoft 365 and third\-party applications
* Error handling and troubleshooting

**Data \& Integration**

* SQL Server
* SAP
* SharePoint Online
* Microsoft Excel
* Microsoft Dataverse
* Azure Services
* REST APIs / External APIs
* ETL and data warehousing concepts

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Approximately **5\+ years of professional experience** in Power BI and Power Apps development.
* Strong hands\-on experience in developing enterprise\-level **Power BI dashboards and reports**.
* Strong knowledge of **DAX and Power Query / M Language**.
* Practical experience developing **Canvas Apps and Model\-Driven Apps**.
* Strong experience with **Power Automate and business process automation**.
* Good knowledge of **Microsoft Dataverse and SharePoint Online**.
* Experience integrating Power Platform solutions with multiple data sources and external systems.
* Good understanding of **data modelling, data warehousing, ETL, and data integration concepts**.
* Experience in implementing application security, RLS, governance, and access controls.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to independently understand business requirements and convert them into technical solutions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

* Computer Science

The ideal candidate should be:

title: Senior Software Engineer, Devices - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**
### **About JumpCloud®**


JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

  


As we continue to grow JumpCloud internationally, we are hiring software engineers to expand our product. You’ll have the opportunity to play a key role in the success and development of our engineering teams in addition to growing your own career.

  


**About the Role:**

In this role, you will specifically work on the Device Management (MDM / Endpoint Management) vertical at JumpCloud, the role shifts focus from broad cloud microservices to deeply understanding operating system internals (macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android) and how they communicate with the cloud.



In the Device Management vertical, you will build the software that allows IT administrators to remotely configure, patch, secure, and monitor thousands of endpoints from a single pane of glass. You will work on cross\-OS device management engines, mobile device management / Declarative Device Management(MDM/DDM) telemetry, custom system agents, and zero\-touch enrollment pipelines. This role balances local client\-side programming (interacting with the OS) and building high\-availability cloud APIs.

  


### **What you’ll be doing:**

* Primarily working with Go and Node.js for cross\-platform applications on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
* Gaining or utilizing expertise in areas like Windows services, kernels, Event Loggers, Mac Launch daemons, and macOS internals.
* Collaborating with architects, UX designers, and DevOps to ensure our systems are highly available, scalable, and deliver exceptional user experiences.
* Working within a Scrum framework to drive agile development.
* Learning and working with mTLS protocols and related security concepts. Prior experience in these areas is a plus.
* Using OAuth/OIDC flows for secure user authentication and service access.
* Writing Unit test cases, Functional test cases, acceptance tests along with automating these test cases.
* Contributing to the future of our Device Management services by participating in strategic planning and scoping sessions with product managers.
* Embodying our core values: building strong connections, thinking big, and striving to improve by 1% every day.

### **We’re looking for:**

* 7\-10 years experience developing MAC, Windows, or Linux applications (including integration with third\-party applications) in any modern language (Python, Java) or Golang. Experience in one of them is a must.
* Experience using one of the public cloud providers (AWS, GCP or Azure) with CI/CD pipelines (preferably Github Action) to build, test and deploy. Knowledge of containerization technologies and orchestration with Kubernetes.
* Strong hands\-on experience in backend software or full stack development is a must
* Working knowledge of Swift, C Sharp, C\+\+ would be an added advantage
* Working knowledge on device MDM would be an added advantage
* Willingness to mentor junior members of the team.
* Bonus points if you have experience with Services, event logger, Kernel in Windows OS and/or Launch demon, app hosting in Mac

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**
JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.**

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on\-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

**Language:**JumpCloud has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

**Why JumpCloud?**
If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud. Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

**Scam Notice:**
Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

\#LI\-Remote \#BI\-Remote

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.
